66505.recognize_zh: A 圖骨髓切片幾乎全為脂肪、只剩零星細胞，符合再生不良性貧血 (aplastic anemia)；B 圖 CT 可見前縱膈腫塊；C 圖為上皮細胞與淋巴球混合、伴纖維束的胸腺瘤 (thymoma)，三者合看提示胸腺瘤相關骨髓衰竭 (Good syndrome)。
features: Panel A: bone marrow biopsy almost entirely replaced by adipocytes with only scattered small cells between fat spaces; bony trabeculae at edges
Panel A: no identifiable clusters of erythroid, myeloid or megakaryocytic precursors in this field
Panel B: contrast CT at the level of the aortic arch showing a small soft-tissue nodule in the anterior mediastinum measured about 15.9 × 32.3 mm
Panel C: thymoma with sheets of small lymphocytes admixed with plump spindle to epithelioid cells, separated by eosinophilic fibrous bands
66505.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows markedly hypocellular marrow composed almost entirely of adipose tissue, with only scattered lymphocytes and stromal cells and no appreciable trilineage hematopoiesis; there is no infiltrative process in this field. A chest CT demonstrates an anterior mediastinal soft-tissue mass. The resected mediastinal lesion shows a lymphocyte-rich epithelial neoplasm with spindled areas and fibrous septa, consistent with thymoma (mixed type A/B per the case). Together with pancytopenia, these findings are consistent with thymoma-associated aplastic anemia; immunoglobulin levels and B-cell counts should be assessed for Good syndrome.

ddx.vs: Hypocellular MDS retains dysplastic megakaryocytes or clusters of immature precursors and often shows increased CD34+ cells or a clonal karyotype, none of which is seen in this fatty marrow.
PRCA shows selective absence of erythroid precursors with preserved granulopoiesis and megakaryocytes, whereas this marrow lacks all three lineages.
Morphology is identical, so exclusion requires chromosome breakage, telomere length and germline testing.
PNH is separated by flow cytometric detection of GPI-anchor-deficient (FLAER-negative) clones, not by marrow morphology.

66185.recognize_zh: 數顆中至大型、形態多變的異常淋巴細胞，細胞核不規則或折疊，細胞質深藍色並含多個清楚的空泡（vacuoles），部分細胞有一端的細胞質突起；這些不像反應性淋巴球，需以免疫表型（CD3、CD56 陽性）確認為侵襲性 T/NK 細胞淋巴瘤侵犯骨髓。
features: Pleomorphic medium to large atypical lymphoid cells, several times the size of a red cell
Irregular, folded to bilobed or dumbbell-shaped nuclei with fine to moderately condensed chromatin; nucleoli are not clearly resolved in this image
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm containing multiple sharply punched-out vacuoles
Occasional cells with polar cytoplasmic projections or ragged cytoplasmic borders
Background of red cells and a single small dense round cell (small lymphocyte or late normoblast)
66185.describe_en: Aspirate smear, in a thin area with a blood-like background, shows several pleomorphic medium to large atypical lymphoid cells. The cells have irregular, folded to bilobed nuclei, moderately dispersed chromatin and moderate amounts of deeply basophilic cytoplasm with prominent discrete vacuoles; some show polar cytoplasmic projections. Nucleoli are not well resolved at this magnification, and azurophilic granules are not evident. These cytologic features are highly atypical and, together with the reported CD3+, CD56+, CD99+ immunophenotype lacking CD4, CD5, CD8, TdT and CD34, are consistent with involvement by an aggressive peripheral T/NK-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: ANKL shows similar vacuolated, granular atypical cells but is surface CD3 negative, CD56 positive and almost always EBV positive, whereas this case was EBV negative.
Burkitt cells also have basophilic vacuolated cytoplasm but are monotonous with round nuclei and a mature CD10+ BCL2- B-cell phenotype with MYC rearrangement.
Histiocytes have abundant pale cytoplasm with ingested blood cells and low N:C ratio, not the high N:C atypical lymphoid cells seen here.

ddx.dx: Acute monoblastic or blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm
ddx.vs: Monoblasts and BPDCN cells have fine chromatin with nucleoli and express CD33/CD64 or CD123/TCF4 respectively rather than CD3.

66121.recognize_zh: 中央的嗜中性球有分葉核，胞質內散布多個金黃色、具折光性的短棒狀結晶；右下另一顆白血球核上也有少數金黃色結晶，背景紅血球多呈鋸齒狀，符合重度高膽紅素血症時白血球內的膽紅素結晶。
features: Neutrophil with lobulated nucleus containing multiple golden-yellow, refractile, short rod/needle-shaped cytoplasmic crystals
Crystals overlie both nucleus and cytoplasm and are not stained purple (intrinsic pigment color)
A second leukocyte (lower right) with dense nucleus shows a few similar yellow crystals
Background red cells are crenated (echinocytic) with small refractile artifacts; no other inclusions evident
66121.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows crenated red cells and scattered leukocytes. A neutrophil in the center contains numerous golden-yellow, refractile, rod-shaped intracytoplasmic crystals that retain their natural color rather than taking up the stain; a second leukocyte shows a few similar crystals. Findings are consistent with intracellular bilirubin crystals, typically seen in smears from patients with marked hyperbilirubinemia, particularly neonates, and are thought to form in vitro after blood collection.

ddx.vs: Hemosiderin forms golden-brown to blue-black granular clumps that stain with Prussian blue, whereas bilirubin crystals are bright yellow needles/rods and iron-negative.
Hemozoin is brown-black and granular, and accompanies intraerythrocytic parasites, not bright yellow refractile rods.
Cryoglobulin deposits are pale blue-gray amorphous or crystalline material, whereas these crystals are distinctly golden-yellow and correlate with serum bilirubin.
Stain precipitate is purple-black, lies over cells and background alike, and is not confined to leukocyte cytoplasm.

66057.recognize_zh: 試管內紅血球懸浮液中可見大量肉眼可見的細小紅色顆粒狀凝集塊（agglutinates），而非均勻的紅色懸浮液，符合冷凝集素（cold agglutinin）試驗陽性。
features: Test tube containing a red cell suspension viewed grossly
Numerous fine, speckled red agglutinates dispersed throughout the fluid and along the glass wall
Suspending medium between clumps is only lightly tinged rather than uniformly opaque red
No single compact button; clumping is granular and diffuse
Temperature of incubation and reversibility on warming cannot be assessed from the photograph
66057.describe_en: Gross photograph of a test tube containing a red cell suspension shows numerous fine, macroscopically visible red cell agglutinates distributed throughout the fluid and adherent to the tube wall, in contrast to a homogeneous suspension. The image alone does not document the incubation temperature, titer, or reversal of agglutination on warming to 37 °C. In the appropriate setting (cold-incubated sample with dispersal on warming, DAT positive for C3d), findings are consistent with a positive cold agglutinin test, supporting cold agglutinin disease.

ddx.vs: Rouleaux form stacked coin-like aggregates that disperse on saline replacement, whereas true agglutinates persist in saline and disperse only on warming in CAD.
Warm autoantibodies rarely cause gross agglutination; agglutination does not reverse at 37 °C and the DAT is typically IgG positive rather than C3d only.
The Donath-Landsteiner IgG biphasic hemolysin causes hemolysis rather than prominent agglutination and is confirmed by the Donath-Landsteiner test.
Low-titer, narrow thermal-amplitude cold agglutinins may clump cells at 4 °C but not near body temperature; titer and thermal amplitude separate them.

65609.recognize_zh: 骨髓中巨核細胞呈多個分離的圓形核葉（separated lobes），並可見巨核細胞的有絲分裂像（抹片中的濃縮染色體團塊與切片中的中期板），加上顆粒異常的顆粒球與芽細胞，指向多系發育不良的 AML。
features: Increased blasts and hypogranular myeloid precursors with irregular nuclei (panel A)
Dysplastic megakaryocytes with multiple widely separated round nuclear lobes (panel B)
Megakaryocytes with condensed chromatin masses representing mitotic figures on aspirate (panel C)
Megakaryocyte mitotic figure with a metaphase-like chromosome plate on H&E biopsy (panel D)
Auer rods not clearly resolved at this image resolution
65609.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smears show increased blasts and hypogranular myeloid cells with nuclear irregularity. Megakaryocytes are dysplastic, with multiple widely separated round nuclear lobes, and several show condensed chromatin clumps consistent with mitotic figures. The core biopsy highlights a megakaryocyte containing a metaphase-like mitotic figure within a cellular marrow. Findings demonstrate multilineage dysplasia with megakaryocyte mitoses; with 40% blasts by flow cytometry and myelodysplasia-related mutations, they are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia, myelodysplasia related.

ddx.vs: Reactive megakaryocytes have normally connected hyperlobated nuclei, with rare mitoses and no increase in blasts.
AMKL is dominated by megakaryoblasts with cytoplasmic blebs and CD41/CD61 expression rather than mature dysplastic megakaryocytes with myeloid blasts.
Morphology may be similar, and separation rests on the blast count (≥20% for AML) by aspirate differential and flow cytometry.
Tumor giant cells form cohesive clusters with atypical mitoses and are keratin positive and CD61 negative.

65417.recognize_zh: 四格裡的異常早幼粒細胞（promyelocyte）細胞質塞滿粗顆粒與大量交錯的桿狀 Auer rod，有的核呈雙葉狀，是典型高顆粒型 APL 的樣子。
features: Large abnormal promyelocytes, roughly 2 to 3 times the diameter of adjacent red cells
Cytoplasm packed with coarse azurophilic granules and numerous crisscrossing rod-like inclusions (multiple Auer rods)
Nuclei round to kidney-shaped, one cell with a bilobed/dumbbell nuclear outline partly obscured by granules
Moderate N:C ratio with granules overlying the nucleus
Background red cells with occasional echinocytes; no normal maturing granulocytes in these crops
65417.describe_en: Composite of four high-power fields shows abnormal promyelocytes with abundant cytoplasm densely filled with coarse azurophilic granules and numerous rod-shaped inclusions consistent with multiple Auer rods, arranged in crisscrossing bundles. Nuclei are round to reniform, and one cell shows a bilobed nuclear contour. These cells are morphologically distinct from normal promyelocytes, which lack Auer rods and have a visible Golgi zone. Findings are consistent with acute promyelocytic leukemia (hypergranular type); urgent confirmation of PML::RARA by FISH or PCR and coagulation screening are indicated.

ddx.vs: Normal promyelocytes have a perinuclear hof, round nucleus and granules without Auer rod bundles, and show orderly maturation.
Those blasts usually carry a single long slender Auer rod with a salmon-colored perinuclear zone rather than faggots of rods in hypergranular cytoplasm.
Occasional single Auer rods may be present but faggot cells are rare, and PML::RARA is absent.

exam.answer_en: Acute promyelocytic leukemia, hypergranular — abnormal promyelocytes with multiple crisscrossing Auer rods (faggot cells)
pearls_zh: 考法：四格小圖考「多根交錯 Auer rod」與雙葉核；即使是高顆粒型，核也常呈雙葉或腎形，這也是 APL 線索。
確認：FISH（快速）或 RT-PCR 檢測 PML::RARA；RT-PCR 可定出 bcr1/bcr2/bcr3 斷點並用於 MRD 追蹤。
變異型 RARA 夥伴：ZBTB16::RARA 對 ATRA 與 ATO 反應差；形態疑 APL 但 PML::RARA 陰性時，應加做 RARA break-apart FISH。
Sanz 風險分層：WBC >10×10⁹/L 為高風險，出血與早期死亡風險較高。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤為 G-CSF 後或恢復期的正常前骨髓球；正常者有核旁 Golgi 淡染區、無 Auer rod 且成熟有序，本圖為多根 Auer rod 的異常細胞。

quiz.q: 形態像 APL 但 PML::RARA FISH 陰性，下一步應考慮什麼？
quiz.a: RARA break-apart FISH／分子檢查，找 variant RARA 夥伴（如 ZBTB16::RARA）

65289.recognize_zh: 中央右側一顆細胞在灰粉色細胞質內有兩個小而緻密的圓核，是雙核的晚期紅血球母細胞（binucleated erythroblast）；背景紅血球大小不一，含卵圓形大紅血球、靶形紅血球與棘狀紅血球，符合巨母紅血球性貧血的紅系發育異常。
features: Binucleate late (orthochromatic) erythroblast with two small, round, pyknotic nuclei in grey-pink cytoplasm
Adjacent small cell with a dense irregular nucleus and ragged cytoplasmic projections
Background anisopoikilocytosis with oval macrocytes and scattered target cells
Occasional echinocytes and irregular poikilocytes
Thin area of smear dominated by mature red cells
65289.describe_en: Smear shows a thin, red-cell-dominated area with marked anisopoikilocytosis including oval macrocytes, target cells and echinocytes. A binucleate late erythroblast with two equal, condensed nuclei is present, adjacent to a small cell with a dense irregular nucleus and frayed cytoplasm. Other precursor stages are not included in this field, so the sample could be either a thin aspirate area or blood. In the setting of B12/folate deficiency, the binucleate erythroblast reflects dyserythropoiesis of megaloblastic anemia.

ddx.vs: MDS can show identical binucleate erythroblasts but typically has ring sideroblasts or clonal cytogenetics and normal B12/folate levels.
CDA II shows numerous binucleate late erythroblasts with normal B12/folate, a positive family history, and SEC23B mutation.
Overlap artifact shows two separate cytoplasmic outlines, whereas here both nuclei lie within one continuous cytoplasmic border.

65161.recognize_zh: 視野中有兩條細長彎曲的線狀蟲體，紫藍色體部內含密集核柱，兩端外有淡粉紅色、超出蟲體的鞘膜（sheath），大小遠大於背景紅血球；在嗜酸性球增多病人的 buffy coat 抹片中出現有鞘微絲蟲（microfilaria）。此圖為螢幕翻拍並有條紋干擾，尾端核的分布無法清楚判讀。
features: Two long, slender, curved worm-like organisms many times longer than an RBC diameter
Bodies stain dark blue-purple with a densely packed column of nuclei
Pale pink sheath extending beyond the head and tail ends of the bodies
Tail-end nuclear pattern and cephalic space not resolvable due to image quality
Background of RBC-rich buffy coat material with prominent moiré line artifact from photographing a screen
65161.describe_en: Buffy coat smear shows two elongated, curved microfilariae lying across a background of red cells. The organisms have a dark blue-purple body packed with nuclei and a pale pink sheath that projects beyond the anterior and posterior ends. Evaluation of the cephalic space and the arrangement of terminal tail nuclei, which is needed for species identification, is limited by moiré artifact and resolution. Findings are consistent with sheathed microfilariae in buffy coat; species determination requires a thick film or concentrated specimen at higher resolution, ideally with nocturnal sampling, or molecular testing.

ddx.vs: W. bancrofti is sheathed but its sheath often stains poorly with Giemsa, the body curves gently and the tail tip is free of nuclei.
B. malayi has a sheath that stains pink with Giemsa, kinked body curves and two distinct separated terminal tail nuclei, which cannot be confirmed in this image.
Loa loa is sheathed with a sheath that stains poorly with Giemsa and nuclei extending continuously to the tail tip, and circulates by day.
Mansonella microfilariae are smaller and unsheathed with a blunt tail containing nuclei to the tip.

exam.answer_en: Sheathed microfilariae in buffy coat smear — elongated nucleated worms with sheath projecting beyond both ends; species not determinable in this image
pearls_zh: 考法：指線狀蟲體問微絲蟲鑑定三要點：有無鞘、頭端 cephalic space 長短、尾端核分布；本圖只能確認有鞘。
有鞘種：W. bancrofti（尾端無核）、B. malayi（尾端兩顆分離核，Giemsa 鞘呈粉紅）、Loa loa（核連續至尾尖）；無鞘：Mansonella、Onchocerca。
Buffy coat、Knott concentration 或膜過濾可濃縮低密度微絲蟲；依種別選採血時間：W. bancrofti、B. malayi 夜間，Loa loa 白天。
嗜酸性球增多病人需列入寄生蟲鑑別；Loa loa 高微絲蟲量時用 DEC 或 ivermectin 有腦病變風險，治療前須定種與定量。
exam.pitfall_zh: 螢幕翻拍條紋與纖維易干擾判讀；真正微絲蟲有規律核柱與鞘，纖維無核。此圖不宜硬判種別，需高解析 thick film 或 PCR。

quiz.q: 圖中微絲蟲鞘膜超出蟲體兩端，鑑定種別時還需觀察哪兩個部位的特徵？
quiz.a: 頭端 cephalic space 長度與尾端核的分布。

65097.recognize_zh: CD3 染色下濾泡間（副皮質）區佈滿棕色陽性 T 細胞，而多個濾泡呈淡藍色幾乎不染，清楚勾勒出小型萎縮濾泡的輪廓；T 細胞屬正常分布，無異常聚集。
features: Low-power (4x) CD3 immunostain of lymph node
Dense CD3-positive small T cells filling the interfollicular/paracortical areas
Several small follicles largely CD3 negative, outlining regressed follicular structures
Scattered CD3-positive cells along vessels traversing interfollicular zones
No aberrant T-cell sheets or loss of CD3 in the interfollicular compartment
65097.describe_en: CD3 immunohistochemistry at low power shows abundant small T cells distributed throughout the interfollicular and paracortical areas, while several small follicles are largely CD3 negative, delineating their regressed architecture. The T-cell compartment appears reactive in distribution without atypical clusters. Taken together with the B-cell and plasma cell stains, the pattern supports preserved compartmentalization in Castleman disease-like changes seen in TAFRO syndrome. Evaluation for aberrant antigen loss (CD5, CD7) or a T follicular helper phenotype would be needed to exclude a T-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: AITL shows an expanded paracortex with atypical clear CD3-positive T cells that coexpress PD-1/CXCL13/CD10, extrafollicular CD21 FDC meshworks and clonal TCR, features not shown here.
PTCL shows diffuse effacement by atypical T cells often with loss of pan-T antigens such as CD5 or CD7, rather than a normal paracortical distribution around preserved follicles.

ddx.dx: Reactive paracortical hyperplasia (e.g., viral or dermatopathic)
ddx.vs: Paracortical hyperplasia has expanded T zones with immunoblasts or Langerhans cells but lacks the regressed follicles and hypervascularity of Castleman-type histology.

64905.recognize_zh: 成群的中大型母細胞核圓、染色質細緻，多數核中央或一側有淡染的杯狀凹陷（cup-like），部分胞質可見少量細顆粒，符合伴杯狀母細胞的急性骨髓性白血病。
features: Clusters of medium to large blasts with high N:C ratio
Round to slightly indented nuclei with a pale cup-shaped invagination in many cells
Fine, open chromatin
Scant to moderate pale cytoplasm, some with fine azurophilic granules
Occasional smudged cell and platelets; red cells show crenation
64905.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous blasts, some in clusters, with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios and finely dispersed chromatin. Many blasts contain a pale cup-like nuclear invagination, and a subset shows scant cytoplasm with fine granules. No Auer rods or maturing granulocytes are identified in this field. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with cup-like blast morphology, which correlates with NPM1 and FLT3-ITD mutations; molecular confirmation is required.

ddx.vs: Microgranular APL has bilobed or sliding-plate nuclei with Auer rod bundles, and PML::RARA must be excluded urgently.
Monocytic blasts have more abundant gray cytoplasm and folded nuclei, and are nonspecific esterase positive.
Lymphoblasts lack cytoplasmic granules and nuclear cups and are MPO negative with TdT and lymphoid antigen expression.

exam.answer_en: AML with cup-like blasts — clustered blasts with fine chromatin and pale cup-shaped nuclear invaginations, associated with NPM1/FLT3-ITD
pearls_zh: 考法：指著核中央或一側淡染區的 blast 問形態名稱與關聯突變；定義上 cup-like 凹陷需佔核直徑相當比例（常引用 ≥25%）。
NPM1 突變造成 NPM1 蛋白異常滯留細胞質，IHC 可見 cytoplasmic NPM1 陽性，可作為分子結果前的輔助證據。
NPM1 突變 AML 常見正常核型、單核球分化傾向與高白血球；伴 FLT3-ITD 時白血球更高。
臨床處置前先排除 APL：CD34−/HLA-DR− 且有顆粒時，送 PML::RARA 並先評估凝血功能。
exam.pitfall_zh: 細胞含少量細顆粒時易誤認為 APL 或 AML with maturation：cup-like blast 為圓核加單一淡染凹陷、無 Auer rod 束；最終仍需 PML::RARA 與 NPM1 分子檢測區分。

quiz.q: 這類杯狀核 blast 的 AML 做 NPM1 免疫染色，蛋白會出現在細胞哪個位置？
quiz.a: 異常位於細胞質（cytoplasmic NPM1）。

64457.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中十顆異常細胞，核呈雙葉、蝴蝶狀或腎形深凹摺，染色質細緻，細胞質淡藍灰色、幾乎看不到顆粒，正是微顆粒型急性前骨髓球性白血病（APL, M3v）的典型形態。
features: Medium to large cells with moderate pale blue-grey cytoplasm
Bilobed, butterfly-shaped, or deeply folded reniform nuclei with a central cleft
Fine, delicate chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous
Cytoplasmic granules sparse to absent at light microscopy (occasional fine dust-like granules)
No Auer rod bundles visible in these cells; background red cells unremarkable
64457.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (composite of ten cells) shows abnormal promyelocytes with characteristic bilobed, butterfly-shaped, or deeply indented reniform nuclei, fine chromatin, and moderate pale blue-grey cytoplasm with few or no visible granules. Auer rod bundles are not identified in these fields. These cells can be mistaken for monocytes or monoblasts because of their folded nuclei. Findings are consistent with microgranular (hypogranular) variant acute promyelocytic leukemia, requiring urgent confirmation of PML::RARA and assessment for coagulopathy.

ddx.vs: Monocytic cells have folded but not symmetric bilobed nuclei with abundant grey cytoplasm, are strongly nonspecific esterase positive, MPO weak, and usually HLA-DR positive and PML::RARA negative, while M3v cells are strongly MPO positive and HLA-DR/CD34 negative.
Classic APL shows cytoplasm packed with coarse granules obscuring the nucleus and frequent faggot cells, usually with leukopenia rather than leukocytosis.
Mature monocytes have lacy condensed chromatin, abundant vacuolated grey cytoplasm, and no immature fine chromatin.

ddx.dx: Sézary or other cleaved lymphoid cells
ddx.vs: Cerebriform or cleaved lymphocytes have hyperchromatic convoluted nuclei with scant cytoplasm and a mature T-cell phenotype without MPO.

exam.answer_en: Acute promyelocytic leukemia, microgranular (hypogranular) variant — abnormal promyelocytes with bilobed butterfly-shaped nuclei and sparse granules
pearls_zh: 考法：指雙葉蝴蝶狀核、顆粒稀少的細胞問「單核球白血病還是 APL？」——答 hypogranular APL（M3v）；MPO 強陽性、NSE 陰性是細胞化學關鍵。
表型與遺傳：CD34−、HLA-DR−、CD33 bright、CD11b−；M3v 常見 CD2 表現與 FLT3-ITD。確診 t(15;17)(q24;q21) PML::RARA（FISH/RT-PCR），WHO 5th 不設母細胞門檻。
急症：凝血病變（DIC 合併過度纖溶）易致致命出血；臨床懷疑 APL 就立即給 ATRA，不必等基因結果，並積極補充 cryoprecipitate/血小板。
M3v 常呈高白血球（>10×10⁹/L 屬 Sanz 高風險）；ATRA+arsenic trioxide 為低中風險標準治療，需監測 differentiation syndrome。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常被誤認為急性單核球性白血病；單核系細胞 NSE 陽性、MPO 弱且多為 HLA-DR 陽性，M3v 則 MPO 強陽性、HLA-DR/CD34 陰性並有 PML::RARA。

quiz.q: 周邊血見圖中雙葉蝴蝶狀核、顆粒稀少的細胞，在等待基因結果前應立即開始哪一個藥物？為什麼？
quiz.a: ATRA（all-trans retinoic acid）；懷疑 APL 時立即治療以降低凝血病變導致的早期出血死亡

64137.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一顆巨大的巨核細胞，細胞質豐富，核高度分葉成許多小葉團聚，細胞表面／細胞質內可見數個小型血球穿入（emperiopolesis），右側另一顆巨核細胞亦呈分葉核；大型過度分葉巨核細胞是 ET 的典型表現。
features: Giant megakaryocyte with abundant granular lilac-blue cytoplasm
Hyperlobulated nucleus composed of numerous clustered lobes
Emperiopolesis: small hematopoietic cells overlying or within the megakaryocyte cytoplasm
Second large megakaryocyte with multilobated nucleus and adherent small cells
Background of free platelet granules/platelets, granulocytes, and thick particle material
64137.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a giant megakaryocyte with abundant granular cytoplasm and a markedly hyperlobulated nucleus composed of numerous clustered lobes, with emperiopolesis of small hematopoietic cells. An adjacent large megakaryocyte also shows a multilobated nucleus. Platelets are abundant in the background. Findings are consistent with the large hyperlobulated megakaryocytes of essential thrombocythemia; bone marrow biopsy and JAK2/CALR/MPL testing are needed to exclude other myeloproliferative neoplasms.

ddx.vs: PMF megakaryocytes have hyperchromatic, bulbous, cloud-like nuclei with aberrant N:C ratio, best assessed on biopsy clustering rather than aspirate.
Reactive megakaryocytes are normal in size and lobation without giant hyperlobulated forms.
Osteoclasts have multiple separate uniform round nuclei, and tumor giant cells lack platelet-type granules, unlike a single hyperlobulated megakaryocyte nucleus.

exam.answer_en: Essential thrombocythemia — giant megakaryocyte with markedly hyperlobulated nucleus and emperiopolesis, abundant background platelets
pearls_zh: 考法：抹片指巨大多葉核細胞與胞質內小細胞，問名稱；答 hyperlobulated megakaryocyte 與 emperiopolesis（血球穿行於巨核細胞內，非吞噬）。
Emperiopolesis 本身非特異，反應性與 MPN 皆可見；ET 的診斷重點在巨核細胞大型成熟過度分葉，須以切片評估分布與纖維化。
ET 確診需 JAK2/CALR/MPL 突變或其他 clonal marker，並排除反應性血小板增多（缺鐵、發炎、脾切除後）與 CML（必驗 BCR::ABL1）。
治療以血栓風險分層：高風險（年齡 >60 或血栓史）用 cytoreduction（如 hydroxyurea）加低劑量 aspirin。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤為反應性巨核細胞增生或 CML：反應性巨核細胞形態正常、分葉不過度；CML 巨核細胞偏小（dwarf/micromegakaryocyte）且須驗 BCR::ABL1，血小板增多時不可漏驗。

quiz.q: 巨核細胞胞質內可見其他血球穿行的現象稱為什麼？
quiz.a: Emperiopolesis。

64073.recognize_zh: 多格組圖中，嗜中性球（A–F、H）與一顆嗜酸性球（K）胞質內可見被透明暈圈包住的短桿菌，G、I、J 另見血片背景中成群的游離桿菌；周邊血抹片直接看到細菌，提示高菌量菌血症（本例為 Klebsiella pneumoniae）。
features: Composite of peripheral blood fields (panels A-K), MGG stain, oil immersion
Neutrophils containing short, plump bacilli within clear phagocytic vacuoles; the clear halo suggests a capsule (panels A-F, H)
One eosinophil with coarse orange granules also contains an intracytoplasmic bacillus (panel K)
Extracellular clusters of short basophilic rods lying free among red cells (panels G, I, J)
Neutrophil cytoplasm shows vacuolization; red cells and platelets otherwise unremarkable in these fields
64073.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (composite of high-power fields) shows neutrophils containing short, plump rod-shaped bacteria within clear phagocytic vacuoles, with a surrounding clear halo suggestive of a capsule. A similar intracytoplasmic bacillus is seen within an eosinophil. In addition, small clusters of extracellular bacilli are present between red cells, favoring true bacteremia over contamination introduced during slide preparation when correlated with cultures. Species cannot be determined morphologically; the findings indicate a very high burden of bacteremia with gram-negative-appearing bacilli, consistent with the blood-culture isolate of Klebsiella pneumoniae.

ddx.vs: Precipitate is irregular, lies on top of cells in multiple planes, and lacks the uniform rod shape and intravacuolar location with a halo seen here.
Döhle bodies are pale blue, ill-defined peripheral cytoplasmic patches and toxic vacuoles are empty, whereas here discrete dark rods sit inside the vacuoles.
Morulae are mulberry-like clusters of tiny cocci within a membrane-bound inclusion, not individual encapsulated bacilli, and bacteria are not seen extracellularly.

ddx.dx: Contamination of the specimen or slide
ddx.vs: Contaminant bacteria are usually only extracellular; intracellular phagocytosed organisms with a matching positive blood culture support true bacteremia.

63945.recognize_zh: 數個大型芽細胞，細胞質豐富呈灰藍色、布滿細小打孔狀空泡，核圓或略凹陷、染色質細緻，部分細胞邊緣有偽足狀突起，這是單核球系芽細胞（monoblasts/promonocytes）的典型外觀，符合 KMT2A 重排的單核球性 AML。
features: Large blasts (roughly 2-3 times RBC diameter) with moderate to low N:C ratio
Round to oval, focally indented or folded nuclei with finely dispersed (lacy) chromatin
Abundant gray-blue cytoplasm with numerous small punched-out vacuoles, some rimming the cell edge
Irregular cytoplasmic margins with blebs and pseudopod-like projections
No Auer rods or coarse granules evident; a single small lymphocyte and scattered normal RBCs in the background
63945.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a population of large blasts in a background of red cells. The blasts have round to indented nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin and abundant gray-blue cytoplasm containing numerous small, punched-out vacuoles, with irregular cytoplasmic blebs and pseudopods. Auer rods are not identified. The morphology is that of monoblasts and promonocytes; findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with monocytic differentiation, and in the setting of t(9;11)(p22;q23) are consistent with AML with MLLT3::KMT2A.

ddx.dx: Acute myelomonocytic or monoblastic leukemia without KMT2A rearrangement
ddx.vs: Morphology is indistinguishable, so karyotype or FISH for the KMT2A rearrangement is required to classify the case.
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with sharply defined lipid vacuoles, coarser chromatin and a high N:C ratio rather than gray-blue abundant monocytoid cytoplasm with folded nuclei.
CMML shows mature monocytes with clumped chromatin and <20% blasts plus promonocytes, whereas this field is dominated by immature fine-chromatin monoblasts.
Microgranular APL has bilobed or folded nuclei and strong MPO positivity with PML::RARA, whereas monoblasts are nonspecific esterase positive and MPO weak or negative.

exam.answer_en: AML with t(9;11)(p21.3;q23.3) MLLT3::KMT2A — monoblasts/promonocytes with gray-blue vacuolated cytoplasm and pseudopods
pearls_zh: 考法：辨認芽細胞系別；灰藍色豐富胞質、細小空泡、折疊或凹陷核、偽足突起 → 單核球系（monoblast/promonocyte），再問對應的 KMT2A 重排。
細胞化學與表型：nonspecific esterase（α-naphthyl butyrate）陽性且可被 fluoride 抑制，MPO 常陰性或弱；flow 常見 CD14、CD64、CD11b、CD4 等單核球標記。
臨床：兒童較常見；單核球性 AML 易有牙齦腫大、皮膚浸潤、CNS 侵犯與 DIC；KMT2A 重排急性白血病可考慮 menin inhibitor（如 revumenib）。
分類：WHO 5th 將 AML with KMT2A rearrangement 列為遺傳定義型，不設 20% 芽細胞門檻；ICC 2022 對 recurrent genetic AML 需芽細胞 ≥10%。
exam.pitfall_zh: 單核球系芽細胞的空泡易誤認為 Burkitt 的深藍空泡胞質；Burkitt 胞質深嗜鹼、核圓且 TdT-/CD10+ 屬 B 細胞，單核芽細胞胞質灰藍、核折疊且 NSE 陽性。

quiz.q: 圖中芽細胞屬於哪一系？哪一種細胞化學染色可協助確認？
quiz.a: 單核球系（monoblasts/promonocytes）；nonspecific esterase（可被 sodium fluoride 抑制）

63817.recognize_zh: 拼圖上排是周邊血片：低倍可見白血球極度增多，從骨髓球、後骨髓球到分葉嗜中性球各階段都有，高倍可見一顆顆粒深紫、遮住核的嗜鹼性球，符合慢性骨髓性白血病（CML）慢性期；下排為胸部 X 光的球形擴大心影、病人臉部與心包膜引流管照片，對應 Sanjad-Sakati 症候群與後續心包膜積液。
features: Low-power blood smear (top right): marked leukocytosis with the full spectrum of granulocytic maturation including myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands and segmented neutrophils, and clusters of cells
High-power blood smear (top left): basophil with coarse dark purple granules obscuring the nucleus, with adjacent myelocytes at the edge
No obvious excess of blasts in the smear fields shown; a platelet aggregate is present
Chest radiograph: enlarged globular cardiac silhouette with overlying lines/leads
Clinical photographs: patient face (eyes masked) and abdomen with a subxiphoid drainage catheter and dressing
63817.describe_en: Composite figure. Peripheral blood smears show marked leukocytosis composed of granulocytes at all stages of maturation, with conspicuous myelocytes and metamyelocytes, and a basophil at high power; blasts are not increased in the fields shown. These blood findings are consistent with chronic myeloid leukemia in chronic phase, in keeping with the reported t(9;22) BCR::ABL1 detection. The accompanying chest radiograph shows a globular enlarged cardiac silhouette, and the clinical photographs show the patient and a subxiphoid pericardial drain, correlating with the reported pericardial effusion and tamponade during imatinib therapy.

ddx.vs: A leukemoid reaction shows neutrophilia with toxic granulation and a left shift dominated by bands and metamyelocytes, without absolute basophilia, a myelocyte peak or BCR::ABL1.
Atypical CML shows prominent granulocytic dysplasia without significant basophilia and is BCR::ABL1 negative, often with SETBP1 or ASXL1 mutations.
CNL has mature neutrophils with fewer than 10% circulating precursors, no basophilia, and a CSF3R mutation rather than t(9;22).
Blast phase requires ≥20% blasts in blood or marrow or an extramedullary blast proliferation, which is not seen in these smear fields.

exam.answer_en: Chronic myeloid leukemia, chronic phase — leukocytosis with full granulocytic spectrum, myelocytes and basophilia
pearls_zh: 考法：指顆粒粗大深紫、遮住核的細胞問 basophil；絕對嗜鹼性球增多加上 myelocyte 與分葉球雙峰是 CML 血片關鍵。
確診需證實 t(9;22)(q34;q11) BCR::ABL1（karyotype、FISH 或 RT-PCR）；治療反應以 IS 標準化 qPCR 監測。
WHO 5th 取消 accelerated phase，只分 chronic 與 blast phase；ICC 2022 仍保留 accelerated phase。
下排為胸部 X 光與臨床照片，對應心包膜積液；TKI 相關積液以 dasatinib 最典型，imatinib 較常見水腫與體液滯留。
傳統考點：LAP score 在 CML 降低，在類白血病反應升高。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤判為 leukemoid reaction：後者有毒性顆粒、以 band 為主，無嗜鹼性球增多與 myelocyte 峰，BCR::ABL1 陰性。

quiz.q: 左上高倍圖中顆粒粗大深紫、遮住核的細胞是什麼？
quiz.a: Basophil（CML 慢性期的嗜鹼性球增多）

63753.recognize_zh: 四格染色中，散在的大型非典型細胞 CD30 與 CD15 呈細胞膜加核旁高基氏體（Golgi）點狀陽性，EBER 原位雜交只標在大細胞核上，而 PAX5 在大細胞比周圍小 B 細胞弱；這組「CD30+/CD15+、PAX5 弱陽」是古典何杰金淋巴瘤的典型免疫表型。
features: Scattered large atypical cells in a background of small lymphocytes
CD30: membranous and paranuclear Golgi-dot staining of the large cells
CD15: similar membrane plus Golgi pattern in a subset of the large cells
EBER ISH: dark nuclear signal restricted to scattered large cells
PAX5: weak nuclear staining in the large cells compared with strongly positive small background B cells
63753.describe_en: Immunohistochemical and in situ hybridization studies on a lymph node show scattered large atypical cells in a background of small lymphocytes. The large cells are positive for CD30 and CD15 with membranous and paranuclear Golgi-zone accentuation, and EBER in situ hybridization highlights nuclei of the large atypical cells. PAX5 shows weak nuclear expression in the large cells, dimmer than in the admixed small reactive B cells. This immunophenotype (CD30+, CD15+, dim PAX5+, EBV+) is characteristic of Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells, and the findings support EBV-positive classical Hodgkin lymphoma.

ddx.vs: LP cells are CD30-/CD15-, strongly PAX5/CD20/OCT2+ and EBV negative.
ALCL shows sheets of uniformly strong CD30+ hallmark cells, usually PAX5 negative with T-cell or cytotoxic markers and EBV negative.
These have large cells with strong CD20, PAX5, OCT2 and BOB1 and usually lack CD15.
IM contains numerous EBER+ cells of varying size including small lymphocytes and CD30+ immunoblasts that are CD15 negative with strong B-cell markers, in a preserved architecture.

63753.stain: IHC: CD30, CD15, PAX5; ISH: EBER

exam.answer_en: EBV-positive classical Hodgkin lymphoma — HRS cells CD30+ CD15+ (membrane + Golgi), weak PAX5, EBER+
pearls_zh: 讀法：CD30/CD15 看大細胞的膜加核旁 Golgi 點狀染色；PAX5 看大細胞是否比背景小 B 細胞弱，弱陽是 HRS 細胞的關鍵。
HRS 細胞通常 CD45 陰性、CD20 陰性或弱，B 細胞轉錄因子 OCT2、BOB1 常缺失。
EBER ISH 陽性在 mixed cellularity 與 lymphocyte-depleted 亞型較常見，nodular sclerosis 較少。
治療連結：CD30 為 brentuximab vedotin 標靶；9p24.1 擴增使 PD-L1 高表現，復發 cHL 對 PD-1 抑制劑反應佳。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤判為 ALK-negative ALCL：ALCL 為成片一致強 CD30+、PAX5 陰性並有 T 細胞或細胞毒標記；HRS 為散在大細胞、PAX5 弱陽。

quiz.q: 圖中大細胞的 PAX5 染色強度與背景小 B 細胞相比如何？代表什麼？
quiz.a: 較弱（dim）；支持 HRS 細胞、classical Hodgkin lymphoma

63689.recognize_zh: 成群的大型異常前骨髓球，細胞核呈雙葉或摺疊狀、兩葉互相重疊（sliding-plate / bilobed），細胞質紫色、顆粒細小到幾乎看不見，這是急性前骨髓球性白血病的低顆粒變異型（hypogranular APL）。
features: Large abnormal cells in cohesive-appearing clusters with moderate N:C ratio
Bilobed, folded or reniform nuclei with overlapping lobes (sliding-plate/butterfly shape)
Fine chromatin; nucleoli not prominent
Moderate violet to basophilic cytoplasm with very fine, dust-like granules or apparent agranularity
No obvious Auer rod bundles (faggot cells) in this field
Background red cells with mild crenation; platelets sparse
63689.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows clusters of large abnormal cells with bilobed and folded nuclei whose lobes overlap in a sliding-plate or butterfly configuration. The chromatin is fine, nucleoli are inconspicuous, and the moderate violet cytoplasm appears hypogranular with only very fine dust-like granules. Auer rod bundles are not evident in this field and platelets appear sparse. Findings are highly suggestive of acute promyelocytic leukemia, hypogranular (microgranular) variant; urgent PML::RARA testing and coagulation studies are indicated.

ddx.vs: Monocytic blasts/promonocytes have delicately folded nuclei with gray-blue vacuolated cytoplasm, are MPO weak and NSE positive, and lack PML::RARA.
Cup-like blasts show a single punched-out nuclear invagination rather than bilobed overlapping lobes, and are PML::RARA negative though may be CD34/HLA-DR negative like APL.
Classic APL cells contain dense coarse azurophilic granules obscuring the nucleus with frequent faggot cells, whereas these cells appear nearly agranular.

ddx.dx: Large cell lymphoma / Sézary cells in blood
ddx.vs: Lymphoma cells are MPO negative with lymphoid markers and lack the strong diffuse MPO positivity characteristic of APL.

exam.answer_en: Acute promyelocytic leukemia, hypogranular (microgranular) variant — bilobed sliding-plate/butterfly nuclei with dust-like granules
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指雙葉重疊（sliding-plate）核、顆粒極細的細胞問診斷；答 hypogranular APL，並立刻說「是急症，先查凝血並開始 ATRA」。
遺傳：t(15;17)(q24.1;q21.2) PML::RARA，可用 FISH 或 RT-PCR 快速確認；微顆粒型較常見 bcr3 轉錄本與 FLT3-ITD。
與典型 APL 不同：微顆粒型常以高白血球表現，flow 可有 CD2 與 CD34 表現；但 MPO 仍強陽性，HLA-DR 與 CD11b 陰性。
臨床：DIC 合併高纖溶出血為早期死因，懷疑即給 ATRA 不等確診；低中危以 ATRA + arsenic trioxide 為主，注意分化症候群。白血球 >10×10⁹/L 為高風險。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為急性單核球性白血病：單核球系核摺疊較細緻、NSE 陽性、MPO 弱、HLA-DR/CD11b/CD14 陽性；APL 為蝴蝶形雙葉核、MPO 強陽性、HLA-DR 陰性。

quiz.q: 圖中雙葉重疊核、幾乎無顆粒的細胞提示何診斷？應立即送的確認檢查與急查的實驗室項目為何？
quiz.a: APL 低顆粒（微顆粒）變異型；PML::RARA（FISH/RT-PCR），並急查 PT、aPTT、fibrinogen、D-dimer（DIC）

63625.recognize_zh: 四格骨髓抹片中都可見大型組織球，細胞核小而圓，豐富的淡粉紫色細胞質內散佈大量細長桿狀的紫紅色結構（Auer rods）及顆粒、小球體，周圍是正常形態的造血細胞，符合 APL 經 ATRA/ATO 治療後被組織球吞噬的 Auer 小體。
features: Large histiocytes with a small round to oval central nucleus and abundant pale pink-violet cytoplasm
Numerous slender, needle-like reddish-purple rods (Auer rods) scattered within histiocyte cytoplasm, most evident in the upper right and lower right panels
Additional coarse granules and globular debris within the histiocyte cytoplasm (upper left and lower left panels)
Surrounding hematopoietic cells show normal-appearing maturing myeloid and erythroid precursors
No abnormal hypergranular promyelocytes or faggot cells seen in these fields
63625.describe_en: Four-panel composite of a bone marrow aspirate shows scattered large histiocytes with small round nuclei and abundant pale cytoplasm containing numerous slender needle-like Auer rods, together with coarse granules and globular phagocytic debris. The background hematopoietic cells show normal-appearing maturation, and no abnormal promyelocytes or faggot cells are identified in these fields. Findings are consistent with phagocytosed Auer rods and granular debris in histiocytes following ATRA/arsenic trioxide therapy for acute promyelocytic leukemia; this phenomenon alone does not indicate residual disease, which should be assessed by PML::RARA RT-PCR.

ddx.vs: Residual disease shows abnormal promyelocytes with their own nucleus and bundles of Auer rods in the cell cytoplasm, whereas here the rods lie within histiocytes with bland nuclei.
Pseudo-Gaucher cells have fibrillary 'crumpled tissue paper' cytoplasm without discrete needle-like rods and are seen in CML or myeloma.
Sea-blue histiocytes contain blue-green lipid granules rather than reddish-purple needle-shaped rods.
Charcot-Leyden crystals are larger bipyramidal eosinophilic crystals associated with eosinophils, not slender azurophilic rods.

63561.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片羽狀邊緣出現遠大於周圍紅血球的巨大細胞，胞質豐富、細胞核偏心且呈顆粒狀（C、E 圖），加上 buffy coat 切片中具核內包涵體的巨大細胞（D 圖），在嚴重免疫抑制病人應想到循環中的 CMV 感染細胞（cytomegalic cells）。
features: Very large cells (several times the diameter of adjacent red cells) at the feathered edge of the smear
Single eccentric oval nucleus with coarse granular chromatin, suggestive of nuclear inclusion (panels C and E)
Abundant cytoplasm, pale-staining in panels B-C and pale lilac in panel E, with irregular scalloped cell border
Low-power view (panel A) shows the large cells trapped in the thin feathered edge, easily overlooked on routine scanning
Cell block of buffy coat (panel D) shows an enlarged cell with a large intranuclear inclusion and perinuclear clearing (owl's-eye-like)
Pale, faded staining in panels A-D limits assessment of cytoplasmic granules
63561.describe_en: Composite figure: panels A, B, C and E are peripheral blood smears and panel D is a cell block of the buffy coat. At low power (A), rare very large cells are concentrated at the feathered edge; at high power (B, C, E) these cells measure several times the size of adjacent erythrocytes and have abundant cytoplasm with an irregular border and a single eccentric oval nucleus with coarse, granular chromatin suggestive of an inclusion. The buffy coat cell block (D) shows an isolated enlarged cell with an intranuclear inclusion surrounded by a clear halo. The staining in several panels is faded, limiting evaluation of cytoplasmic granularity. In an immunocompromised patient, findings are consistent with circulating cytomegalovirus-infected (cytomegalic, likely endothelial) cells, supported by CMV DNA detection.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes have multilobated or naked hyperchromatic nuclei with platelet-type granular cytoplasm, whereas these cells have a single oval nucleus containing an inclusion; CD61 or CMV IHC/PCR resolves difficult cases.

ddx.dx: Circulating carcinoma or other malignant cells
ddx.vs: Tumor cells usually occur in cohesive clusters with high N:C ratio and prominent nucleoli rather than solitary cells with a single large intranuclear viral inclusion.

ddx.dx: Endothelial cells or squamous contaminants from venipuncture
ddx.vs: Contaminating endothelial or squamous cells are flat with small bland nuclei and no nuclear inclusion or cytomegaly.

63497.recognize_zh: 這是上腹部電腦斷層軸切面：箭頭所指處在前腹壁下、肝臟前方有數個黑色（空氣密度）小氣泡，不在腸道內，代表腹腔游離氣體（pneumoperitoneum）；在淋巴瘤病人需想到腸道穿孔。
features: Axial CT of the upper abdomen with oral contrast opacifying the stomach
Small non-dependent pockets of extraluminal gas anterior to the liver beneath the anterior abdominal wall (arrow)
Gas lies outside the bowel lumen, indicating free intraperitoneal air
Enlarged liver occupying much of the upper abdomen
Distended gas-filled stomach with high-density contrast material
63497.describe_en: Axial CT image of the upper abdomen shows small non-dependent collections of gas anterior to the liver beneath the anterior abdominal wall, outside the bowel lumen (arrow), consistent with pneumoperitoneum. The liver appears enlarged, and the stomach is distended with gas and dense oral contrast. This is a radiologic image and has no cellular morphology; in a patient with large B-cell lymphoma, free air raises concern for bowel perforation from transmural lymphoma or treatment-related tumor necrosis.

ddx.vs: Iatrogenic free air is explained by the procedure history and is not accompanied by clinical peritonitis.
Gas is located within the bowel wall in a linear or bubbly pattern rather than free in the peritoneal cavity.
Gas between liver and diaphragm/abdominal wall is contained within haustrated colon rather than free non-dependent pockets.

63433.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指紅血球內有一個形狀不規則、帶紫色染色質點的滋養體（trophozoite），旁邊另一顆紅血球含散在的棕黑色瘧色素顆粒，符合間日瘧（P. vivax）變形蟲樣滋養體（amoeboid form）；但影像失焦、放大倍率受限。
features: Intraerythrocytic parasite (arrow) with irregular, ameboid-appearing blue cytoplasm and a magenta chromatin dot
Adjacent red cell containing scattered fine brown-black hemozoin pigment granules, consistent with a more mature trophozoite
Parasitized cells do not show clearly resolvable Schüffner dots due to focus and resolution
Background red cells without obvious multiple ring forms or banana-shaped gametocytes
Out-of-focus image with refractile debris/artifact limiting assessment of red cell enlargement
63433.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows intraerythrocytic malarial parasites. The arrowed red cell contains a trophozoite with irregular, ameboid cytoplasm and a chromatin dot, and a neighboring red cell contains a trophozoite with scattered brown hemozoin pigment. Enlargement of infected red cells and Schüffner stippling cannot be reliably assessed because the image is out of focus. Findings are consistent with Plasmodium vivax amoeboid trophozoites in the stated clinical context; species confirmation by thick/thin film review or PCR is recommended.

ddx.vs: P. ovale trophozoites are compact rather than ameboid and infect oval red cells with fimbriated edges and prominent James dots.
P. falciparum shows multiple small delicate rings, appliqué forms and crescent gametocytes in normal-sized red cells, with mature trophozoites rarely seen in peripheral blood.
P. malariae trophozoites form compact band shapes with coarse pigment in normal-sized or small red cells without stippling.

ddx.dx: Platelet overlying a red cell / stain precipitate
ddx.vs: A superimposed platelet lies in a different focal plane, lacks a distinct chromatin dot with cytoplasm and has no hemozoin pigment.

exam.answer_en: Plasmodium vivax amoeboid trophozoite — irregular intraerythrocytic parasite with chromatin dot and fine hemozoin pigment
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指形狀不規則的滋養體問種別；變形蟲樣（amoeboid）細胞質是 P. vivax 滋養體的特徵，搭配紅血球增大與 Schüffner dots。
瘧色素（hemozoin）為寄生蟲消化血紅素的產物，棕黑色顆粒可幫助區分瘧原蟲與 Babesia 或血小板重疊。
P. ovale 的感染紅血球呈卵圓形並常有鋸齒緣（fimbriated）；P. malariae 滋養體呈帶狀（band form），紅血球不增大。
P. vivax 可引起重症（如嚴重貧血、脾破裂），並非一律良性；根治 hypnozoite 前須檢測 G6PD。
exam.pitfall_zh: 此圖失焦時易把血小板重疊或折光假影當成滋養體；真正寄生蟲有藍色細胞質＋紫紅染色質點並位於紅血球內平面，常伴瘧色素。

quiz.q: 圖中形狀不規則、細胞質呈偽足狀的滋養體，是哪一種瘧原蟲的特徵？
quiz.a: P. vivax（amoeboid trophozoite）

63305.recognize_zh: 兩格視野各有一顆胞質呈泡沫狀、多空泡的巨噬細胞，胞質內可見數顆已被消化、深染縮小的細胞核殘骸位於吞噬體（phagosome）中，代表骨髓巨噬細胞正在消化被吞噬的細胞。
features: Macrophage with abundant pale, foamy, vacuolated cytoplasm and irregular cell border
Round eccentric nucleus with fine chromatin and a small nucleolus
Multiple small, dense, pyknotic nuclear remnants of ingested cells within cytoplasmic phagosomes
Occasional clear vacuoles adjacent to the ingested material
Background of red cells; panel A shows drying artifact with refractile central inclusions in erythrocytes
63305.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at 100x (panels A and B) shows isolated macrophages with abundant foamy, vacuolated cytoplasm and bland round nuclei. Each contains several small, dense, condensed nuclear remnants of phagocytosed cells within cytoplasmic phagosomes, representing late-stage digestion of ingested hematopoietic cells. The background red cells in panel A show drying artifact. Findings demonstrate hemophagocytosis with intracellular digestion; clinical and laboratory correlation is required before attributing this to hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis.

ddx.vs: Tingible body macrophages contain apoptotic nuclear debris of variable size from local cell turnover rather than recognizable whole ingested cells, a distinction that becomes difficult once digestion is advanced.
Storage cells have uniformly bubbly lipid-laden cytoplasm without ingested nuclear remnants.
Hemosiderin appears as coarse blue-black to golden granules confirmed by Prussian blue, not as round condensed nuclei within phagosomes.

63241.recognize_zh: 單一漿細胞樣細胞，深染的偏心核佔去大半，周邊胞質排滿一圈大小一致的圓形小體，各有透亮暈環與偏心深色點。作者判讀為 Snapper-Schneid 顆粒，但在此解析度下必須與胞內酵母菌（如 Histoplasma）鑑別。
features: Single mononuclear cell larger than adjacent red cells with an eccentric, dark, condensed nucleus occupying much of the cell
Peripheral cytoplasmic rim packed with numerous uniform round inclusions about 2-3 um across
Inclusions show a clear halo/ring outline with a dark eccentric dot or crescent, rather than fine dust-like azurophilic granules
Perinuclear hof and clock-face chromatin not discernible at this resolution
Adjacent red cells without specific abnormality; a small platelet at lower left
63241.describe_en: Blood smear shows a single mononuclear cell with an eccentric, dark, condensed nucleus and a rim of cytoplasm filled with numerous uniform round inclusions. The inclusions have a clear halo with a dark eccentric dot or crescent, rather than the fine azurophilic granules usually expected. The submitted interpretation is Snapper-Schneid granules (lysosomal azurophilic granules) in a plasma cell; however, the image resolution does not allow confident identification of the host cell as a plasma cell, and the halo-and-dot appearance overlaps with intracellular yeasts such as Histoplasma capsulatum or Talaromyces marneffei. Review of additional fields and, if doubt remains, GMS/PAS staining or culture is recommended before accepting this as a plasma cell with azurophilic granules.

ddx.vs: Yeasts are 2-4 um oval bodies with a crescent of basophilic chromatin inside a clear halo (Talaromyces with a central septum), are GMS/PAS positive and usually sit in monocytes or neutrophils rather than plasma cells.
Russell bodies are larger, homogeneous pale blue to pink immunoglobulin globules without a central dark dot.
Crystals are angular, rod- or needle-shaped rather than round ringed bodies.
These are few, large, irregular azurophilic or pink granules in granulocytes, typically in AML/MDS, not uniform ring-like bodies.

63177.recognize_zh: 骨髓中大量紅血球前驅細胞體積變大、染色質呈篩網狀開放而細胞質已深藍或偏粉紅（核質發育不同步），並見多核紅血球母細胞與核呈馬蹄形的巨大後骨髓細胞（giant metamyelocyte，箭頭與插圖），是巨母紅血球性造血的典型表現。
features: Hypercellular aspirate with marked erythroid hyperplasia composed of enlarged erythroblasts
Erythroid precursors with open, sieve-like (stippled) chromatin disproportionate to cytoplasmic maturation (nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony)
Deeply basophilic to polychromatic cytoplasm in erythroblasts; occasional multinucleated erythroblast
Giant metamyelocytes/bands with large horseshoe-shaped nuclei and fine granular cytoplasm (arrows, inset)
Background of macrocytic red cells and scattered granulocytic cells
63177.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a hypercellular specimen with marked erythroid hyperplasia. The erythroid precursors are enlarged with open, finely stippled sieve-like chromatin and relatively mature cytoplasm, reflecting nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony; a multinucleated erythroblast is present. Giant metamyelocytes with large horseshoe-shaped nuclei are also seen (arrows and inset). No increase in blasts or abnormal infiltrate is evident. Findings are consistent with megaloblastic hematopoiesis, in keeping with vitamin B12 and folate deficiency.

ddx.vs: MDS may show megaloblastoid erythroids but also has ring sideroblasts, hypolobated/hypogranular neutrophils or dysplastic megakaryocytes and does not correct with vitamin replacement.
Pure erythroid leukemia shows >80% erythroid cells with >=30% proerythroblasts, highly atypical and often TP53-mutated, rather than a full maturation spectrum.
Morphology is identical; drug history and normal B12/folate levels distinguish it.

exam.answer_en: Megaloblastic hematopoiesis (B12/folate deficiency) — erythroid precursors with nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony and giant metamyelocytes
pearls_zh: 考法：考官常指插圖中馬蹄形大核的細胞問名稱（giant metamyelocyte），或指紅系前驅細胞問「核質發育不同步」代表什麼。
B12 vs folate：兩者 homocysteine 皆上升，methylmalonic acid 上升只見於 B12 缺乏；B12 臨界值時 MMA 有助確認。
B12 缺乏可致 subacute combined degeneration；未排除 B12 缺乏前單給 folate 可改善血液學卻讓神經病變惡化。
無效造血（骨髓內溶血）造成 LDH 顯著上升、間接膽紅素升高與 haptoglobin 降低；補充治療初期要監測低血鉀。
惡性貧血檢驗：anti-intrinsic factor antibody 特異性高，anti-parietal cell antibody 敏感但特異性低。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤判為 MDS 或 pure erythroid leukemia；MDS 另有環狀鐵粒母細胞、低分葉嗜中性球或異常巨核細胞且補充維生素無效，此片為完整成熟譜系且有 giant metamyelocyte。

quiz.q: 插圖中核呈馬蹄形、體積明顯變大的顆粒球系細胞叫什麼？代表何種造血異常？
quiz.a: Giant metamyelocyte；megaloblastic hematopoiesis（B12/folate deficiency）

63113.recognize_zh: 低倍下左側為脾被膜與白髓濾泡，右側為相對分界清楚的病灶，由許多充滿血液、彼此吻合的囊狀血管腔與乳頭狀突起組成；位於脾實質內的這種海綿狀血管病灶是 littoral cell angioma 的低倍樣貌。
features: Splenic capsule (left edge) and a white pulp lymphoid follicle for orientation
Adjacent vascular lesion composed of anastomosing, cystic, blood-filled channels
Papillary projections and irregular septa within the dilated spaces
Congested red pulp between the follicle and the lesion
Lesion relatively circumscribed; no solid sheets or necrosis at this power
63113.describe_en: Low-power section of spleen shows the capsule and a white pulp follicle adjacent to a relatively circumscribed vascular lesion. The lesion consists of anastomosing, cystically dilated blood-filled channels with papillary projections and thin septa. No solid growth or necrosis is identified at this magnification. Findings are consistent with littoral cell angioma, in conjunction with the immunophenotype.

ddx.vs: Cavernous hemangioma has thin-walled spaces lined by flat endothelium without papillary tufts of plump lining cells.
SANT shows multiple angiomatoid nodules separated by dense fibrosclerotic bands with a concentric architecture.
Peliosis has blood-filled cavities without a lining of plump papillary cells and without a discrete neoplasm.
Angiosarcoma shows infiltrative borders, solid areas and cytologic atypia.

63049.recognize_zh: A 圖淋巴結中上方殘存小淋巴球濾泡，下方副皮質區則被中到大型、染色質開放、核仁明顯的母細胞成片取代，並夾雜帶紅色顆粒的未成熟嗜伊紅球；B 圖 MPO 與 C 圖 CD34 強陽性，確認為髓性肉瘤。
features: Panel A (H&E): sheet of medium to large blasts with irregular vesicular nuclei, open chromatin, distinct nucleoli and moderate pale eosinophilic cytoplasm
Residual follicle of small dark lymphocytes (upper field) sharply demarcated from the interfollicular/paracortical blast infiltrate
Scattered immature eosinophils with bright red granules and apoptotic bodies among the blasts
Panel B: diffuse strong granular cytoplasmic MPO positivity in the blasts
Panel C: diffuse membranous/cytoplasmic CD34 positivity in the blasts, with CD34+ endothelium in a vessel wall
63049.describe_en: Lymph node biopsy shows effacement of the paracortex by a diffuse infiltrate of medium to large blasts with irregular vesicular nuclei, open chromatin, distinct nucleoli and moderate eosinophilic cytoplasm, sparing a residual lymphoid follicle. Scattered immature eosinophils and apoptotic bodies are admixed. By immunohistochemistry the blasts are diffusely positive for myeloperoxidase and CD34. Findings are consistent with myeloid sarcoma (extramedullary myeloid tumor) involving lymph node; bone marrow evaluation and molecular studies (including NPM1) are recommended.

ddx.vs: DLBCL cells are CD20/PAX5 positive and MPO/CD34 negative, and lack admixed immature eosinophils.
Lymphoblasts have finer chromatin, scant cytoplasm and are TdT+ with CD3 or CD19/PAX5 and MPO negative.

ddx.dx: Classic Hodgkin lymphoma or anaplastic large cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: These show CD30+ Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg or hallmark cells within a mixed background, not MPO+ CD34+ monotonous blast sheets.
BPDCN is CD4+, CD56+, CD123+, TCF4+ and MPO negative, typically presenting in skin.

exam.answer_en: Myeloid sarcoma of lymph node — paracortical sheets of blasts with admixed immature eosinophils, diffusely MPO- and CD34-positive
pearls_zh: 考法：A 圖考官指成片大細胞中帶紅色顆粒的未成熟嗜伊紅球作為髓系線索，再給 MPO 與 CD34 染色要你下診斷：myeloid sarcoma。
IHC panel：MPO、lysozyme、CD34、CD117、CD33、CD68/CD163（單核球分化時）；CD34 可陰性，特別是單核球型或 NPM1 突變者，應加做 NPM1 c 染色或分子。
即使骨髓無侵犯，髓性肉瘤在分類上等同 AML 診斷，應以全身性 AML 治療，並做骨髓評估、核型與分子檢查。
常見相關遺傳異常：t(8;21)、inv(16)、NPM1 突變、KMT2A 重組與單核球分化型 AML；亦可為 MDS/MPN 轉化的表現。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常被誤診為 DLBCL 或淋巴母細胞淋巴瘤；淋巴結大細胞成片浸潤時務必把 MPO、CD34、CD117、lysozyme 加入初始 panel。

quiz.q: 淋巴結 blast 浸潤中若只做 CD20、CD3 皆陰性，要確認此病變最關鍵的 IHC 為何？
quiz.a: MPO（加 CD34、CD117、lysozyme）；診斷 myeloid sarcoma

62985.recognize_zh: 低倍下淋巴結被膜仍在，但正常皮髓質結構部分消失：濾泡間區擴大、竇道擴張，只剩少數小濾泡，並散在淡染的圓形結節，提示淋巴結被浸潤性病變（此病例為系統性肥大細胞增生症）部分取代。
features: Partial effacement of nodal architecture with expanded interfollicular/paracortical areas
Dilated, patent sinuses forming a reticulated pattern throughout the node
Few scattered small lymphoid follicles, some with small germinal centers
Scattered pale, rounded nodules of pale-staining cells within the node
Intact capsule with perinodal adipose tissue; no capsular breach evident at this power
62985.describe_en: Low-power H&E section of a lymph node shows an intact capsule with perinodal fat and partial effacement of the normal architecture. The interfollicular areas are expanded, the sinuses are dilated, and only a few small follicles with germinal centers remain. Scattered pale-staining rounded nodules are present within the parenchyma; their cellular composition cannot be resolved at this magnification. In the context of systemic mastocytosis, findings are suggestive of nodal involvement and warrant tryptase, CD117 and CD25 immunostains.

ddx.vs: Reactive hyperplasia preserves sinuses and lacks aggregates of spindled CD117+/CD25+ mast cells on IHC.
Hodgkin lymphoma shows Reed-Sternberg cells that are CD30+/CD15+ in a mixed inflammatory background rather than tryptase-positive mast cell aggregates.
Rosai-Dorfman disease shows markedly distended sinuses filled with large S100+ histiocytes with emperipolesis, rather than interfollicular mast cell infiltrates.
PTCL shows sheets of atypical T-cells with aberrant antigen loss and clonal TCR rearrangement, which mast cell infiltrates lack.

62921.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片右上與右下各有一個小而深染圓核的有核紅血球，中央為一個淋巴球，背景紅血球大小不均且有標靶細胞、鋸齒狀細胞、淚滴與碎片；周邊血出現 NRBC 加上嚴重異形紅血球，符合重型乙型地中海貧血。
features: Nucleated red blood cells with small dense round nuclei at upper and lower right
Small dark round nucleated cell left of center (NRBC versus small lymphocyte)
Lymphocyte with moderately condensed chromatin in the center
Marked anisopoikilocytosis with target cells, echinocytes, teardrop cells, and fragments
Hypochromic microcytes with irregular central pallor; scattered platelets
62921.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked anisopoikilocytosis with hypochromic microcytes, target cells, echinocytes, teardrop cells, and fragmented red cells. Nucleated red blood cells with small dense nuclei are present at the right side of the field, and a lymphocyte is seen centrally. The image is slightly blurred. Findings are consistent with beta-thalassemia major; NRBCs should be enumerated and used to correct the automated WBC count.

ddx.vs: Lymphocytes have a thin rim of blue cytoplasm and less pyknotic chromatin, whereas orthochromatic NRBCs have a very dense nucleus within pink hemoglobinized cytoplasm.
Hb H disease shows target cells and microcytosis but fewer NRBCs, with golf-ball inclusions on supravital stain.
MAHA shows schistocytes with thrombocytopenia but lacks prominent microcytic target cells.

62857.recognize_zh: 網狀纖維銀染色下，骨小樑（棕色）之間與周圍布滿密集交織的黑色網狀纖維，並包圍數個淡染、未著色的圓形結晶沉積結節，顯示草酸鈣沉積伴隨明顯骨髓網狀纖維增生。
features: Dense, coarse network of black reticulin fibers throughout the marrow space
Increased fibers along the surfaces of bony trabeculae (peritrabecular) and around nodules
Large pale, unstained rounded areas with faint radiating texture corresponding to crystal deposits
Bony trabeculae stained golden brown
Hematopoietic cells largely absent from the field
62857.describe_en: Reticulin silver stain of the bone marrow trephine shows a markedly increased, dense and intersecting network of reticulin fibers occupying the marrow space, accentuated along trabecular surfaces and around several large pale, unstained nodules with a faint radiating texture that correspond to crystal deposits. The bony trabeculae stain golden brown, and hematopoietic tissue is largely absent. The fibrosis appears marked (approximately MF-2 to MF-3), although collagen deposition requires a trichrome stain to assess. Findings are consistent with secondary marrow fibrosis associated with calcium oxalate deposition (oxalosis).

ddx.vs: PMF shows diffuse reticulin fibrosis with atypical megakaryocytic clusters and no crystal-filled nodules.
Fibrosis surrounds cohesive tumor nests that are cytokeratin positive on immunostaining rather than acellular crystal deposits.
HCL shows diffuse fine reticulin fibrosis around infiltrating CD20/annexin A1/BRAF V600E-positive cells, producing a dry tap.

62729.recognize_zh: 高倍 H&E 下成熟脂肪細胞之間的纖細間質中，夾有小型深染圓核的紅血球前驅細胞、帶顆粒胞質的骨髓系細胞，以及少數較大、核較開放的細胞，顯示脂肪組織內含多系造血細胞，符合腎上腺骨髓脂肪瘤。
features: Large empty adipocyte vacuoles separated by thin hematopoietic cords
Small round cells with dense, dark nuclei consistent with late erythroid precursors
Cells with eosinophilic granular cytoplasm and segmented or band-like nuclei consistent with maturing granulocytes
Occasional larger cells with vesicular nuclei and moderate cytoplasm (immature hematopoietic cells or megakaryocytic forms)
Admixed red cells and delicate capillaries; no atypical stromal cells or lipoblasts
62729.describe_en: Higher-power section shows mature adipocytes separated by thin cords of hematopoietic tissue. The cords contain small erythroid precursors with dark round nuclei, maturing granulocytic cells with eosinophilic granular cytoplasm, and occasional larger cells with vesicular nuclei, together with red cells and delicate capillaries. There are no lipoblasts or cytologically atypical stromal cells. Findings are consistent with the hematopoietic component of an adrenal myelolipoma.

ddx.vs: Shows atypical hyperchromatic stromal cells and lipoblasts in fibrous septa rather than maturing erythroid and granulocytic precursors.
Morphologically the hematopoietic cells are identical, but EMH arises in the setting of marrow failure or hemoglobinopathy and lacks a discrete fat-predominant encapsulated mass.
Contains foamy histiocytes, lipid cysts and mixed inflammatory cells rather than orderly maturing erythroid and myeloid precursors.

62665.recognize_zh: 整個淋巴結低倍 HHV8 染色中，棕色陽性細胞沿著被膜下竇與髓質竇（sinusoidal pattern）分布，濾泡與皮質副皮質區則為陰性，顯示腫瘤以竇內浸潤為主。
features: Scanning view of a lymph node with preserved follicles and capsule
HHV8-positive cells clustered within subcapsular and medullary/intermediate sinuses
Follicles and paracortex largely HHV8-negative
Discontinuous, patchy sinusoidal distribution of positive cell clusters
Nuclear detail not resolvable at this magnification
62665.describe_en: Low-power HHV8 (LANA-1) immunohistochemistry of a lymph node shows partially preserved architecture with residual follicles and an intact capsule. Clusters of HHV8-positive cells are distributed predominantly within the subcapsular and intranodal sinuses, whereas follicles and paracortex are negative. Individual nuclear staining patterns cannot be resolved at this magnification. Findings demonstrate a sinusoidal pattern of involvement by HHV8-positive cells, consistent with extracavitary primary effusion lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Characteristically sinusoidal but HHV8-negative.
HHV8-positive cells are scattered plasmablasts in the mantle zones of regressed follicles, not sinus clusters.
Sinusoidal metastases are HHV8-negative and express epithelial or melanocytic markers.

62601.recognize_zh: 這是數位切片瀏覽器截圖的 CD56 染色：腫瘤細胞群不著色，只見零星小型陽性細胞與纖細基質結構著色，與同病例另一張 CD56 圖相同，表示腫瘤 CD56 陰性。
features: Screenshot of a whole-slide viewer (toolbar at left, slide panel at top right)
Sheets of tumor cells with round nuclei, negative for CD56
Rare scattered small CD56-positive cells with membranous staining
Faint staining of thin spindled stromal/neural processes
Same field as the companion CD56 image of this case
62601.describe_en: CD56 immunohistochemistry, captured from a digital slide viewer, shows the neoplastic plasma cell infiltrate to be negative, with only rare scattered positive cells and faint staining of delicate stromal processes. The field duplicates the other CD56 image from this case. Absence of aberrant CD56 on the tumor cells is in keeping with EBV-positive plasmacytoma-like post-transplant lymphoproliferative disorder rather than favoring conventional plasma cell myeloma.

ddx.vs: Myeloma plasma cells are CD56-positive in the majority of cases, whereas the tumor here is negative, though negativity alone does not exclude it.
NK/T-cell lymphoma is diffusely CD56-positive and EBER-positive, not CD56-negative.

62537.recognize_zh: 這是 G 顯帶核型圖，男性（XY），第 7 號染色體位置只有一條，箭頭指出缺少的另一條，即 45,XY,-7（monosomy 7）；在兒童骨髓衰竭中出現 monosomy 7 支持 MDS（如 RCC），並提示進展風險高。
features: G-banded karyotype arranged 1-22, X, Y (male)
Single chromosome 7 with arrow marking the absent homolog
All other autosomes present in pairs without obvious structural rearrangement at this resolution
Interpretation: 45,XY,-7
62537.describe_en: G-banded karyogram from a male shows 45 chromosomes with loss of one chromosome 7 (arrow), and no other numerical or apparent structural abnormality at this band resolution. A clonal loss requires identification of the same monosomy in at least three metaphases. The karyotype is interpreted as 45,XY,-7. In a child with cytopenias and a hypocellular or dysplastic marrow, monosomy 7 supports myelodysplastic neoplasm such as refractory cytopenia of childhood and indicates a high risk of progression, warranting evaluation for GATA2 or SAMD9/SAMD9L germline predisposition.

ddx.vs: A 7q deletion shows two chromosome 7 homologs with one shortened long arm rather than a missing whole chromosome.
Artifactual chromosome loss is seen in isolated metaphases, whereas clonal monosomy must be present in at least three metaphases.
Monosomy 7 in children can be acquired on a germline predisposition background, which requires germline testing rather than karyotype to identify.

exam.answer_en: Karyotype 45,XY,-7 (monosomy 7) — supports childhood MDS (refractory cytopenia of childhood) over aplastic anemia
pearls_zh: 判讀：G-banding 核型依大小與帶型排列 1–22、X、Y；數每對染色體數目，本例第 7 號只有一條，以 ISCN 寫作 45,XY,-7。
臨床意義：兒童骨髓衰竭若出現 monosomy 7，傾向克隆性 MDS 而非 severe aplastic anemia，進展為 AML 風險高，通常建議造血幹細胞移植。
胚系體質：兒童 monosomy 7 要想到 GATA2 deficiency、SAMD9/SAMD9L 等胚系異常，移植前應評估，家屬捐贈者也需篩檢。
WHO 5th 將 refractory cytopenia of childhood 改稱 childhood MDS with low blasts（hypocellular 亞型最常見）；診斷仍需骨髓形態支持。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把 X 染色體與第 7 號混淆而數錯：兩者大小相近，需依帶型辨認；男性核型只有一條 X，若誤把 X 放進 7 號位置，就會漏看 monosomy 7。

quiz.q: 請寫出此核型的 ISCN 表示法。

62473.recognize_zh: 背部臨床照片可見大範圍、幾乎融合的深紫褐色色素沉著斑塊，局部皮膚苔蘚化並有細屑，界線不清且分布廣泛，符合蕈狀肉芽腫斑塊期至紅皮症樣的皮膚表現（深色膚色中紅斑常呈紫褐色）。
features: Clinical photograph of the back showing extensive, near-confluent involvement
Ill-defined dusky violaceous to dark brown hyperpigmented patches and thin plaques
Areas of lichenification with fine scale, including paraspinal and lower back regions
Scattered small lighter, hypopigmented-appearing zones between patches
No discrete exophytic tumors or ulcerations
62473.describe_en: Clinical photograph of the back shows extensive, ill-defined, near-confluent dusky violaceous-brown patches and thin plaques with areas of lichenification and fine scale, interspersed with small lighter areas. No tumors or ulcers are evident. In darkly pigmented skin, erythema of patch/plaque or erythrodermic disease often appears violaceous or hyperpigmented rather than red. This is a clinical image and is nonspecific by itself; in this context it is compatible with widespread cutaneous mycosis fungoides approaching erythroderma.

ddx.vs: Eczema is typically pruritic with flexural predominance and biopsy shows spongiosis without epidermotropic atypical lymphocytes or a clonal T-cell population.

ddx.dx: Drug eruption or erythroderma due to other causes (psoriasis, PRP)
ddx.vs: Other erythrodermas lack Sezary cells, CD4:CD8 >10, and CD7/CD26 loss on blood flow cytometry.
Postinflammatory pigmentation is flat without active scale or induration and shows only dermal melanophages on biopsy.
Tinea shows annular lesions with an active scaly border and hyphae on KOH preparation or PAS stain.

62409.recognize_zh: 高倍下骨髓中一片小型淋巴球為主的浸潤，核圓、染色質濃密，其間夾雜細胞質較多、核偏位的漿細胞樣淋巴球與漿細胞，並散在含棕色含鐵血黃素的巨噬細胞——小淋巴球加漿細胞分化的組合即淋巴漿細胞淋巴瘤的形態。
features: Sheet of small lymphoid cells with round nuclei, condensed chromatin and scant cytoplasm
Admixed plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with eccentric nuclei and amphophilic cytoplasm
Occasional slightly larger cells with more open chromatin, but no sheets of large cells
Scattered hemosiderin-laden macrophages with golden-brown pigment
Adjacent fat spaces and a congested vessel at the upper right
62409.describe_en: High-power view of a bone marrow core biopsy (H&E) shows a dense infiltrate of small lymphocytes with round nuclei and condensed chromatin, admixed with plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells showing eccentric nuclei and amphophilic cytoplasm. Scattered hemosiderin-laden macrophages are present. Occasional slightly larger cells are seen, but there are no sheets of large transformed cells, and mitotic activity is not conspicuous. Findings are consistent with a low-grade B-cell lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation, compatible with lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma.

ddx.vs: CLL/SLL shows proliferation centers with prolymphocytes and paraimmunoblasts and is CD5/CD23-positive without a clonal plasma cell component.
MZL cells often have more pale cytoplasm (monocytoid) and overlap morphologically, so MYD88 L265P and clinical IgM paraprotein aid separation.
Myeloma consists of plasma cells without a significant small B-lymphocyte component and shows CD19-negative aberrant plasma cells.
Mantle cell lymphoma is monotonous with slightly irregular nuclei, lacks plasma cells, and is cyclin D1/SOX11-positive.

62345.recognize_zh: 高倍下脂肪細胞之間是一片大型細胞，細胞質豐富偏嗜雙色、核偏位、染色質呈泡狀並可見核仁，旁邊有小而深染的紅血球前驅細胞與左側一顆巨核細胞作對照，符合退行性（anaplastic）漿細胞。
features: Large atypical cells with abundant amphophilic to eosinophilic cytoplasm
Round to oval, often eccentric nuclei with vesicular chromatin and visible nucleoli
Some binucleated forms and moderate nuclear pleomorphism
Cells form a cohesive-appearing sheet between adipocytes
Few small dark erythroid precursors and a megakaryocyte at the left edge for size comparison
62345.describe_en: High-power view of the bone marrow biopsy shows a sheet of large atypical cells between adipocytes. The cells have abundant amphophilic cytoplasm, eccentric round to oval nuclei with vesicular chromatin and distinct nucleoli, with occasional binucleation. Rare residual erythroid precursors and a megakaryocyte at the left margin are present. Classic clock-face chromatin and perinuclear hofs are not prominent, so immunohistochemistry (CD138, kappa/lambda) is needed to confirm lineage. Findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma with anaplastic/plasmablastic cytology.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma cells form true glandular or cohesive nests and are cytokeratin-positive, whereas these cells are CD138/MUM1-positive and cytokeratin-negative plasma cells.
DLBCL cells express CD20/PAX5 and lack the abundant eccentric cytoplasm and CD138/light-chain restricted cytoplasmic immunoglobulin of plasma cells.
Plasmablastic lymphoma shares the CD138+/CD20- phenotype but typically occurs extramedullary in immunocompromised patients, is often EBER-positive, and lacks M-protein/lytic bone disease.
Megakaryocytes are much larger with lobulated nuclei and granular cytoplasm, as seen in the single megakaryocyte at the left edge, unlike the uniform round eccentric nuclei of plasma cells.

62281.recognize_zh: IgD 染色在大型結節內呈深棕色的網狀／斑塊分布，陽性套層細胞穿插其中，把淡染的生發中心切成許多小碎片，右側另有邊界清楚的小濾泡，支持 PTGC 的套層細胞內侵。
features: Large irregular nodule with IgD-positive small B cells forming a coarse reticulated/patchy network
Numerous small IgD-negative pale islands (germinal center fragments) scattered within the nodule
Loss of the normal sharp boundary between mantle zone and germinal center
Separate smaller, well-defined IgD-positive nodule at the right side
Faint weak background staining in interfollicular areas; capsule and vessels at right edge
62281.describe_en: IgD immunohistochemistry demonstrates a large, irregular nodule in which IgD-positive mantle zone B cells form a coarse reticulated network enclosing multiple small IgD-negative germinal center fragments, with loss of the normal mantle-germinal center interface. A smaller, well-circumscribed nodule is seen nearby, and the interfollicular tissue shows only weak background staining. Findings are consistent with progressive transformation of germinal centers.

ddx.vs: Both show IgD-rich nodules; NLPHL is distinguished by LP cells with PD-1+ T-cell rosettes and multinodular effacement of the node.
Lymphocyte-rich CHL shows expanded mantle zones harboring CD30+/CD15+ Hodgkin cells around regressed germinal centers, which must be excluded with CD30/CD15 staining.

62217.recognize_zh: 一團彼此黏著的大細胞，每顆核中都有一個明顯淡藍色核仁，細胞質淡灰並布滿透明小空泡，與周圍紅血球大小相差懸殊，屬於骨髓中的轉移性癌細胞團。
features: Cohesive cluster of about 20 large epithelial-type cells
Round to oval nuclei with fine granular chromatin and a single prominent blue nucleolus
Moderate pale cytoplasm containing multiple clear vacuoles
Distinct cell borders with focal nuclear molding
Background red cells; a small hematopoietic cell entrapped within the cluster
62217.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cohesive cluster of large non-hematopoietic cells. The cells have round to oval nuclei with finely granular chromatin and single prominent nucleoli, and moderate pale cytoplasm containing numerous clear vacuoles. Cell borders are relatively distinct, and the cluster is sharply separated from the surrounding red cells. Findings are consistent with metastatic carcinoma involving the bone marrow, compatible with the known breast primary; confirmation by cytokeratin and breast-lineage immunostains is recommended.

ddx.vs: Osteoblasts have eccentric nuclei with a hof separated from the nucleus and inconspicuous nucleoli, and lack vacuolated cohesive clusters with prominent nucleoli.
Burkitt cells also have vacuoles but are discohesive, medium-sized with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and CD45/CD20 positivity.

ddx.dx: Macrophage clusters (e.g. storage or hemophagocytic histiocytes)
ddx.vs: Histiocytes have small bland nuclei, abundant foamy or phagocytic cytoplasm and are CD68/CD163 positive rather than cytokeratin positive.

exam.answer_en: Metastatic breast carcinoma in bone marrow — cohesive cluster of large vacuolated epithelial cells with prominent single nucleoli and nuclear molding
pearls_zh: 考法：問這團細胞與骨髓造血細胞的差別：細胞黏著、邊界清楚、核互相擠壓（molding）、細胞遠大於周圍紅血球，是非造血腫瘤的線索。
成人骨髓轉移常見來源：乳癌、前列腺癌、肺癌；兒童則要想到 neuroblastoma、rhabdomyosarcoma、Ewing sarcoma。
乳癌 IHC：GATA3、ER/PR、HER2 可在骨髓標本評估；骨髓切片脫鈣方式會影響 IHC 與分子檢測結果。
臨床線索：不明原因血球低下、leukoerythroblastosis、ALP 升高或高鈣血症；乳癌患者出現這些表現需考慮骨髓侵犯。
exam.pitfall_zh: 細胞質多空泡易被誤認為 Burkitt lymphoma 或 monoblast：這些是單個分散的淋巴／單核細胞；此處細胞成團黏著且具上皮型核仁與核擠壓。

quiz.q: 這團細胞為何不是造血細胞？請說出兩個形態線索。
quiz.a: 細胞彼此黏著成團、體積巨大並有核擠壓（molding）與明顯核仁，符合轉移性癌

62153.recognize_zh: 多顆大型母細胞，核圓至不規則、染色質細緻並有明顯核仁，胞質中等量淡藍；同視野有一顆分葉成熟嗜中性球，提示有顆粒球成熟，符合 AML 伴成熟（M2）。
features: Large blasts with moderate N:C ratio and moderate pale blue cytoplasm
Round to irregular or indented nuclei with fine chromatin
One to two prominent nucleoli in several blasts
Rare fine cytoplasmic granules; no definite Auer rods in this field
Accompanying mature segmented neutrophil indicating residual granulocytic maturation
62153.describe_en: Aspirate smear shows a hemodilute field containing several large blasts. The blasts have round to indented nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin and prominent nucleoli, and a moderate rim of pale basophilic cytoplasm with occasional fine granules. A mature segmented neutrophil is present nearby, and no definite Auer rods are seen. Findings are consistent with myeloblasts; AML with maturation is supported by the presence of maturing granulocytes, but confirmation requires a full differential count, cytochemistry or flow cytometry, and genetic studies.

ddx.vs: Monoblasts have more abundant grey-blue vacuolated cytoplasm and delicately folded nuclei, with nonspecific esterase positivity and CD14/CD64 on flow cytometry.
Lymphoblasts are usually smaller with scant cytoplasm and are MPO negative with a B- or T-lymphoid immunophenotype.
This genetic subtype commonly shows AML-M2 morphology with salmon-pink granules, a single long Auer rod and perinuclear hofs, requiring cytogenetics or molecular testing to confirm.
Regenerating marrow shows a spectrum of granulated promyelocytes with perinuclear hofs and orderly maturation rather than agranular blasts with prominent nucleoli.

exam.answer_en: Acute myeloid leukemia with maturation (FAB M2) — myeloblasts with prominent nucleoli accompanied by maturing segmented neutrophils
pearls_zh: 考法：同視野的成熟分葉嗜中性球是考點：代表有顆粒球成熟，用以區分 AML with maturation 與 AML without maturation。
WHO 定義概念：AML with maturation 為 blast ≥20%，且 promyelocyte 以後的成熟顆粒球 ≥10%、monocytic 細胞 <20%。
Flow：CD34、CD117、CD13、CD33、HLA-DR、MPO；若 CD19/PAX5 異常表現或有細長 Auer rod，要做 RUNX1::RUNX1T1 檢測。
現行分類以遺傳異常優先：先排除 t(8;21)、NPM1、CEBPA bZIP 突變及 myelodysplasia-related 變化，才歸入依分化定義的類別。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把 myelocyte／promyelocyte 誤數為 blast 而高估比例：promyelocyte 有明顯嗜天青顆粒與核旁高爾基淡染區；blast 顆粒極少或無。

quiz.q: 與原始細胞同視野出現的成熟分葉嗜中性球，在 AML 分型上代表什麼？
quiz.a: 有顆粒球成熟，支持 AML with maturation（FAB M2）

61961.recognize_zh: CD30染色中大型腫瘤細胞一致性呈強烈膜狀加核旁點狀（Golgi）陽性，成群呈黏著性團塊或巢狀分布於陰性小細胞之間，這種「成片、強度一致」的CD30是ALCL的必要特徵。
features: Strong, uniform membranous and paranuclear Golgi-type CD30 staining in large cells
Positive cells form cohesive clusters, nests and sheets, some with a sinusoidal-like distribution
Large cells with abundant cytoplasm and vesicular nuclei
Intervening negative small lymphocytes and stromal cells
61961.describe_en: CD30 immunostain shows strong and uniform membranous and Golgi-zone staining in virtually all large neoplastic cells, which grow in cohesive clusters, nests and sheets separated by negative small lymphocytes and stroma. The intensity is homogeneous across the large-cell population. This pattern is characteristic of anaplastic large cell lymphoma; with negative ALK it supports ALK-negative ALCL.

ddx.vs: cHL shows CD30 in scattered HRS cells (except syncytial variant) with CD15 and weak PAX5, rather than uniform sheets of CD30+ T cells.
CD30 in PTCL NOS is variable in intensity and proportion, while ALCL shows strong uniform CD30 in nearly all tumor cells.
Embryonal carcinoma is CD30-positive but also keratin, SALL4 and OCT3/4-positive and CD45/T-cell-marker negative.
BIA-ALCL shares the CD30+ ALK- phenotype but arises in periprosthetic effusion or capsule, a clinical rather than morphologic distinction.

exam.answer_en: Anaplastic large cell lymphoma — strong uniform membranous and Golgi CD30 staining in cohesive sheets of large cells
pearls_zh: 考法：問染色型態：細胞膜加核旁 Golgi 點狀；ALCL 要求幾乎所有腫瘤細胞強而一致陽性。
腫瘤細胞常呈竇內（sinusoidal）或黏著成巢分布，易被誤認為轉移癌。
下一步必做 ALK IHC：ALK+ ALCL 多為 NPM1::ALK（t(2;5)），呈核加細胞質染色；ALK− 再分 DUSP22、TP63 重排。
CD30 是 brentuximab vedotin 的治療標靶。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 CD30 陽性的 PTCL, NOS 混淆；PTCL NOS 的 CD30 強度與比例不一，ALCL 為幾乎全部腫瘤細胞強而一致陽性。

quiz.q: ALCL 的 CD30 典型染色位置為何？
quiz.a: 細胞膜加核旁 Golgi 點狀

61897.recognize_zh: 撥開頭髮後，耳朵上方頭皮（紅色箭頭）可見一個小的暗紅色結痂丘疹或糜爛；此類在日光暴露區反覆出現、結痂後留疤的丘疱疹是 HV 樣淋巴增生性疾病（HVLPD）的臨床表現，但照片本身不具特異性。
features: Clinical photograph of the left temporal scalp above the ear with hair parted by a gloved hand
Small dark red crusted papule or erosion on the scalp (red arrow)
Lesion measures a few millimeters without obvious vesicle or surrounding cellulitis
Small pigmented macule on the helix of the ear, likely incidental
No extensive scarring or alopecia visible at this resolution
61897.describe_en: Clinical photograph of the left temporal scalp, with the hair parted, shows a small dark red crusted papule or erosion just above the ear (red arrow). There is no evident vesiculation, surrounding erythema or scarring alopecia in this view, and a small pigmented macule on the helix appears incidental. The lesion is nonspecific in isolation but is compatible with a crusted papulovesicular lesion in the clinical context of hydroa vacciniforme-like lymphoproliferative disorder. Tissue biopsy with EBER in situ hybridization is required for diagnosis.

ddx.vs: Classic HV is a self-limited childhood photodermatosis without systemic symptoms, whereas HVLPD may have systemic involvement, high EBV DNA load and a clonal EBV-positive infiltrate.
Excoriations and folliculitis show neutrophilic follicular or superficial inflammation without an EBER-positive lymphoid infiltrate.
Herpetic lesions show viral cytopathic change in keratinocytes and are HSV/VZV PCR positive rather than EBER positive.
Bite reactions have eosinophil-rich wedge-shaped infiltrates without EBV-infected lymphocytes.

61833.recognize_zh: 這是冠狀切面 FDG PET/CT 融合影像，右中腹部腸道/腸繫膜區有一串強烈攝取的節段性病灶（白色箭頭），與心肌、膀胱等生理性攝取不同；PET 本身無法定組織型，需切片證實為組織球肉瘤。
features: Coronal fused FDG PET/CT image of the neck, chest, abdomen, and pelvis
Multiple confluent intensely FDG-avid nodular foci in the right and central abdomen along bowel loops/mesentery (arrows)
Physiologic uptake in myocardium, gastric wall, and urinary bladder
No discrete FDG-avid thoracic or peripheral nodal masses evident in this slice
Bone marrow uptake not markedly increased on this single slice
61833.describe_en: This is a non-morphologic figure: a coronal fused FDG PET/CT image. Multiple intensely hypermetabolic, confluent nodular foci are present in the right and central abdomen along bowel loops and/or mesentery (arrows), distinct from physiologic uptake in the myocardium, stomach, and urinary bladder. No additional discrete hypermetabolic thoracic masses are evident on this single slice. The pattern indicates an FDG-avid intra-abdominal neoplasm involving bowel or mesentery, which is nonspecific and requires tissue biopsy; in this case the biopsy established histiocytic sarcoma.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma or Burkitt lymphoma of the bowel
ddx.vs: Aggressive B-cell lymphomas produce identical FDG-avid bowel masses and are distinguished only on biopsy by CD20/PAX5 positivity versus CD163/CD68/PU.1 in histiocytic sarcoma.
Carcinoma is separated by keratin-positive epithelial histology on biopsy, not by PET avidity.

ddx.dx: Inflammatory bowel disease or physiologic bowel uptake
ddx.vs: Physiologic or inflammatory bowel uptake is usually linear and segmental along the mucosa rather than forming confluent nodular masses.

61705.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中低倍即可見到骨小樑之間幾乎被一片單調、密集的圓核細胞取代，脂肪與正常三系造血明顯減少，呈片狀（sheet-like）浸潤，符合漿細胞瘤性浸潤的樣式。
features: Markedly hypercellular marrow space with near-effacement of fat
