Diffuse, sheet-like infiltrate of monotonous small-to-intermediate cells with round, often eccentric nuclei
Moderate amphophilic cytoplasm; individual plasmacytoid detail (clock-face chromatin, hof) not resolvable at this power
Marked reduction of normal trilineage hematopoiesis; megakaryocytes not conspicuous
Bony trabeculae and hemorrhage at the periphery; no granulomas or fibrosis evident
61705.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy (H&E, low-to-medium power) shows a markedly hypercellular intertrabecular space with near-complete loss of fat. The marrow is replaced by diffuse sheets of monotonous cells with round, eccentrically placed nuclei and moderate cytoplasm, with marked reduction of normal hematopoietic elements. Cytologic detail is limited at this magnification, and plasma cell lineage should be confirmed with CD138 and kappa/lambda staining. Findings are consistent with extensive marrow involvement by plasma cell myeloma in the appropriate context.

ddx.vs: LPL shows a mixed infiltrate of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with mast cells, often paratrabecular/nodular, and is CD20-positive with MYD88 L265P, whereas myeloma is a pure CD138+ plasma cell sheet.

ddx.dx: Marginal zone or other small B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: These are composed of CD20+ small lymphocytes rather than CD138+/CD20- light-chain-restricted plasma cells, which requires IHC to separate at this power.
Blasts have fine chromatin, high N:C ratio and scant cytoplasm and express CD34/TdT or MPO rather than CD138 with cytoplasmic light-chain restriction.

61641.recognize_zh: 單一嗜酸性球，核呈 C 形/帶狀的低分葉，細胞質內橘紅色顆粒分布不均並有部分脫顆粒的淡染區與小空泡；這種型態異常的嗜酸性球是 PCM1::JAK2 相關嗜酸性球增多的線索之一，但本身不具特異性。
features: Eosinophil with hypolobated C-shaped/band-form nucleus
Orange-red eosinophilic granules unevenly distributed with areas of partial degranulation
Small clear cytoplasmic vacuoles
Background red cells with mild anisopoikilocytosis including occasional ovalocytes and a teardrop-like form
Occasional small platelets
61641.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows an eosinophil with a hypolobated band-form (C-shaped) nucleus and unevenly distributed eosinophilic granules with areas of degranulation and small cytoplasmic vacuoles. Red cells show mild anisopoikilocytosis with occasional ovalocytes and a teardrop-like cell. Dysplastic features in eosinophils are nonspecific and may occur in reactive states. In the setting of a documented PCM1::JAK2 fusion, the abnormal eosinophil is consistent with a myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with eosinophilia and JAK2 rearrangement.

ddx.vs: Reactive eosinophils can also be vacuolated or degranulated, so a clonal process requires cytogenetic/molecular evidence rather than morphology alone.
CEL shows similar dysplastic eosinophils but requires clonality or increased blasts without a defining PDGFRA/PDGFRB/FGFR1/JAK2 rearrangement.
Morphologically indistinguishable in blood; FIP1L1::PDGFRA is detected by FISH or RT-PCR and predicts imatinib response.
Immature forms have mixed basophilic-staining granules and rounder or kidney-shaped nuclei with more cytoplasmic basophilia.

61577.recognize_zh: 流式散布圖中紅色母細胞群 CD10 一致陽性、CD20 由陰性到部分弱陽性呈拖尾分布，和紫色成熟 B 細胞（CD20 陽性、CD10 陰性）明顯分開；CD10+、CD20 異質表現是 B 淋巴母細胞（common B-ALL）的典型免疫表型。
features: Bivariate dot plot: CD10-APC700 (x-axis) versus CD20-PB (y-axis), log scales
Red (blast-gated) population uniformly CD10-positive at moderate intensity (about 10^1-10^2)
Blasts show heterogeneous CD20, spanning negative to dim/partial positive as a vertical smear
Purple CD20-positive/CD10-negative cluster representing residual mature B cells
Purple CD20-negative/CD10-negative cluster representing non-B events (T/NK/myeloid cells)
61577.describe_en: This flow cytometry dot plot displays CD10 versus CD20. The gated blast population (red) is uniformly CD10-positive with heterogeneous CD20 expression ranging from negative to partial dim-to-moderate positivity, forming a vertical smear. Residual mature B cells (purple) are CD20-positive and CD10-negative, and a separate purple CD10-negative/CD20-negative cluster represents non-B-cell events. The discrete, homogeneous CD10-positive population, distinct from the normal hematogone maturation continuum, supports a precursor B-cell (B-lymphoblastic) leukemia immunophenotype; the BCR::ABL1-like subtype cannot be determined from this plot and requires CRLF2 and molecular studies.

ddx.vs: Hematogones form a continuous maturation pattern in which CD10 decreases as CD20 increases, rather than a tight uniform CD10+ cluster with aberrant antigen intensity.
CD10-positive but uniformly bright CD20 with surface light-chain restriction and TdT/CD34 negativity.
CD10+/bright CD20+ mature B cells with surface light-chain restriction and no CD34/TdT expression.

61513.recognize_zh: 雙酯酶染色（combined esterase）下，絕大多數母細胞呈瀰漫紅棕色的非特異性酯酶（α-naphthyl butyrate）陽性，僅中央一顆較小細胞呈藍色（chloroacetate esterase 陽性，顆粒球系）；以單核球系為主的染色結果支持急性單核母細胞白血病。
features: Most leukocytes show diffuse red-brown cytoplasmic nonspecific (butyrate) esterase positivity
Staining intensity varies from strong to weak among the blasts
A single small cell stains blue with chloroacetate esterase, marking a granulocytic-lineage cell (internal control)
Only rare cells show double staining or are unstained
Red cells in the background are unstained apart from pale pink counterstain
61513.describe_en: Combined esterase cytochemical stain on the peripheral blood shows that the large majority of leukocytes exhibit diffuse red-brown cytoplasmic alpha-naphthyl butyrate (nonspecific) esterase activity. A rare cell shows blue naphthol AS-D chloroacetate (specific) esterase staining, consistent with a granulocytic-lineage cell serving as an internal control. The predominance of nonspecific esterase-positive cells confirms monocytic lineage of the blasts. Findings support acute monoblastic leukemia.

ddx.vs: AMML shows substantial populations of both butyrate esterase-positive (red-brown) and chloroacetate esterase-positive (blue) cells, each at least 20% of marrow cells.
These may show focal, dot-like nonspecific esterase activity (alpha-naphthyl acetate) that is fluoride-resistant, not the diffuse fluoride-sensitive butyrate esterase of monocytes.
Granulocytic blasts are chloroacetate esterase and MPO positive (blue) with little or no butyrate esterase staining.

exam.answer_en: Acute monoblastic leukemia — combined esterase stain with most blasts nonspecific (butyrate) esterase positive; rare chloroacetate esterase+ granulocyte
pearls_zh: 考法：問兩種顏色分別代表什麼：butyrate/acetate（nonspecific）esterase 標示單核球系，naphthol AS-D chloroacetate（specific）esterase 標示顆粒球系；本圖以單核球系為主。
Chloroacetate esterase（Leder stain）除顆粒球外，肥大細胞也強陽性，且可在福馬林固定的切片上施行。
同一群 blast 兩種 esterase 並存（兩系混合或同細胞雙陽性）時，要考慮 acute myelomonocytic leukemia；inv(16) 的異常嗜酸性球也可呈 chloroacetate esterase 陽性。
細胞化學如今多被 flow 取代，但 NSE 仍有助於 MPO 陰性或單核球表現不典型的病例；判讀以 blast 為分母。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把兩種 esterase 的顏色弄反，或把背景紅血球淡染當陽性；需以染色說明確認發色劑，並以中央 chloroacetate 陽性的顆粒球作內部對照。

quiz.q: 雙酯酶染色中，大多數母細胞呈紅棕色的是哪一種 esterase？代表哪一系？
quiz.a: Nonspecific（α-naphthyl butyrate）esterase；單核球系

61449.recognize_zh: 組合圖：A 冠狀切 CT 顯示鼻腔與鼻竇大片軟組織腫塊，B 為瀰漫成片的大型異型淋巴細胞，C–E 免疫染色瀰漫強陽性，F 為治療後腫塊明顯消退；形態符合瀰漫性大 B 細胞淋巴瘤，但 1α-羥化酶與細胞激素產生無法由圖片判定。
features: Panel A: coronal CT with a large soft-tissue mass filling the nasal cavity and paranasal sinuses with bony remodeling
Panel B (H&E): diffuse sheets of large atypical lymphoid cells with vesicular nuclei, effacing architecture
Panel C: immunostain with diffuse strong positivity infiltrating between skeletal muscle-like fibers
Panels D-E: diffuse membranous/cytoplasmic positivity in the large-cell infiltrate (antibodies not labeled)
Panel F: follow-up coronal CT with near-complete resolution of the mass
61449.describe_en: Composite figure. Coronal CT (A) demonstrates a large sinonasal soft-tissue mass that has largely resolved on follow-up imaging (F). Biopsy (B) shows diffuse sheets of large atypical lymphoid cells with vesicular chromatin, and immunostains (C-E) show diffuse strong positivity in the neoplastic cells, including infiltration around muscle fibers; the specific antibodies are not labeled and cannot be identified from the image. The morphology is compatible with diffuse large B-cell lymphoma. The claimed 25-hydroxyvitamin D-1α-hydroxylase and cytokine production cannot be confirmed from these panels and requires clinical correlation (hypercalcemia with elevated 1,25-dihydroxyvitamin D) and specific immunostains.

ddx.vs: Shows angiocentric necrosis with CD3ε+/CD56+ cytotoxic cells and EBER positivity, rather than CD20+ sheets.
Common in the oral/sinonasal region but is CD20-negative, CD138+/MUM1+ and often EBER+.
Epithelial or neuroendocrine markers (keratin, synaptophysin) are positive and CD45/B-cell markers negative.
Tumor cells express desmin/myogenin rather than lymphoid markers, which matters because panel C shows infiltration among muscle.

61385.recognize_zh: 一團中至大型母細胞，染色質細緻、核形不規則，細胞質中等量、淡灰藍色且無顆粒，最特別的是細胞質邊緣排成一圈的小空泡（像珍珠項鍊），這是母細胞性漿細胞樣樹突細胞腫瘤（BPDCN）的典型線索。
features: Cluster of medium-to-large blasts with irregular, folded or indented nuclei
Fine, finely granular to dispersed chromatin with inconspicuous nucleoli
Moderate pale gray-blue agranular cytoplasm
Small cytoplasmic microvacuoles aligned along the cell membrane in a peripheral string-of-pearls pattern, most evident in the upper cells
Two small cells with round dense nuclei (lymphocytes or late erythroblasts) within the cluster for size comparison
61385.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cluster of medium-to-large blasts with irregular, focally indented nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and a moderate amount of pale gray-blue agranular cytoplasm. Several cells display small cytoplasmic vacuoles arranged circumferentially beneath the cell membrane in a pearl-necklace pattern. No Auer rods or cytoplasmic granules are identified. Two small cells with dense round nuclei are admixed for comparison. The morphology is suggestive of blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm, which should be confirmed by flow cytometry or immunohistochemistry for CD4, CD56, CD123, TCF4 and TCL1.

ddx.vs: Monoblasts/promonocytes have folded nuclei with prominent nucleoli and fine azurophilic granules and are nonspecific esterase and lysozyme positive, lacking the CD123-bright/TCF4+ phenotype.
Lymphoblasts have scant cytoplasm and high N:C ratio without peripheral vacuoles, and express TdT with CD19 or cytoplasmic CD3.

ddx.dx: Myeloid sarcoma / AML with CD56 expression
ddx.vs: Blasts usually contain granules or Auer rods and are MPO-positive, with weaker CD123 and absence of TCL1/TCF4.
Vacuoles are distributed throughout intensely basophilic cytoplasm rather than aligned peripherally, and cells are mature B cells with MYC rearrangement.

exam.answer_en: Blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm — agranular blasts with peripheral string-of-pearls cytoplasmic microvacuoles
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指細胞膜下排成一圈的小空泡，問「這是哪種母細胞？要做哪些標記？」答 BPDCN，並說出 CD4、CD56、CD123、TCF4、TCL1。
表型：CD4+/CD56+/CD123 強陽性，TCF4、TCL1、CD303 陽性；MPO、lysozyme、CD3、CD19 陰性。常見 TET2 等突變。
臨床：好發老年男性，典型以皮膚紫紅色結節/斑塊表現，之後侵犯骨髓、血液與淋巴結；預後差。
治療：CD123 標靶藥 tagraxofusp 已核准用於 BPDCN；適合者於緩解後考慮 allogeneic HSCT。常有 CNS 侵犯風險。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為急性單核球性白血病（亦可 CD4+/CD56+）；BPDCN 無顆粒、NSE/lysozyme 陰性、CD123/TCF4/TCL1 強陽性，單核母細胞則 NSE 陽性並表現 CD14/CD11c 等單核標記。

quiz.q: 老年男性皮膚紫色結節合併骨髓侵犯，母細胞如圖。請列出確診所需的三個關鍵免疫表型標記。
quiz.a: CD4、CD56、CD123（加 TCF4/TCL1）→ BPDCN

61321.recognize_zh: 組合圖：A 為紅血球為主的周邊血液抹片，白血球極少；B 骨髓切片可見大片由組織球構成的肉芽腫病灶；C 高倍見上皮樣組織球與多核巨細胞；D 以銀染（GMS）顯示多個小型圓至卵圓形、染成黑褐色的酵母菌，符合莢膜組織漿菌（Histoplasma）。
features: Panel A: peripheral blood smear with red cells and very few leukocytes or platelets in the field
Panel B: bone marrow biopsy with extensive pale granulomatous areas replacing hematopoietic marrow between trabeculae
Panel C: epithelioid histiocytes and multinucleated giant cells forming non-necrotizing granulomas with admixed inflammatory cells
Panel D: silver stain showing numerous small round to oval dark yeast forms, uniform in size
Low-resolution composite; budding and capsule-like halo cannot be assessed
61321.describe_en: This composite figure shows a peripheral blood smear (A) with red cells and very few leukocytes or platelets in the field, in keeping with pancytopenia. The bone marrow core biopsy (B) shows extensive granulomatous inflammation replacing hematopoietic tissue, and at higher power (C) the granulomas are composed of epithelioid histiocytes and multinucleated giant cells without obvious necrosis. A Grocott methenamine silver stain (D) highlights numerous small, uniform, round to oval yeast forms. The findings are consistent with granulomatous marrow involvement by disseminated histoplasmosis; culture, urine/serum antigen testing, or PCR can confirm the species.

ddx.vs: Cryptococcus yeasts are larger and more variable in size, with a thick mucicarmine-positive capsule and narrow-based budding.
Leishmania amastigotes have a kinetoplast visible on Giemsa and are GMS-negative.
Mycobacteria are acid-fast bacilli on Ziehl-Neelsen stain and do not appear as round yeasts on GMS.
Non-infectious granulomas lack organisms on GMS and acid-fast stains.

61257.recognize_zh: 周邊血中央一顆小型漿細胞：核偏心、染色質粗塊，細胞質深藍偏向一側；背景紅血球明顯串成錢幣狀長鏈（rouleaux）。單看這顆細胞需與漿細胞樣淋巴球區分，但配合 rouleaux 與病史，指向漿細胞白血病。
features: Single small plasma cell with an eccentric round nucleus and coarse clumped chromatin
Moderate deeply basophilic cytoplasm displaced to one side of the nucleus
Marked red cell rouleaux with stacked chains and clumps throughout the field
Scattered platelets; few isolated red cells with central pallor
Single cell in field limits assessment of plasma cell number and atypia
61257.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a small circulating plasma cell with an eccentric nucleus, coarsely clumped chromatin and a crescent of deeply basophilic cytoplasm. The red cells display marked rouleaux formation, consistent with increased serum paraprotein. Only a single abnormal cell is present in this field, so quantification of circulating plasma cells and flow cytometric assessment of clonality are required. Findings are consistent with circulating plasma cells with rouleaux, supporting plasma cell leukemia in the appropriate context.

ddx.vs: Cells are smaller with less eccentric nuclei and coexist with small lymphocytes; IgM paraprotein and MYD88 L265P support LPL.
Isolated polyclonal plasma cells without paraprotein-related rouleaux and with normal serum protein electrophoresis.
Has a central nucleus with a thin symmetric rim of pale blue cytoplasm and lacks a perinuclear hof.
Disappears in the thin area of the smear, whereas true rouleaux persists and correlates with elevated ESR and globulin.

exam.answer_en: Circulating plasma cell with marked rouleaux — consistent with plasma cell leukemia in context (single cell; quantification required)
pearls_zh: 考法：單一顆核偏心、染色質粗塊、胞質深藍偏向一側的細胞，加上滿視野 rouleaux，考官會問「這是什麼細胞？背景代表什麼？」→ plasma cell；rouleaux 反映血中 paraprotein 增加。
Rouleaux 的臨床關聯：ESR 顯著上升、total protein 與 globulin 升高，應安排 SPEP/immunofixation 與 serum free light chain。
單張圖只有一顆細胞不足以診斷 PCL，必須計數：IMWG 2021 門檻為周邊血抹片 plasma cells ≥5%，並以 flow 證明單株性。
PCL 是侵襲性最高的 plasma cell neoplasm，常合併高 LDH、腎功能不全、高鈣與髓外病灶，需積極誘導治療並考慮自體移植。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最易誤認為 lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma 的漿細胞樣淋巴球或小淋巴球：小淋巴球核居中、胞質為對稱細邊且無 hof；LPL 為小淋巴球到漿細胞的連續譜系，伴 IgM paraprotein 與 MYD88 L265P。

quiz.q: 圖中紅血球疊成錢幣狀代表血液中哪一種變化？應安排哪項檢查？
quiz.a: 血漿 paraprotein（球蛋白）增加；SPEP／immunofixation（及 serum free light chain）

61193.recognize_zh: CSF 抹片中一小群細胞核偏心、染色質呈粗塊狀、細胞質深藍且可見核旁淡染區（hof），外觀為漿細胞群，在骨髓瘤病人即為 CSF 漿細胞增多（中樞侵犯）。
features: Small aggregate of seven mononuclear cells on a clean cytospin background
Eccentric round to oval nuclei with coarse, clumped chromatin
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm with a paler perinuclear zone (hof) in several cells
Cells are relatively uniform, medium-sized, with irregular cytoplasmic contours and small blebs
Nucleoli not conspicuous; no admixed lymphocytes, neutrophils or red cells
61193.describe_en: Cytospin of cerebrospinal fluid shows a small cluster of uniform plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, coarsely clumped chromatin and deeply basophilic cytoplasm, several showing a perinuclear hof. The cells lack admixed reactive lymphocytes or monocytes. The clustering reflects cytocentrifuge aggregation rather than true epithelial cohesion. In a patient with known multiple myeloma and neurologic symptoms, findings are consistent with CSF plasmacytosis due to CNS involvement by plasma cell myeloma, which can be confirmed by flow cytometry for clonal plasma cells.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are few and mixed with lymphocytes and monocytes, and flow cytometry shows polytypic light chains.
Carcinoma cells form truly cohesive three-dimensional clusters with nuclear molding, macronucleoli and cytokeratin positivity.
Contains a spectrum of small lymphocytes and plasmacytoid cells with CD19/CD20 expression, rather than pure CD138+/CD19- plasma cells.

61129.recognize_zh: 合成圖 A 格（100x 抹片）為大型母細胞，胞質深藍且布滿清楚空泡，核染色質細緻，外觀很像 Burkitt 淋巴瘤細胞；B–D 為 FISH、E 為核型，須靠 BCR::ABL1 證據與骨髓性標記才能判定為 CML 骨髓性急變期。
features: Panel A: large blasts with round to oval nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin and moderate to abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Prominent, sharply punched-out cytoplasmic vacuoles creating a Burkitt-like appearance
Occasional maturing granulocytes in the background; no Auer rods evident at this resolution
Panels B-D: interphase and metaphase FISH with red/green signals and arrows marking fusion or abnormal signals (labels not legible at this resolution)
Panel E: karyotype ideogram with additional abnormalities (details not legible)
61129.describe_en: Composite figure. The smear in panel A shows large blasts with fine chromatin, moderate to abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm and numerous distinct cytoplasmic vacuoles, closely mimicking Burkitt lymphoma/leukemia cells; a maturing granulocyte is present nearby. Panels B-D display interphase and metaphase FISH images with abnormal signal patterns, and panel E shows a karyotype; probe names and specific abnormalities are not legible at this resolution. In a patient with CML, vacuolated blasts must be immunophenotyped, as the morphology alone cannot establish lineage; findings are consistent with myeloid blast phase of CML with lymphoma-like morphology when myeloid markers and BCR::ABL1 are demonstrated.

ddx.vs: Burkitt cells are mature B cells (CD19/CD20/CD10/sIg+, TdT-negative) with MYC rearrangement and no BCR::ABL1 fusion.
Lymphoid blasts are TdT/CD19/CD10-positive and MPO-negative, whereas myeloid blast phase shows MPO, CD13/CD33/CD117 expression.

ddx.dx: Acute monocytic leukemia with vacuolated blasts
ddx.vs: Monoblasts are nonspecific esterase- and CD14/CD64-positive with folded nuclei and lack the Philadelphia chromosome.

61065.recognize_zh: 整個視野中有相當比例的紅血球呈兩側平行、長軸明顯的橢圓形或雪茄狀（橢圓形紅血球，elliptocyte），其餘多為卵圓形，缺乏碎片或淚滴細胞，符合遺傳性橢圓形紅血球症。
features: Numerous elliptocytes with long axis clearly exceeding short axis, some cigar- or pencil-shaped with parallel sides
Many additional ovalocytes; remaining cells round with central pallor
Red cells approximately normocytic with preserved central pallor in most cells
No significant schistocytes, teardrop cells or spherocytes in this field
Scattered platelets; weakly stained (blue-gray cast) smear
61065.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a prominent population of elliptocytes, including cigar-shaped forms with parallel sides, together with ovalocytes. Red cells are otherwise normocytic with preserved central pallor, and schistocytes, teardrop cells and spherocytes are not conspicuous. Platelets are present. The stain is weak, limiting color assessment. Findings are consistent with hereditary elliptocytosis.

ddx.vs: Iron deficiency shows microcytic, hypochromic cells with variable pencil forms and low ferritin, rather than a uniform population of normochromic elliptocytes.
Myelofibrosis shows teardrop cells, leukoerythroblastosis and poikilocytosis rather than a predominance of regular elliptocytes.
SAO cells are rounder stomatocytic ovalocytes, often with one or two transverse bars or slits, due to a SLC4A1 deletion.
Macro-ovalocytes are larger (high MCV) and accompanied by hypersegmented neutrophils.

exam.answer_en: Hereditary elliptocytosis — predominance of normochromic elliptocytes including cigar-shaped cells
pearls_zh: 考法：辨識兩側平行的長橢圓細胞並問最可能遺傳疾病；關鍵是細胞正常大小、正色素、形態均一。
分子：多為 α/β-spectrin（SPTA1、SPTB）或 protein 4.1（EPB41）缺陷，影響細胞骨架水平方向連結，多為體染色體顯性。
多數病人無症狀或輕度溶血；嚴重型 hereditary pyropoikilocytosis 可見碎片與微球形細胞，紅血球熱穩定性下降。
東南亞需注意 Southeast Asian ovalocytosis（SLC4A1/band 3 的 27-bp deletion），細胞呈口形橢圓，對瘧疾有保護作用。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為缺鐵性貧血的 pencil cells；缺鐵為小球低色素、ferritin 低且形狀不一，HE 則為正色素、正常大小的均一橢圓細胞。

quiz.q: 圖中大量兩側平行的長橢圓紅血球叫什麼？最常受影響的膜蛋白為何？
quiz.a: Elliptocytes；spectrin（或 protein 4.1）

61001.recognize_zh: 高倍（但略失焦）骨髓抹片中央一顆大型細胞，細胞質淡藍灰、邊界圓滑，核由兩個相互重疊的圓形核葉組成，未呈正常巨核細胞的多分葉連續核；這種核葉分離、圓形的型態是 MDS/MPN 中常見的非典型（發育不良）巨核細胞。
features: Very large cell with a smooth round outline and a rim of pale grey-blue cytoplasm
Nucleus composed of two large, round, overlapping lobes rather than a complex multilobated nucleus
Chromatin appears finely granular; nucleoli not discernible (image out of focus)
Adjacent granulocytic precursors with coarse dark granules, including a heavily granulated cell at right
Resolution and focus limit assessment of cytoplasmic granularity and nuclear detail
61001.describe_en: High-magnification bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large megakaryocyte with a smooth rounded contour, a rim of grey-blue cytoplasm and a nucleus composed of two round, overlapping lobes instead of the normal multilobated configuration. Adjacent cells include granulocytic precursors, one with coarse dark granules. The image is somewhat out of focus, which limits evaluation of chromatin and cytoplasmic maturation. The megakaryocyte shows dysplastic features (round, separated/bilobed nuclear lobes), which in context are consistent with megakaryocytic atypia of an MDS/MPN such as atypical CML.

ddx.dx: Normal megakaryocyte seen in a single plane
ddx.vs: Normal megakaryocytes have a continuous, compactly lobulated nucleus with granular pink-purple cytoplasm, not two discrete round lobes.
Micromegakaryocytes are small (about the size of a myelocyte) with a single round nucleus, whereas this cell is large.
Osteoclasts contain many separate, uniform oval nuclei with visible nucleoli within abundant granular cytoplasm, rather than two large lobes.
5q- megakaryocytes are medium-sized with a non-lobated or hypolobated single round nucleus rather than separated lobes; cytogenetics distinguishes them.

60937.recognize_zh: 血片中許多紅血球邊緣像被咬掉一口（bite cells/degmacytes），另有血紅素偏向一側、另一側透明的水泡細胞與偏心紅血球（blister cells、eccentrocytes），符合氧化性溶血，例如給予 rasburicase 後誘發 G6PD 缺乏症溶血。
features: Numerous bite cells with semicircular peripheral defects in the red cell membrane
Blister cells/eccentrocytes with hemoglobin displaced to one side and a clear membrane-bound area
Scattered dense, irregularly contracted red cells and occasional spherocytic forms
Normocytic red cells overall; platelets present in normal numbers
No schistocytes or red cell agglutination
60937.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous red cells with sharply demarcated peripheral bites (degmacytes) and blister cells with hemoglobin retracted to one side leaving a clear rim, along with dense contracted cells and occasional spherocytic forms. Platelets are adequate and there are no schistocytes. Findings are consistent with oxidative hemolysis; in a patient treated with an oxidant drug such as rasburicase, they are suggestive of G6PD deficiency, and G6PD activity should be measured (ideally after reticulocytosis subsides) with methemoglobin assessment.

ddx.vs: Schistocytes are small angular fragments and helmet cells with thrombocytopenia, rather than intact cells with rounded bites or eccentric hemoglobin.
Shows spherocytes, polychromasia and a positive DAT without bite or blister cells.
Produces similar bite cells and Heinz bodies but with normal G6PD activity and positive hemoglobin instability testing.

ddx.dx: Dapsone or other drug-induced oxidant injury in G6PD-normal patients
ddx.vs: Morphology is identical, so G6PD assay and drug dose history are needed to separate them.

exam.answer_en: Oxidative hemolysis (G6PD deficiency, e.g. after rasburicase) — bite cells and blister cells/eccentrocytes without schistocytes
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指邊緣被「咬掉一口」的紅血球與血紅素偏一側的細胞，問名稱與機轉 → bite cell（degmacyte）與 blister cell/eccentrocyte，由脾臟移除 Heinz bodies 或氧化損傷造成。
Rasburicase 分解尿酸時產生 H₂O₂，G6PD 缺乏者無法處理而引發溶血與 methemoglobinemia；使用前應篩檢 G6PD，台灣與地中海、非洲族群尤其重要。
此情境的 methemoglobinemia 不可用 methylene blue（需 G6PD 產生的 NADPH，無效且可加重溶血）；以停藥、支持性治療、輸血為主。
G6PD 活性在急性溶血期可因網狀紅血球增多而假性正常，宜於溶血恢復後（數週後）複驗；Heinz body 需 supravital 染色才看得到。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤為 schistocytes 而懷疑 TMA：bite cell 缺口邊緣平滑圓弧、細胞大致完整，schistocyte 為有尖角的碎片；本例血小板正常且無碎片，指向氧化性溶血。

quiz.q: 病人使用 rasburicase 後出現溶血，圖中紅血球邊緣像被咬掉一口的細胞叫什麼？此時合併的 methemoglobinemia 為何不能用 methylene blue？
quiz.a: Bite cell（degmacyte）；G6PD 缺乏無法產生 NADPH，methylene blue 無效且會加重溶血

60809.recognize_zh: 肝細胞（圓形核、淡染細胞質）不染色，其間擴張的竇狀隙內充滿 CD25 膜狀強陽性的淋巴細胞聚集，呈竇內（sinusoidal）分布，符合毛細胞白血病侵犯肝臟。
features: Clusters and cords of CD25-positive cells filling dilated hepatic sinusoids
Strong membranous and cytoplasmic CD25 staining of small to medium cells with oval nuclei
Negative hepatocytes with round central nuclei in intervening plates
Sinusoidal/intravascular distribution without portal-based nodules in this field
60809.describe_en: Liver section stained for CD25 shows numerous positive lymphoid cells aggregated within dilated sinusoids between plates of unstained hepatocytes. The positive cells have oval, bland nuclei with moderate cytoplasm and strong membranous staining. The sinusoidal pattern and CD25 expression are consistent with hepatic involvement by hairy cell leukemia.

ddx.dx: Hairy cell leukemia variant (splenic B-cell lymphoma/leukemia with prominent nucleoli)
ddx.vs: Shares sinusoidal red-pulp-type infiltration but is CD25 negative, annexin A1 negative and BRAF V600E wild type.

ddx.dx: Splenic diffuse red pulp small B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Also sinusoidal but typically CD25, CD103 and annexin A1 negative.
Sinusoidal infiltrate of CD3+, CD4-/CD8-, usually TCR gamma-delta T cells, not CD20+/CD25+ B cells.
Tends to involve portal tracts in liver and is CD25 usually negative or weak, with absent CD103 and annexin A1.

60617.recognize_zh: 切片中成片的漿細胞樣腫瘤細胞（偏心核、車輪狀染色質、部分有核仁），其間可見細長、均質嗜伊紅的針狀或棒狀結晶，有的位於細胞外，有的在細胞胞質內，符合漿細胞骨髓瘤合併免疫球蛋白結晶沉積。
features: Diffuse sheets of plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei, moderate eosinophilic-amphophilic cytoplasm and perinuclear clearing
Nuclear atypia: coarse clock-face to vesicular chromatin, conspicuous nucleoli in some cells, occasional binucleation and mitotic figure
Large elongated, homogeneous, glassy eosinophilic rod-shaped crystal lying extracellularly between plasma cells
Smaller rhomboid/needle-shaped eosinophilic crystals within plasma cell cytoplasm
Minimal residual hematopoiesis or fat in these fields
60617.describe_en: Sections show a diffuse, sheet-like infiltrate of atypical plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, coarse to vesicular chromatin, occasional prominent nucleoli and mitotic figures. Interspersed are elongated, homogeneous, glassy eosinophilic crystals, some extracellular and others within the cytoplasm of neoplastic plasma cells. The crystals likely represent precipitated monoclonal immunoglobulin or light chain. Findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma with extracellular and intracellular crystal deposition; light-chain immunostains and evaluation for light-chain–associated renal injury (e.g., crystalline nephropathy, Fanconi syndrome) are advised.

ddx.vs: In CSH the crystals accumulate within CD68-positive histiocytes rather than within plasma cells or free in the interstitium.
Charcot-Leyden crystals are bipyramidal, form in eosinophil-rich lesions and are not associated with sheets of clonal plasma cells.
Oxalate crystals are birefringent, pale and fan-shaped and urate crystals are needle-shaped in tophi, neither arising from plasma cells.
LPL shows a mixed small lymphocyte, plasmacytoid and plasma cell population with round globular inclusions rather than elongated crystals and sheets of atypical plasma cells.

60681.recognize_zh: 腦脊髓液（CSF）巨噬細胞中，A 圖可見金黃色菱形結晶（hematoidin），B 圖胞質內有藍黑色粗顆粒（含鐵血黃素，siderophage），C 圖吞噬完整紅血球（erythrophage）；三者同時出現代表真正的腦內出血而非穿刺創傷。
features: Panel A: macrophage with bright golden-yellow rhomboid crystals of hematoidin and finer yellow-brown pigment
Panel B: vacuolated macrophage containing coarse blue-black granular hemosiderin (siderophage)
Panel C: macrophage with an ingested intact red blood cell within a vacuole (erythrophage)
Foamy, vacuolated cytoplasm with eccentric oval to kidney-shaped nuclei in all macrophages
Background free red cells
60681.describe_en: Cytocentrifuge preparation of cerebrospinal fluid shows activated macrophages with abundant vacuolated cytoplasm. One macrophage contains golden-yellow rhomboid hematoidin crystals (panel A), another contains coarse blue-black hemosiderin granules (panel B), and a third contains a phagocytosed intact erythrocyte (panel C). Free red cells are present in the background. The combination of erythrophages, siderophages, and hematoidin crystals indicates red cell breakdown in vivo over days to weeks and is consistent with true subarachnoid or intracerebral hemorrhage rather than a traumatic tap.

ddx.vs: A traumatic tap shows fresh red cells without erythrophagocytosis, hemosiderin, or hematoidin, since those require hours to weeks to form in vivo.
Melanin is fine brown-black dusty pigment that does not form golden rhomboid crystals and is Prussian blue negative, often with atypical melanoma cells present.
Stain precipitate lies on top of cells in multiple planes and is not golden, while hematoidin crystals are intracellular within macrophages.

ddx.dx: In vitro erythrophagocytosis in a delayed specimen
ddx.vs: Delayed processing can produce erythrophages but not hemosiderin or hematoidin, which indicate longer in vivo hemorrhage.

exam.answer_en: True CNS hemorrhage on CSF cytology — erythrophages, siderophages (hemosiderin) and macrophages with golden hematoidin crystals
pearls_zh: 考法：三格分別指吞噬完整紅血球的 erythrophage、含藍黑色顆粒的 siderophage、含金黃色菱形結晶的 hematoidin，要求逐一命名並說明代表出血時間序。
時間序大致為 erythrophage（數小時）→ siderophage（約 2 天後）→ hematoidin 結晶（約 1 週以上）；出現後兩者代表體內出血已有一段時間。
Hemosiderin 含鐵，Prussian blue 染色陽性；hematoidin 為膽紅素類衍生物、不含鐵，Prussian blue 陰性。
與 traumatic tap 鑑別：traumatic tap 連續管紅血球遞減、上清液無 xanthochromia、無 siderophage/hematoidin。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最易誤認為 melanoma 的 melanin-laden macrophage：melanin 為細小棕黑色顆粒、Prussian blue 陰性並可配合 IHC；hemosiderin 為粗大藍黑顆粒且鐵染色陽性。

quiz.q: 圖中巨噬細胞內金黃色菱形結晶是什麼？它與 hemosiderin 在鐵染色上有何不同？
quiz.a: Hematoidin 結晶；hematoidin 不含鐵（Prussian blue 陰性），hemosiderin 陽性

60745.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中巨噬細胞內與周圍散布大量細小、卵圓形、帶一個核與一個小桿狀動基體（kinetoplast）的無鞭毛體（amastigote），同一巨噬細胞也吞噬有核細胞與紅血球，同時呈現利什曼原蟲感染與噬血現象。
features: Aspirate (C, D): large macrophages containing phagocytosed nucleated hematopoietic cells and red cells (hemophagocytosis)
Numerous small oval amastigotes (about 2–4 µm) within macrophage cytoplasm and scattered extracellularly, each with a nucleus and a small rod-shaped kinetoplast
Biopsy (A): marrow with abundant fat and patchy hematopoietic cellularity at low power
Biopsy (B): histiocytes with abundant pale, finely granular to vacuolated cytoplasm containing tiny dot-like organisms and engulfed cells
Smear background yellowish-brown clumped red cells; no granulomas evident
60745.describe_en: The bone marrow core biopsy shows patchy hematopoietic cellularity with increased histiocytes that have abundant granular cytoplasm containing minute dot-like bodies. Aspirate smears reveal macrophages engulfing nucleated hematopoietic cells and erythrocytes, together with numerous intracellular and extracellular small oval organisms each bearing a nucleus and a rod-shaped kinetoplast, characteristic of Leishmania amastigotes. Findings are consistent with visceral leishmaniasis with associated hemophagocytosis, supporting secondary hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis; confirmation by PCR, culture or serology and species identification are recommended.

ddx.vs: Histoplasma yeasts are similar in size but have a clear halo and no kinetoplast, and stain with GMS/PAS, whereas Leishmania amastigotes are GMS-negative with a kinetoplast.
Toxoplasma tachyzoites lack a kinetoplast and T. cruzi amastigotes favor cardiac and muscle tissue rather than marrow macrophages.

ddx.dx: HLH due to other causes (EBV, lymphoma)
ddx.vs: Other HLH triggers show hemophagocytosis without intracellular kinetoplastid organisms.

ddx.dx: Platelets or granular debris overlying macrophages
ddx.vs: Platelets lack the paired nucleus-and-kinetoplast structure and uniform oval shape of amastigotes.

captions: BM biopsy low power: fatty marrow with patchy cellularity
BM biopsy high power: histiocytes with granular cytoplasm containing organisms
Aspirate: macrophage with engulfed cells and amastigotes
Aspirate: hemophagocytic macrophage surrounded by numerous Leishmania amastigotes

exam.answer_en: Visceral leishmaniasis with secondary HLH — marrow macrophages with hemophagocytosis and Leishmania amastigotes (nucleus plus kinetoplast)
pearls_zh: 考法：同一張圖考兩件事：指巨噬細胞吞噬有核細胞（hemophagocytosis），再指旁邊帶 kinetoplast 的小橢圓體，問「噬血的病因？」→ Leishmania。
HLH 病人一定要在骨髓仔細找 Leishmania：治療 leishmaniasis（liposomal amphotericin B）常可使 HLH 緩解，多不需 HLH-94 化療。
Visceral leishmaniasis 典型：發燒、巨脾、全血球低下、polyclonal hypergammaglobulinemia；脾抽吸敏感度最高，但骨髓較安全常用。
確認：Leishmania PCR、培養或 rK39 血清學；PCR 亦可做種別鑑定。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 Histoplasma 或血小板疊在巨噬細胞上：Histoplasma 無 kinetoplast、周圍有透亮暈且 GMS 陽性；血小板無核、大小形狀不一；amastigote 有核與 kinetoplast。

quiz.q: 圖中巨噬細胞內外帶有兩個點狀構造的小體是什麼？它與噬血現象的關係為何？
quiz.a: Leishmania amastigotes；為繼發性 HLH 的可治療誘因

60553.recognize_zh: 血液抹片中出現一顆中型細胞，細胞核圓形偏向一側、染色質呈粗塊狀（車輪狀），細胞質豐富且呈深藍色，形態為典型漿細胞；周邊紅血球有疊錢狀（rouleaux）排列傾向，符合漿細胞白血病。
features: Medium-sized cell with abundant, deeply basophilic cytoplasm and a small cytoplasmic bleb
Round, eccentrically placed nucleus with coarse, clumped (clock-face) chromatin
No visible nucleoli; low-to-moderate N:C ratio
Subtle paler zone of cytoplasm adjacent to the nucleus (perinuclear hof)
Red cells show short stacked chains suggestive of rouleaux formation
Occasional platelets; no other leukocytes in this field
60553.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows red cells with a tendency to form short rouleaux chains. A circulating mature-appearing plasma cell is present, with abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm, a round eccentric nucleus with coarse clock-face chromatin, and a subtle perinuclear clearing. A single field cannot establish the diagnosis, which requires an absolute circulating plasma cell count or proportion above the defined threshold. In the appropriate clinical and quantitative context, findings are consistent with plasma cell leukemia.

ddx.vs: Reactive circulating plasma cells are few, polytypic by flow cytometry, and accompanied by reactive lymphocytes, whereas plasma cell leukemia shows numerous monotypic plasma cells.
LPL shows a spectrum of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with MYD88 L265P, rather than a predominance of plasma cells.
Plasmacytoid lymphocytes have less eccentric nuclei, finer chromatin, and lack a well-formed hof.

exam.answer_en: Circulating plasma cell with rouleaux — mature plasma cell with clock-face chromatin; plasma cell leukemia if count reaches ≥5%
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指周邊血中深藍胞質、核偏位、車輪狀染色質的細胞，並指背景紅血球疊錢，問「細胞與背景各代表什麼？」→ plasma cell 與 rouleaux（M-protein）。
單一視野無法診斷 PCL：需計數周邊血 plasma cell，IMWG 2021 與 WHO 5th 定義為 ≥5%，並以 flow 證實單株。
Rouleaux 反映血漿球蛋白增加（如 M-protein）；應做 SPEP、immunofixation 與 serum free light chain。
Primary PCL 預後差，常見高風險細胞遺傳學與髓外侵犯、腎衰竭、高血鈣。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把 plasmacytoid reactive lymphocyte 當成 plasma cell：反應性淋巴球核較居中、染色質較細、無明顯核旁淡染區；plasma cell 核偏位、車輪狀染色質並有 hof。

quiz.q: 圖中背景紅血球排成錢幣狀稱為什麼？提示血漿中什麼增加？
quiz.a: Rouleaux；免疫球蛋白（M-protein）

60489.recognize_zh: 黏膜組織中，瀰漫的中型至大型非典型淋巴細胞浸潤於殘存腺體之間，核形不規則、深染並伴有散在凋亡碎屑；結外（鼻腔）黏膜部位的瀰漫非典型淋巴浸潤是結外 NK/T 細胞淋巴瘤的線索，但確診需 CD56、細胞毒性標記與 EBER。
features: Diffuse dense infiltrate of medium to large atypical lymphoid cells in mucosa
Irregular, angulated to elongated hyperchromatic nuclei with coarse to granular chromatin
Scant to moderate pale cytoplasm
Infiltrate surrounds and separates residual mucous glands, with focal glandular infiltration
Scattered apoptotic bodies and nuclear debris; a thick-walled vessel coursing through the infiltrate
60489.describe_en: Section of mucosa (consistent with sinonasal-type mucosa) shows a diffuse, dense infiltrate of medium to large atypical lymphoid cells that surround and separate residual seromucinous glands. The cells have irregular, angulated hyperchromatic nuclei with granular chromatin and scant pale cytoplasm; scattered apoptotic bodies are present. Angiocentric destruction and zonal necrosis are not clearly demonstrated in this field. Findings are suggestive of extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma, nasal type, pending confirmation with CD3, CD56, cytotoxic markers and EBER in situ hybridization.

ddx.vs: DLBCL cells are usually larger with vesicular chromatin and prominent nucleoli and express CD20/PAX5, being EBER and CD56 negative in most cases.
PTCL-NOS lacks the combined CD56/cytotoxic/EBER-positive profile that defines ENKTL.

ddx.dx: Granulomatosis with polyangiitis or reactive/infectious sinusitis
ddx.vs: Inflammatory lesions show a polymorphous infiltrate with neutrophils, granulomas or organisms rather than a sheet of cytologically atypical lymphocytes, and are EBER negative.

ddx.dx: Rhabdomyosarcoma or other small round blue cell tumor
ddx.vs: Non-hematolymphoid small round cell tumors are CD45 negative and express lineage markers such as desmin/myogenin or keratin.

exam.answer_en: Extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma (suggestive) — diffuse atypical medium-to-large lymphoid infiltrate in sinonasal mucosa with apoptosis
pearls_zh: 考法：鼻腔黏膜被不典型淋巴細胞瀰漫浸潤、夾雜凋亡碎屑，考官會問「還需要哪些檢查確診」：CD3、CD56、細胞毒性標記與 EBER。
必考表型：cytoplasmic CD3ε+（表面 CD3−）、CD56+、細胞毒性顆粒（TIA-1、granzyme B、perforin）+，EBER in situ hybridization 陽性是診斷必要條件。
流行病學：EBV 相關，好發亞洲（含台灣）與中南美洲，典型位於鼻腔/上呼吸消化道，以中線破壞性病灶、鼻塞流血表現。
治療與追蹤：局限期以放射治療合併含 asparaginase 的化療；進展期用含 asparaginase 方案（如 SMILE、P-GemOx）；血漿 EBV DNA 用於分期、療效與復發監測。
exam.pitfall_zh: 常誤判為發炎性鼻竇炎或 GPA；壞死與混合發炎會遮蔽腫瘤細胞，任何鼻腔壞死性病灶都應做 EBER，陽性不典型淋巴細胞支持淋巴瘤。

quiz.q: 鼻腔黏膜出現此瀰漫不典型淋巴浸潤，確診結外 NK/T 細胞淋巴瘤必須陽性的原位雜交檢查是什麼？
quiz.a: EBER（EBV-encoded RNA）in situ hybridization

60361.recognize_zh: 間期 FISH 使用 D7S486（7q31，紅）/CEP7（7 號著絲點，綠）雙色探針，圖中細胞核只見一個紅訊號與一個綠訊號（正常應為各兩個），代表整條 7 號染色體只剩一套，即 monosomy 7。
features: Interphase FISH on DAPI-counterstained nuclei using Vysis D7S486 (7q31, red) / CEP7 (chromosome 7 centromere, green) probes
Evaluable nuclei show a single red and a single green signal (1R1G) instead of the normal 2R2G pattern
Loss of both the centromere and 7q31 signals together indicates loss of a whole chromosome 7 rather than an isolated 7q deletion
Some green signals appear doublet-like, consistent with a split signal of one centromere; an adjacent nucleus in the right panel has no signals in this focal plane and is not evaluable
60361.describe_en: Interphase fluorescence in situ hybridization was performed with a dual-color D7S486 (7q31, red)/CEP7 (green) probe set on DAPI-stained nuclei. The illustrated nuclei show one red and one green signal, compared with the expected two copies of each, indicating concurrent loss of the chromosome 7 centromere and the 7q31 locus. This pattern is consistent with monosomy 7; a 7q deletion alone would show two green signals with one red signal. The percentage of abnormal nuclei should be compared with the laboratory cutoff before reporting a clonal abnormality, and the result is useful for detecting monosomy 7 when metaphases are not obtained in marrow failure or MDS.

ddx.vs: A 7q deletion gives two CEP7 (green) signals with one D7S486 (red) signal (1R2G), whereas both signals are reduced to one here.
Sectioning or overlapping signals can mimic loss in isolated nuclei, so a scored count of 200 or more nuclei above the validated cutoff is needed.

60233.recognize_zh: 骨小樑之間的髓腔幾乎完全被細胞填滿、脂肪細胞極少，並由單一形態、核圓而淡染的中型細胞呈片狀（sheets）取代正常三系造血，符合急性白血病的骨髓切片表現。
features: Markedly hypercellular marrow (near 100%) with near-complete loss of fat
Diffuse sheets of monotonous medium-sized cells with round to oval nuclei, open chromatin and scant cytoplasm
Normal trilineage hematopoiesis, including megakaryocytes, largely effaced
Intact bony trabeculae and small vessels with extravasated red cells
Cytologic detail of blasts limited at this magnification
60233.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a markedly hypercellular marrow with near-total replacement of fat. The intertrabecular spaces are filled by diffuse sheets of monotonous immature-appearing cells with round nuclei and scant cytoplasm, with marked reduction of normal erythroid, granulocytic and megakaryocytic elements. No granulomas or fibrosis are evident on H&E. Findings are consistent with marrow involvement by acute leukemia; lineage and genetic classification (AML with t(6;9)) require aspirate, flow cytometry and cytogenetics.

ddx.vs: Also forms sheets of blasts on core biopsy, so IHC (MPO, CD34, TdT, PAX5, CD3) or flow cytometry is required to assign lineage.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma / Burkitt lymphoma involvement
ddx.vs: Cells are larger with vesicular chromatin and prominent nucleoli or show starry-sky pattern, and are CD20/PAX5 positive and CD34/TdT negative.
Retains dysplastic maturing trilineage hematopoiesis with blasts below 20% rather than diffuse sheets of blasts.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small round blue cell tumor
ddx.vs: Shows cohesive nests and desmoplasia with lineage-specific IHC (keratin, synaptophysin, CD99) and is CD45 negative.

60169.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片幾乎看不到脂肪，細胞密度接近100%，由一片片密集的顆粒球系細胞組成，左上可見骨小樑，整片視野中巨核細胞很少，符合aCML的高細胞性、顆粒球為主的骨髓。
features: Markedly hypercellular marrow (near 100%) with virtually no residual fat
Diffuse sheets of granulocytic cells with small dark to irregular nuclei, consistent with maturing myeloid elements
Scattered eosinophilic cytoplasm among the myeloid cells; erythroid islands not prominent
Megakaryocytes are inconspicuous/decreased at this power
Bony trabecula at upper left; low magnification limits assessment of dysplasia and blasts
60169.describe_en: Bone marrow trephine section at low power shows a markedly hypercellular marrow, approaching 100% cellularity, abutting a bony trabecula. The marrow space is filled by sheets of granulocytic cells, with relatively inconspicuous erythroid islands and few megakaryocytes in this field. No discrete fibrosis, lymphoid aggregates, or clusters of blasts are evident at this magnification. The findings are consistent with a granulocyte-predominant myeloproliferation; together with peripheral blood dysgranulopoiesis and absence of BCR::ABL1, they support atypical chronic myeloid leukemia.

ddx.vs: CML also produces a packed granulocytic marrow but typically with increased small hypolobated megakaryocytes and basophilia; BCR::ABL1 detection is required to separate them.
CNL shows mature neutrophil predominance without dysgranulopoiesis and with <10% circulating precursors, often with a CSF3R mutation.
CMML has absolute peripheral monocytosis ≥0.5–1×10^9/L with ≥10% monocytes, highlighted in the marrow by CD14/CD163 immunostains.
Reactive hyperplasia (infection, G-CSF) lacks dysplasia and clonal markers and is usually less extreme with preserved megakaryocytes and fat.

17097.recognize_zh: 周邊血液出現大型異常細胞，細胞質深藍、周邊有多個空泡，核不規則有凹陷、染色質細緻（左圖）；右圖另見數顆中型、核扭曲或花瓣狀的異常淋巴細胞夾雜中性球，年輕女性合併淋巴結腫大，符合 ALK 陽性間變性大細胞淋巴瘤白血病期。
features: Left panel: large atypical cells, over twice the size of neutrophils, with moderate-to-abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Left panel: numerous small clear cytoplasmic vacuoles, often at the cell periphery
Nuclei irregular, indented or kidney-shaped, with finely dispersed chromatin and inconspicuous-to-small nucleoli
Right panel: medium-sized atypical lymphoid cells with convoluted/lobated nuclei and basophilic vacuolated cytoplasm (small cell pattern)
Adjacent normal segmented neutrophils; background RBCs crenated (echinocytes, likely artifact)
17097.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows circulating atypical lymphoid cells. The left panel contains large cells with abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm with peripheral vacuoles and irregular, indented nuclei with fine chromatin, several times the size of adjacent neutrophils. The right panel shows smaller to medium-sized atypical cells with convoluted or lobated nuclei and basophilic vacuolated cytoplasm, admixed with a neutrophil. The morphology is not lineage-specific and requires immunophenotyping (CD30, ALK, T-cell antigens). In a young patient with lymphadenopathy, findings are consistent with leukemic phase of ALK-positive anaplastic large cell lymphoma, often of the small cell or lymphohistiocytic pattern.

ddx.vs: Burkitt cells are monotonous medium-sized cells with round nuclei and multiple nucleoli, express mature B-cell markers and MYC rearrangement, and are CD30/ALK-negative.
Monoblasts/promonocytes may be vacuolated with folded nuclei but express CD33, CD64 and nonspecific esterase and lack ALK.
ATLL flower cells have condensed chromatin and scant non-vacuolated cytoplasm, are CD25+ and HTLV-1 associated, and lack ALK expression.
Morphology cannot separate them; ALK immunostaining or detection of an ALK fusion such as NPM1::ALK is required.

15241.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中一顆嗜中性球的細胞質內有一團深藍紫色、呈桑椹狀（morula）的點狀包涵體，靠近細胞核旁，是人類顆粒球無形體症（human granulocytic anaplasmosis）的特徵。
features: Segmented neutrophil with a cytoplasmic basophilic stippled inclusion forming a mulberry-like cluster (morula)
Morula located adjacent to the nucleus, composed of tightly packed dark blue-purple granular elements
Neutrophil cytoplasm with prominent coarse granulation (toxic-type change)
Background red cells with echinocytes/crenated forms and occasional irregular shapes
A small platelet clump at the upper left; no intraerythrocytic parasites
15241.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a segmented neutrophil containing a dark blue-purple, mulberry-shaped cytoplasmic inclusion (morula) composed of clustered granular elements adjacent to the nucleus. The neutrophil cytoplasm shows coarse granulation. Red cells include crenated forms, and no intraerythrocytic organisms are seen. In a patient with fever, respiratory failure and a subacute febrile illness, findings are consistent with human granulocytic anaplasmosis (Anaplasma phagocytophilum); PCR of whole blood is the confirmatory test, since morulae are seen in only a minority of cases.

ddx.vs: E. chaffeensis morulae occur mainly in monocytes rather than neutrophils; PCR distinguishes the species.
Döhle bodies are pale blue, homogeneous, peripheral cytoplasmic patches and toxic granules are dispersed, whereas a morula is a discrete, stippled, dark cluster.
Phagocytosed bacteria are discrete cocci/rods and Histoplasma yeasts have clear halos, rather than a single membrane-bound cluster of tiny granules.
A platelet lying on a neutrophil has a granular purple center with a pale hyalomere and is in a slightly different focal plane.

exam.answer_en: Human granulocytic anaplasmosis — mulberry-like basophilic morula within a neutrophil cytoplasm (Anaplasma phagocytophilum)
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指中性球內的桑椹狀包涵體問名稱→morula，並問「在中性球還是單核球？」中性球→Anaplasma phagocytophilum；單核球→Ehrlichia chaffeensis。
Morula 是細胞內空泡中的菌落（Anaplasma 為 obligate intracellular 細菌）；抹片陰性不能排除，確診首選全血 PCR。
典型檢驗組合：白血球減少、血小板減少與肝指數上升，病人有發燒及蜱蟲（Ixodes）暴露史。
治療：doxycycline 為首選（兒童亦同），不應等檢驗結果才開始；Ixodes 蜱蟲可同時傳播 Lyme disease 與 Babesia。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 Döhle bodies、toxic granulation 或覆蓋在中性球上的血小板混淆；Döhle body 為胞質邊緣淡藍均質斑塊，morula 則是深藍紫色、由細小顆粒緊密聚成的點狀團塊。

quiz.q: 圖中中性球胞質內桑椹狀的深色包涵體稱為什麼？首選的治療藥物為何？
quiz.a: Morula（Anaplasma phagocytophilum）；doxycycline

15113.recognize_zh: 舌背、舌側與舌腹可見白色網狀（reticular）條紋與斑塊，伴隨舌乳頭萎縮與紅斑，唇緣也發紅，是口腔 cGVHD 的苔蘚樣（lichenoid）表現，屬 NIH 口腔 cGVHD 的診斷性徵象。
features: Lacy reticular white striae and plaques on the dorsal tongue (panels A, D)
Reticular white keratosis on the lateral and ventral tongue (panels B, C)
Patchy depapillation and erythema between keratotic striae
Yellowish coating over the posterior dorsum in panel A
Erythematous lips/vermilion in panel D
15113.describe_en: Clinical photographs of the tongue in four patients with chronic graft-versus-host disease. The dorsal, lateral, and ventral surfaces show lacy reticular white striae and confluent white keratotic plaques set against patchy erythema and papillary atrophy. Panel A additionally shows a yellowish surface coating posteriorly, and panel D shows erythema of the lips. No exophytic mass or deep ulcer is seen. Findings are consistent with lichenoid oral cGVHD, a diagnostic manifestation by NIH consensus criteria.

ddx.vs: Morphologically near-identical lichenoid striae; distinction rests on transplant history and concurrent cGVHD in other organs rather than appearance.
Candida forms removable curd-like plaques or erythematous atrophy with fungal elements on smear, whereas lichenoid striae are fixed and reticular.
Hairy leukoplakia shows vertically corrugated white plaques confined to the lateral tongue and EBV positivity, not reticular lacy striae across the dorsum.
A homogeneous or verrucous fixed plaque without reticular pattern, or a persistent nonhealing area, warrants biopsy to exclude dysplasia, a recognized late risk in oral cGVHD.

2633.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中，有幾顆紅血球（含一顆偏多染性者）細胞質內散布著明顯的藍紫色粗大點狀顆粒（coarse basophilic stippling），其餘紅血球大致正常，這種粗點彩在鉛中毒時很典型。
features: Red cells containing coarse, dark blue-purple punctate granules distributed through the cytoplasm (coarse basophilic stippling)
Stippled cells are slightly polychromatic and similar in size to neighboring red cells
Occasional poikilocytes including fragments, an elongated cell, and a stomatocyte-like cell
Most red cells are normochromic with central pallor
Scattered platelets; no leukocytes in the field
2633.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a mostly normochromic red cell population with scattered cells exhibiting coarse basophilic stippling, seen as numerous dark blue punctate granules distributed through the cytoplasm of slightly polychromatic erythrocytes. Mild poikilocytosis with occasional fragments and elongated forms is present. No nucleated red cells or abnormal leukocytes are seen in this field. Coarse basophilic stippling, reflecting aggregated ribosomal RNA from pyrimidine 5'-nucleotidase inhibition, is suggestive of lead poisoning in the appropriate clinical setting; blood lead level measurement is recommended.

ddx.vs: Thalassemia also shows basophilic stippling but with pronounced microcytosis, hypochromia, and target cells on a background of otherwise abnormal indices.
Hereditary P5'N deficiency produces identical stippling and hemolysis but with normal blood lead and a congenital history.
Pappenheimer bodies are fewer, small clustered granules at the cell periphery that stain with Prussian blue, rather than evenly dispersed iron-negative stippling.
Precipitate lies on top of cells and in the background in variable focal planes rather than being confined within individual erythrocytes.

exam.answer_en: Lead poisoning — coarse basophilic stippling of red cells (aggregated ribosomal RNA)
pearls_zh: 考法：指著紅血球內深藍點狀顆粒問是什麼 → coarse basophilic stippling；再問常見原因：鉛中毒、thalassemia、pyrimidine 5'-nucleotidase 缺乏。
機轉：鉛抑制 pyrimidine 5'-nucleotidase 使 RNA 降解障礙而形成點彩；同時抑制 ALA dehydratase 與 ferrochelatase，使 zinc protoporphyrin 升高並出現 ring sideroblasts。
檢查：確診以血中鉛濃度為準；血中 ZPP 升高、尿中 ALA 增加可作輔助，貧血多為輕度小球性或正球性。
臨床：腹絞痛、周邊運動神經病變（wrist drop）、兒童認知發展受損、牙齦 Burton line；治療首要移除暴露源，嚴重者以螯合劑（如 succimer、CaNa2EDTA）治療。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 Pappenheimer bodies 混淆；Pappenheimer bodies 為少數聚在細胞一側的含鐵顆粒（Prussian blue 陽性），點彩則是均勻散布全細胞的 RNA 顆粒、鐵染色陰性。

quiz.q: 這些紅血球內散布的藍色點狀顆粒稱為什麼？鉛抑制的哪一個酵素直接造成此現象？
quiz.a: Coarse basophilic stippling；pyrimidine 5'-nucleotidase

3785.recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血液抹片中每個視野都有十多顆分葉與帶狀嗜中性球，白血球明顯增加且以成熟嗜中性球為主，未見母細胞，符合嗜中性球增多（neutrophilia）。
features: Markedly increased leukocytes for a low-power field, composed predominantly of segmented and band neutrophils
Neutrophils with mature clumped chromatin; several show pinkish-purple cytoplasmic granules, but toxic granulation and Dohle bodies are not well resolved at this power
No blasts or immature myeloid precursors identified in this field
Red cells with scattered echinocytes/crenated forms, likely drying artifact
Platelets present
3785.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low magnification shows a marked increase in white blood cells, composed predominantly of mature segmented neutrophils and band forms. No blasts, promyelocytes or myelocytes are identified in this field, and basophilia is not evident. Toxic granulation and Dohle bodies, if present, require higher magnification for assessment. Red cells show scattered crenated forms, likely artifactual. Findings are consistent with neutrophilia, most often reactive (infection, inflammation, corticosteroids); correlation with the absolute count and clinical history is recommended.

ddx.vs: CML shows a left-shifted spectrum with a myelocyte bulge, basophilia and eosinophilia, rather than a predominantly mature neutrophil population.
CNL shows sustained mature neutrophilia (often without toxic changes) with CSF3R mutation, and requires exclusion of reactive causes.
Leukemoid reactions show more pronounced left shift with toxic granulation and Dohle bodies and a high LAP score, reflecting an extreme reactive response.
Leukoerythroblastosis shows immature myeloid cells together with nucleated red cells and teardrop cells, which are absent here.

3465.recognize_zh: 免疫組織化學染色中，成片細胞呈強而完整的細胞膜（棕色）陽性，核卵圓淡染、部分可見凹陷；配合 LCH 形態，這種瀰漫的膜陽性型態符合 CD1a 或 langerin 陽性的蘭格漢斯細胞。
features: Diffuse, strong brown membranous and cytoplasmic staining in sheets of lesional cells
Unstained oval to reniform nuclei (hematoxylin counterstain), some with indentations
Scattered negative cells, including small lymphocytes and larger pale histiocytes
Marker not labeled; the diffuse membranous pattern in a LCH lesion corresponds to CD1a (or langerin)
3465.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain (marker not specified) shows diffuse strong membranous and cytoplasmic positivity in sheets of lesional cells with oval to reniform, focally indented nuclei. Scattered small lymphocytes and occasional larger histiocytes are negative. In the context of Langerhans cell histiocytosis, this pattern is typical of CD1a or langerin (CD207) expression, although the antibody cannot be confirmed from the image. Findings support the diagnosis of Langerhans cell histiocytosis.

ddx.vs: Rosai-Dorfman histiocytes are S100-positive but CD1a- and langerin-negative.
Indeterminate cells are CD1a- and S100-positive but langerin-negative and lack Birbeck granules.
These histiocytes express CD68/CD163 and factor XIIIa and are CD1a-negative.
T-LBL can be CD1a-positive but is TdT- and CD3-positive with blastic chromatin rather than grooved histiocytoid nuclei.

3529.recognize_zh: 兩顆巨大細胞各含 4 個彼此分離、大小一致的圓至卵圓形細胞核，細胞質豐富呈藍灰色帶細小顆粒、邊緣不規則，這是蝕骨細胞（osteoclast），而非核融合分葉的巨核細胞。
features: Two giant multinucleated cells, each with about four separate, uniform round-to-oval nuclei
Nuclei are discrete (not interconnected lobes) with fine chromatin and small nucleoli
Abundant blue-gray cytoplasm with fine azurophilic granules and irregular frayed borders
No platelet budding from cell margins
Background erythrocytes, a neutrophil and a few myeloid cells
3529.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows two large multinucleated cells, each containing several separate, uniform, round nuclei set in abundant finely granular blue-gray cytoplasm with irregular borders. The nuclei do not overlap or connect as a single lobulated mass, and there is no platelet budding. These features identify osteoclasts, which should not be confused with megakaryocytes.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocyte nuclei are lobulated and interconnected into a single polyploid nucleus with pink granular cytoplasm, rather than multiple discrete round nuclei.
Osteoblasts are mononuclear with an eccentric nucleus and a perinuclear hof, often in clusters, not giant multinucleated cells.
Carcinoma cells form cohesive clusters of separate cells with pleomorphic nuclei and distinct cell borders, not a single cytoplasmic syncytium with uniform nuclei.
Histiocytic giant cells usually have vacuolated or phagocytic cytoplasm and occur with granulomatous inflammation; morphologic overlap may require clinical context.

exam.answer_en: Osteoclasts (megakaryocyte look-alike) — giant cells with multiple separate, uniform round nuclei and granular grey-blue cytoplasm
pearls_zh: 考法：look-alike 題，考官問這是 megakaryocyte 還是 osteoclast；關鍵在核：osteoclast 多顆「彼此分離、大小一致」的核，megakaryocyte 為單一分葉核。
來源與標記：osteoclast 來自單核球/巨噬細胞系，CD68+、TRAP+；megakaryocyte 為 CD61、CD42b 陽性。
臨床：osteoclast 在兒童骨髓、骨重塑增加時較常見，如 hyperparathyroidism、Paget disease、轉移癌造成的骨破壞；常與 osteoblast 同時出現。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 MDS 中核分離的發育不良 megakaryocyte（separated nuclear lobes）：後者核大小不一、胞質為產血小板的細顆粒且缺乏 osteoclast 那種大小一致多核；必要時 CD61 IHC 區分。

quiz.q: 圖中巨大細胞含 4 個分離且大小一致的核，是 megakaryocyte 還是 osteoclast？用哪個 IHC 可區分？
quiz.a: Osteoclast；CD61（megakaryocyte 陽性，osteoclast 陰性），或 TRAP/CD68 支持 osteoclast。

2121.recognize_zh: 低倍淋巴結切片中淋巴濾泡不明顯，副皮質區（paracortex）大幅擴張，並可見許多明顯的高內皮小靜脈與血管分支穿行其中，淋巴結結構大致保留，符合 ALPS 的副皮質增生型態。
features: Lymph node with intact thin capsule at the right edge
Marked expansion of the paracortex/interfollicular zones by densely packed lymphoid cells
Prominent branching vessels (likely high endothelial venules) running through the expanded paracortex
Few discernible secondary follicles at this magnification
Overall nodal architecture preserved without sheets of large atypical cells
2121.describe_en: Low-power lymph node section (H&E) shows a preserved capsule with marked expansion of the paracortex and interfollicular areas by a dense lymphoid population traversed by prominent branching vessels, consistent with high endothelial venules. Secondary follicles are inconspicuous at this magnification, and no sheets of overtly atypical large cells are identified, although cytologic detail cannot be evaluated at this power. The pattern of florid paracortical hyperplasia is consistent with autoimmune lymphoproliferative syndrome in the appropriate clinical and flow cytometric context (increased CD3+ TCRαβ+ CD4- CD8- double-negative T cells).

ddx.vs: PTCL shows effacement by atypical T cells with loss of pan-T antigens and a clonal TCR rearrangement, whereas ALPS double-negative T cells are polyclonal and cytologically bland.
Viral hyperplasia contains many immunoblasts with EBER positivity and lacks expanded double-negative T cells.
RDD is sinus-based with large S100-positive histiocytes and emperipolesis, which may coexist with ALPS but are not evident here.
Identified by CD30+/CD15+ Hodgkin-Reed-Sternberg cells at higher power.

1545.recognize_zh: 高倍血片中紅血球明顯大小不一，許多是比正常大的卵圓形巨紅血球（macro-ovalocytes），並有淚滴狀紅血球（箭頭所指尖端）與小碎片，這種大小與形狀不等（anisopoikilocytosis）是惡性貧血等巨母細胞性貧血的血片表現。
features: Marked anisocytosis with large oval red cells (macro-ovalocytes) exceeding normal red cell size
Poikilocytosis including a teardrop-shaped cell with tapered end (arrow)
Small irregular red cell fragments and microcytic forms
Most red cells retain central pallor; no polychromasia evident
No leukocytes in this field to assess neutrophil segmentation
1545.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at high power shows marked anisopoikilocytosis with large oval macrocytes (macro-ovalocytes), a teardrop cell (arrow), and scattered small fragmented red cells. Polychromasia is not evident. No leukocytes are present in the field for evaluation of hypersegmentation. Findings are suggestive of megaloblastic anemia such as pernicious anemia; correlation with MCV, vitamin B12 levels, and neutrophil morphology is recommended.

ddx.vs: These produce round macrocytes and target cells without marked poikilocytosis or macro-ovalocytes.
Myelofibrosis shows prominent teardrop cells with leukoerythroblastosis and usually normocytic red cells, rather than predominant macro-ovalocytes.
Reticulocyte-driven macrocytosis shows blue-grey polychromatophilic cells, which are not seen here.
MDS can show macro-ovalocytes but has normal B12/folate and dysplastic neutrophils such as pseudo-Pelger cells rather than hypersegmentation.

exam.answer_en: Megaloblastic anemia (pernicious anemia) — marked anisopoikilocytosis with macro-ovalocytes, teardrop cells and red cell fragments
pearls_zh: 考法：高倍血片問「描述紅血球形態」；需同時說出 macro-ovalocytes、teardrop cells 與小碎片，並指出這種大小形狀不一（高 RDW）支持 megaloblastic anemia。
嚴重巨母細胞性貧血可有明顯 poikilocytosis 與碎片，使 MCV 被小碎片拉低；因此 MCV 正常也不能排除，要看血片與 RDW。
Pernicious anemia 為自體免疫性 atrophic gastritis 致 intrinsic factor 缺乏；查 anti-intrinsic factor antibody、gastrin，並注意胃 neuroendocrine tumor 與胃癌風險。
無效造血造成的溶血樣表現：LDH 常明顯升高、indirect bilirubin 上升、haptoglobin 低，但 reticulocyte 偏低，與周邊溶血不同。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤判為 primary myelofibrosis（teardrop cells）或 TMA（碎片）；PMF 多為正球性並有 leukoerythroblastosis，TMA 碎片伴血小板低下，這裡主角是 macro-ovalocytes。

quiz.q: 此血片可見卵圓形巨紅血球、淚滴細胞與碎片，請寫出最可能診斷及一項確認用的血清檢查。
quiz.a: Megaloblastic anemia（如 pernicious anemia）；serum B12（或 methylmalonic acid、anti-intrinsic factor antibody）

2249.recognize_zh: 低倍淋巴結可見大片不規則、地圖狀（geographic）的淡粉紅色區域，包圍並切割深藍色的殘存淋巴組織，呈星芒狀輪廓，左上角仍有一個淋巴濾泡；這種地圖狀淡染的壞死或肉芽腫性發炎區是化膿性肉芽腫性淋巴結炎（如兔熱病）的低倍特徵。
features: Low-power lymph node with large, irregular, geographic pale eosinophilic zones
Pale zones have stellate, serpiginous borders and surround darker residual lymphoid tissue
Residual lymphoid follicle preserved at upper left
Pale areas appear histiocyte-rich and hypocellular, consistent with granulomatous or necrotizing inflammation
Cytologic detail such as neutrophils or necrosis cannot be resolved at this magnification
2249.describe_en: Low-power lymph node section shows partial effacement of the architecture by large, irregular, geographic pale eosinophilic zones with stellate borders, surrounding islands of darker residual lymphoid tissue. A residual follicle is present at the upper left. At this magnification the pale zones appear histiocyte-rich and hypocellular, consistent with granulomatous and necrotizing inflammation, but cellular detail cannot be resolved. In the appropriate clinical context, findings are consistent with necrotizing granulomatous lymphadenitis such as tularemia; higher-power examination, special stains, and microbiologic studies are required.

ddx.vs: Cat-scratch disease has the same low-power stellate microabscess pattern, so it requires Bartonella immunostain or serology to separate.

ddx.dx: Classic Hodgkin lymphoma, nodular sclerosis type
ddx.vs: Nodular sclerosis shows nodules separated by birefringent collagen bands containing lacunar Reed-Sternberg cells, rather than pale histiocytic or necrotic zones.
These show caseating granulomas with giant cells and organisms on AFB or GMS stains.

1289.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中巨核細胞明顯增多並彼此緊貼成群（clusters），核大小不一、深染，呈雲朵狀或球狀（cloud-like/bulbous），部分核漿比偏高，旁邊有骨小樑與散在含鐵血黃素；這種異型巨核細胞緊密聚集是原發性骨髓纖維化（PMF）的特徵。
features: Increased megakaryocytes forming tight clusters of several cells
Marked variation in megakaryocyte size with hyperchromatic, irregularly folded, cloud-like or bulbous nuclei
Some megakaryocytes with increased N:C ratio and abnormal chromatin clumping
Hypercellular marrow with background granulocytic proliferation
Scattered hemosiderin-laden macrophages; adjacent bony trabecula
1289.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a hypercellular marrow with a proliferation of megakaryocytes forming tight clusters. The megakaryocytes vary markedly in size and have hyperchromatic, irregularly folded, cloud-like or bulbous nuclei, with some showing increased nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios. The background shows granulocytic proliferation, scattered hemosiderin-laden macrophages and an adjacent bony trabecula. Fibrosis cannot be graded on H&E alone. These atypical clustered megakaryocytes are characteristic of primary myelofibrosis, and a reticulin stain and JAK2/CALR/MPL testing are needed for grading and classification.

ddx.vs: ET megakaryocytes are large to giant with hyperlobulated staghorn nuclei and are loosely scattered, without the hyperchromatic cloud-like nuclei and tight clustering seen here.
PV shows panmyelosis with pleomorphic megakaryocytes of variable size but less nuclear atypia and prominent erythroid proliferation, together with erythrocytosis.
MDS megakaryocytes are small and hypolobated or with separated lobes, with dysplasia in other lineages, rather than large hyperchromatic cloud-like forms.
Increased CD34-positive blasts (>=20%) and small dysplastic megakaryocytes favor acute panmyelosis over PMF.

exam.answer_en: Primary myelofibrosis — tight clusters of atypical megakaryocytes with hyperchromatic, cloud-like/bulbous nuclei in hypercellular marrow
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指著緊密成群、核深染如雲朵的巨核細胞問屬於哪一種 MPN；答 PMF，並要比較 ET（大型、過度分葉 staghorn、鬆散分布）與 PV（多形性、大小不一）。
Driver mutations：JAK2 V617F、CALR、MPL，三者互斥；三者皆陰性稱 triple-negative，須找其他 clonal marker（如 ASXL1、EZH2、TET2）。
必做 reticulin 與 trichrome 染色分級（MF-0 至 MF-3）：pre-fibrotic PMF 為 MF-0/1，overt PMF 為 MF-2/3；pre-PMF 常被誤診為 ET。
預後以 DIPSS/MIPSS70 評估，ASXL1、SRSF2、U2AF1 Q157、EZH2、IDH1/2 屬 high-molecular-risk；症狀與脾腫大可用 ruxolitinib 等 JAK inhibitor。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常與 ET 混淆：ET 巨核細胞大而成熟、核過度分葉、多散在不成緊密簇，細胞量正常；PMF 巨核細胞異型、核質比高、成緊密群聚且常伴顆粒球增生。

quiz.q: PMF 的三個互斥 driver mutation 基因是哪些？
quiz.a: JAK2（V617F）、CALR、MPL

1097.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片免疫組織化學染色中，大多數細胞胞質呈顆粒狀棕色陽性，陰性細胞零散夾雜，代表骨髓幾乎被骨髓性/單核球性細胞取代，符合 JMML 的骨髓表現。
features: Densely cellular marrow with diffuse granular brown cytoplasmic staining in most cells
Positive cells show coarse granular cytoplasmic pattern typical of myeloid/monocytic markers
Interspersed negative cells with blue hematoxylin-stained nuclei (likely erythroid or lymphoid)
Some strongly stained cells with dark, condensed or indented nuclei
No fat spaces in this field
1097.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain of a hypercellular bone marrow biopsy shows diffuse granular cytoplasmic positivity in the majority of cells, with scattered interspersed negative cells. The staining pattern is typical of a myeloid or monocytic marker (such as myeloperoxidase or lysozyme), although the specific antibody is not stated. The findings indicate that the marrow is largely occupied by myelomonocytic cells, consistent with juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia in context; CD34 staining would be needed to assess blast percentage.

ddx.vs: AML shows sheets of CD34/CD117-positive blasts, which must be enumerated separately from the myeloid marker stain.
CML marrow is similarly myeloid-rich but has small hypolobated megakaryocytes and BCR::ABL1 fusion.
Lymphoblasts would be negative for myeloid markers and positive for TdT and lymphoid antigens.

1097.stain: IHC (likely MPO or lysozyme; not specified)

4233.recognize_zh: 密集的異常前骨髓球，胞質含紫紅色顆粒、核摺疊；箭頭指的細胞胞質中隱約可見覆蓋在核上的細條棒狀結構，疑為成束的 Auer 小體（faggot cell），但此解析度難以完全確認。
features: Densely packed abnormal promyelocytes with folded, reniform, or bilobed nuclei
Cytoplasm with abundant fine azurophilic granules and granular background
Arrowed cell shows faint linear rod-like structures overlying the nucleus, suggestive of bundled Auer rods (faggot cell)
Monotonous infiltrate with little normal hematopoietic maturation
4233.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a dense population of abnormal promyelocytes with folded to bilobed nuclei and granular cytoplasm. The arrowed cell contains faint linear cytoplasmic structures overlapping the nucleus, suggestive of multiple Auer rods in a bundle (faggot cell), although this is not unequivocal at the current resolution. Normal maturing myeloid and erythroid elements are scant. Findings are consistent with acute promyelocytic leukemia; confirmation by PML::RARA FISH or RT-PCR is required.

ddx.vs: Blasts in t(8;21) usually contain a single, long, slender Auer rod and a perinuclear hof with maturing dysplastic neutrophils, not bundles of Auer rods in bilobed promyelocytes.
The microgranular variant has bilobed nuclei but sparse visible granules, whereas these cells are overtly hypergranular; both carry PML::RARA.
Reactive promyelocytes have round nuclei with a Golgi hof and a full maturation sequence, and never contain Auer rods.

exam.answer_en: Acute promyelocytic leukemia — abnormal promyelocytes with bilobed nuclei; arrowed cell suggestive of a faggot cell (bundled Auer rods)
pearls_zh: 考法：指箭頭細胞問「這種含成束 Auer rods 的細胞叫什麼？」答 faggot cell，幾乎專屬於 APL。
確診：PML::RARA 以 FISH（快速）或 RT-PCR 確認；RT-PCR 也用於分辨 bcr1/2/3 transcript 與後續 MRD 追蹤。
Variant RARA 夥伴基因：ZBTB16::RARA（t(11;17)）對 ATRA 與 arsenic 反應差，是常考的例外。
Microgranular variant（M3v）：顆粒少、核雙葉，WBC 常高、常伴 FLT3-ITD 與 CD2 表現，形態易漏診但 MPO 仍強陽性。
exam.pitfall_zh: 成束 Auer rods 若看不清易當成 AML with t(8;21) 的單根 Auer rod；t(8;21) 母細胞核非雙葉、有 perinuclear hof 並伴成熟中的發育不良中性球。

quiz.q: 箭頭所指含成束棒狀結構的細胞稱為什麼？代表何種白血病？
quiz.a: Faggot cell；acute promyelocytic leukemia（PML::RARA）

1033.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央一團相黏的單核細胞，有的核深染較小、有的核較大且染色質細緻，細胞質淡藍；此視野看不到含被吞噬血球的組織球，無法僅憑此圖確認噬血現象。
features: Aggregate of mononuclear cells with overlapping nuclei in the center of the field
Mixture of smaller cells with dense chromatin and larger cells with fine, open chromatin
Scant to moderate pale blue cytoplasm with indistinct cell borders
Scattered single mononuclear and plasmacytoid cells in the background
No macrophage containing ingested red cells or nucleated cells in this field
1033.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows an aggregate of mononuclear cells with overlapping nuclei, composed of smaller cells with dense chromatin admixed with larger cells with fine chromatin and pale cytoplasm. Scattered single mononuclear cells are present in the background. No definite hemophagocytic histiocyte is identified in this field. The image does not by itself demonstrate hemophagocytosis; the aggregate most likely represents clumped marrow cells, but a non-hematopoietic cluster should be excluded by review of other fields and ancillary studies.

ddx.vs: Metastatic clusters are truly cohesive with nuclear molding and cells larger or more atypical than marrow elements, and are CD45-negative/keratin or neuroendocrine marker positive.
Hematogones and blasts are confirmed by flow cytometry (CD10/CD19/TdT spectrum versus aberrant blasts) rather than by aggregation pattern.
Diagnosis rests on macrophages containing engulfed hematopoietic cells plus clinical criteria, not shown in this field.

4105.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中一顆淋巴球胞質量中等且淡藍，含少數細小嗜天青顆粒，核偏位、染色質濃縮，這是大顆粒淋巴球（LGL）；若持續 >2×10⁹/L 或具克隆性，需考慮 T-LGL 白血病。
features: Lymphocyte slightly larger than a small lymphocyte
Moderate to abundant pale blue cytoplasm
Few fine azurophilic granules in the cytoplasm
Round to oval, slightly eccentric nucleus with condensed chromatin and no nucleoli
Background red cells without significant abnormality
4105.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a single large granular lymphocyte with a round-to-oval eccentric nucleus, condensed chromatin, and moderate pale blue cytoplasm containing a few fine azurophilic granules. The surrounding red cells show no significant morphologic abnormality. A single LGL is not diagnostic in itself; a sustained LGL count above 2 x 10^9/L with a clonal CD3+/CD8+/CD57+ population and STAT3 mutation would be consistent with T-cell large granular lymphocytic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Reactive LGLs look identical and are distinguished only by lack of clonality (TRG/TRB) and a transient course.

ddx.dx: Chronic lymphoproliferative disorder of NK cells
ddx.vs: NK-cell LGLs are CD3-negative (surface) and CD16+/CD56+, which requires flow cytometry rather than morphology.
Aggressive NK leukemia cells are larger with more open chromatin, nucleoli and basophilic cytoplasm, often EBV-positive.
Monocytes are larger with folded nuclei, lacy chromatin and grey-blue vacuolated cytoplasm with fine dusty granules.

exam.answer_en: Large granular lymphocyte — lymphocyte with moderate pale blue cytoplasm and fine azurophilic granules
pearls_zh: 考法：問「這顆淋巴球與小淋巴球差在哪？」答胞質較多且含 azurophilic granules，屬 cytotoxic T 或 NK 細胞。
判斷是否為 LGL leukemia：持續（通常 >6 個月）的 LGL 增多加上克隆性；計數門檻常用 >2×10⁹/L，但較低數量合併典型臨床與克隆性仍可診斷。
T-LGL（CD3+ CD8+ CD57+）與 chronic lymphoproliferative disorder of NK cells（CD3− CD16+ CD56+）多屬 indolent；aggressive NK-cell leukemia 與 EBV 相關、病程兇猛。
臨床常見 neutropenia、脾腫大、自體免疫疾病（尤其 RA）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把 LGL 當成單核球或反應性淋巴球：LGL 核染色質緻密、胞質透明淡藍含清楚顆粒；單核球核摺疊、胞質灰藍毛玻璃狀且常有空泡。

quiz.q: 圖中淋巴球的胞質顆粒屬哪一種？代表此細胞的功能為何？
quiz.a: Azurophilic granules（含 perforin/granzyme）；cytotoxic T 或 NK 細胞

4169.recognize_zh: 整片骨髓抹片幾乎都是各階段的顆粒球系細胞（骨髓球、後骨髓球、帶狀核與分葉核嗜中性球），有核紅血球前驅細胞非常少，因此骨髓/紅血球比（M:E ratio）明顯升高。
features: Hypercellular smear dominated by granulocytic cells at all stages of maturation
Abundant myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands and segmented neutrophils with orderly maturation
Scattered eosinophils with orange granules
Very few erythroid precursors (only occasional dark round-nucleus normoblasts), indicating a markedly increased M:E ratio
No increase in blasts evident; no obvious dysplasia at this magnification
4169.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is hypercellular with a marked predominance of granulocytic elements showing orderly maturation from myelocytes to segmented neutrophils, with scattered eosinophils. Erythroid precursors are sparse, resulting in a markedly increased myeloid-to-erythroid ratio. Blasts are not increased and no significant dysgranulopoiesis is evident at this magnification. Findings are consistent with granulocytic hyperplasia with increased M:E ratio, which may reflect infection or inflammation, growth factor effect, erythroid suppression, or a myeloproliferative neoplasm; clinical and CBC correlation is required.

ddx.vs: Shows a myelocyte peak with basophilia, eosinophilia and small hypolobated megakaryocytes and requires BCR::ABL1 demonstration.
The increased M:E ratio results from absent erythroid precursors with normal rather than increased granulopoiesis and reticulocytopenia.
Shows predominance of mature segmented neutrophils with peripheral neutrophilia and CSF3R mutation.
Requires at least 20% blasts, often with Auer rods, rather than mostly maturing granulocytes.

4041.recognize_zh: 多顆大型單核芽細胞，細胞核圓、染色質細緻、有核仁，細胞質豐富灰藍並有許多小空泡，左上方的芽細胞貼附/包入紅血球；左側可見一個有絲分裂像，符合伴紅血球吞噬的急性單核芽細胞白血病。
features: Numerous large blasts with abundant gray-blue cytoplasm containing fine vacuoles
Round to oval nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin and visible nucleoli
Red cells intimately associated with and partially enclosed by blast cytoplasm (left-center cluster), suggestive of erythrophagocytosis
Mitotic figure with condensed chromosomes at left
Few residual normal cells; one degenerating granulocyte at upper left
4041.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows numerous large blasts with abundant gray-blue, finely vacuolated cytoplasm, round nuclei with delicate chromatin, and distinct nucleoli, consistent with monoblasts. Some blasts are closely apposed to or partially enclose red blood cells, suggestive of erythrophagocytosis, and a mitotic figure is present. Residual normal hematopoietic elements are sparse. Findings are consistent with acute monoblastic leukemia (FAB AML-M5a) with erythrophagocytosis; nonspecific esterase, flow cytometry (CD14, CD64, CD11c), and cytogenetics for t(8;16) are recommended.

ddx.vs: Benign histiocytes have abundant cytoplasm with condensed, kidney-shaped nuclei without nucleoli, and are not accompanied by sheets of blasts.
Contains a substantial granulocytic component (at least 20% neutrophils and precursors) and MPO-positive myeloblasts in addition to monocytic cells.
Carcinoma cells form cohesive clusters with nuclear molding and are keratin-positive and CD45-negative.
Immature plasma cells have eccentric nuclei and a perinuclear hof and express CD138 rather than monocytic markers.

exam.answer_en: Acute monoblastic leukemia (FAB M5a) with erythrophagocytosis by blasts — large vacuolated gray-blue monoblasts engulfing red cells
pearls_zh: 考法：考官會指「細胞質包住紅血球的大型芽細胞」問這是什麼現象，答 blast 的 erythrophagocytosis；接著追問要想到哪個 translocation。
芽細胞吞噬紅血球的 AML 經典關聯是 t(8;16)(p11;p13) KAT6A::CREBBP，常為單核球分化、合併 DIC 與髓外（皮膚）浸潤。
細胞化學：nonspecific esterase（α-naphthyl butyrate）陽性且可被 NaF 抑制；monoblast 的 MPO 常為陰性或弱陽性。Flow 表現 CD14、CD64、CD11b、CD4、lysozyme。
單核球性 AML 臨床常見牙齦增生、皮膚與 CNS 浸潤、高白血球；也常與 KMT2A rearrangement 相關，需做染色體與分子檢查。
FAB M5a 是 monoblast 佔單核系細胞 ≥80%；M5b 則以 promonocyte 與 monocyte 為主。注意 promonocyte 在計數時算作 blast equivalent。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為良性 hemophagocytic histiocyte（HLH）；本圖吞噬者是有細緻染色質、核仁且成片出現的芽細胞，而非核濃縮、無核仁的成熟組織球。

quiz.q: 圖中細胞質包住紅血球的芽細胞，最常與哪一個 AML 重複性染色體轉位相關？
quiz.a: t(8;16)(p11;p13), KAT6A::CREBBP（單核球分化 AML，常合併 DIC）

3977.recognize_zh: 高倍剛果紅（Congo red）染色可見小血管壁被一圈均質橘紅色沉積物環狀增厚（箭頭），內皮下與中膜被取代，周邊間質亦有同樣沉積；血管壁剛果紅陽性沉積是類澱粉沉積症的典型分布。
features: Small vessel with circumferential salmon-orange congophilic deposits replacing the media (arrow)
Residual patent lumen lined by flattened endothelial cells
Similar orange amorphous deposits in the adjacent interstitium and neighboring vessel
Scattered spindle and inflammatory cell nuclei in loose stroma
Polarization not shown
3977.describe_en: Congo red-stained section at high power shows a small vessel whose wall is concentrically thickened and replaced by homogeneous salmon-orange amorphous material (arrow), with a residual patent lumen. Similar congophilic deposits are present in the adjacent interstitium and around a neighboring vessel. Findings are consistent with vascular and interstitial amyloid deposition; apple-green birefringence under polarized light and amyloid typing are needed, with AL type favored in the context of multiple myeloma.

ddx.vs: Hyaline arteriolosclerosis is PAS positive but Congo red negative and lacks birefringence.

ddx.dx: Cerebral-type or senile vascular ATTR/Abeta amyloid
ddx.vs: These are equally congophilic in vessel walls; tissue site, clinical context and typing distinguish them from AL.
Fibrinoid necrosis shows brighter eosinophilic material with nuclear debris and inflammation of the vessel wall and is Congo red negative.

exam.answer_en: Amyloidosis (AL type favored in myeloma) — Congo red-positive salmon-orange deposits replacing small vessel walls and interstitium
pearls_zh: 考法：剛果紅切片指血管壁均質橘紅色沉積，問是什麼，並追問確認方法：偏光下 apple-green birefringence。
分型比形態更重要：AL 與 ATTR 治療完全不同，需以 mass spectrometry（LC-MS/MS）或免疫方法分型，不可只憑 myeloma 病史推定 AL。
AL amyloidosis 輕鏈 lambda 比 kappa 常見；檢查 serum free light chains、SPEP/IFE、骨髓切片，並評估心臟（NT-proBNP、troponin）與腎臟蛋白尿。
取組織：腹部脂肪抽吸是低侵入性篩檢；心臟侵犯是 AL 預後最重要決定因素。
AL 第一線治療常以 daratumumab 合併 CyBorD（cyclophosphamide、bortezomib、dexamethasone）為基礎，符合條件者可考慮 autologous SCT。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為高血壓/糖尿病的 hyaline arteriolosclerosis；後者 PAS 陽性但剛果紅陰性且無偏光雙折射，需以偏光確認。

quiz.q: 圖中血管壁剛果紅陽性的橘紅色沉積，在偏光顯微鏡下應呈現什麼特徵才能確認為 amyloid？
quiz.a: Apple-green birefringence（蘋果綠雙折射）

3209.recognize_zh: 組織切片中淡染的實質細胞索之間，擴張充血的血管／竇狀隙腔內塞滿大型異型淋巴細胞，而周圍實質中幾乎沒有腫瘤細胞，這種侷限於血管腔內的分布是血管內大B細胞淋巴瘤的線索。
features: Dilated, congested vascular spaces (sinusoids/capillaries) distended by red cells
Large atypical lymphoid cells packed within vascular lumina, with vesicular nuclei and visible nucleoli
Tumor cells confined to intravascular spaces with minimal extravascular infiltration
Intervening cords of pale polygonal parenchymal cells with eosinophilic cytoplasm
Diffuse, regularly repeating pattern of filled vessels across the field
3209.describe_en: Tissue section at medium power shows parenchymal cords of pale polygonal cells separated by markedly dilated, congested vascular spaces. The vascular lumina are filled with large atypical lymphoid cells having enlarged vesicular nuclei and occasional nucleoli, admixed with red cells.
