The neoplastic cells are largely restricted to the intravascular compartment without forming extravascular masses. Findings are consistent with intravascular large B-cell lymphoma; confirmation with CD20/PAX5 and CD34 (to highlight vessels) immunostains is recommended. The exact organ cannot be established with certainty from this image alone.

ddx.vs: Myeloid blasts are MPO/CD34/CD117 positive and usually also infiltrate the parenchyma, whereas IVLBCL cells are CD20-positive large B cells restricted to vessel lumina.
HSTCL has sinusoidal infiltration by monotonous medium-sized T cells (CD3+, CD5-, TCR gamma-delta) rather than large B cells.
EMH shows a mixed population of erythroid precursors, myeloid cells and megakaryocytes rather than monotonous large atypical lymphoid cells.
This rare mimic is CD20 negative and EBER/CD56 positive, requiring immunohistochemistry to separate it from IVLBCL.

exam.answer_en: Intravascular large B-cell lymphoma — dilated vascular spaces filled with large atypical lymphoid cells, parenchyma spared
pearls_zh: 考法：中倍組織切片考「分布型態」：規律重複的擴張血管內塞滿大細胞、實質索內沒有腫瘤，答 IVLBCL。
器官無法由本圖確定；IVLBCL 常侵犯皮膚、CNS、肺、腎、腎上腺、肝、骨髓，腫瘤常在活檢才意外發現。
確認：CD20/PAX5 陽性腫瘤 B 細胞位於 CD34 標出的血管內；CD5 可陽性。
鑑別 hepatosplenic T-cell lymphoma：竇狀隙內中型 T 細胞、CD3+ 且多為 γδ TCR，與 isochromosome 7q 相關。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為一般充血或白血病細胞侵犯竇狀隙；IVLBCL 細胞大、核空泡狀、CD20+ 且幾乎不進入實質。

quiz.q: 此切片腫瘤細胞主要分布在哪個腔室？最可能的診斷是？
quiz.a: 血管/竇狀隙腔內；Intravascular large B-cell lymphoma

3145.recognize_zh: 一群中等大小、形態單一的淋巴細胞，胞質深藍色且布滿大小一致、邊界清楚的圓形透明脂質空泡，核圓、染色質細點狀，這是Burkitt細胞（FAB L3）的典型樣貌。
features: Cluster of monotonous medium-sized lymphoid cells
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm containing numerous sharply punched-out round clear vacuoles
Vacuoles present in both cytoplasm and overlying the nucleus
Round to oval nuclei with finely stippled chromatin and small indistinct nucleoli
Moderate N:C ratio with a narrow but distinct rim of dark blue cytoplasm
3145.describe_en: Smear shows a cluster of monotonous medium-sized lymphoid cells with round nuclei, finely stippled chromatin and small nucleoli. The cells have a rim of deeply basophilic cytoplasm studded with numerous sharply defined round clear vacuoles, some overlying the nucleus. Findings are consistent with Burkitt lymphoma/leukemia (FAB L3 morphology); confirmation of a mature B-cell immunophenotype (CD10+, BCL2 negative, Ki-67 near 100%) and MYC rearrangement is required.

ddx.vs: B-ALL blasts may have occasional vacuoles but have scant pale cytoplasm and are TdT positive and surface immunoglobulin negative, unlike TdT-negative, sIg-positive Burkitt cells.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma / high-grade B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: DLBCL cells are larger and more pleomorphic, and double-hit lymphoma requires FISH for MYC with BCL2 and/or BCL6 rearrangements.
Monoblasts have more abundant gray-blue cytoplasm with irregular vacuoles and folded nuclei and are MPO/NSE and CD14/CD64 positive.

exam.answer_en: Burkitt leukemia/lymphoma — monotonous medium lymphoid cells with deeply basophilic, sharply vacuolated cytoplasm (L3)
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指深藍胞質內的透亮圓空泡，問「空泡內是什麼、是哪個 FAB 型」；答 lipid vacuoles（Oil Red O+）、FAB L3。
遺傳：MYC 重組，最常 t(8;14) IG H::MYC，其次 t(2;8)（kappa）、t(8;22)（lambda）。
表型：成熟 B 細胞 CD19+、CD20+、CD10+、BCL6+、sIg+、TdT−、BCL2 陰性或弱；Ki-67 接近 100%。
急症：腫瘤生長極快，易 tumor lysis syndrome（高尿酸、高鉀、高磷、低鈣、AKI），化療前需水化與 rasburicase；治療採高強度短程化療含 CNS 預防。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為帶空泡的 B-ALL；B-ALL 胞質淡少、TdT+ 且 sIg−，Burkitt 胞質深藍、空泡多且 TdT− sIg+。

quiz.q: 此類深藍胞質帶許多透亮空泡的淋巴細胞，最典型的染色體易位是什麼？

3081.recognize_zh: 胸水中一大團黏著的上皮樣細胞（核圓偏位、胞質空泡化），邊緣與團內可見三顆胞質佈滿紫紅色異染性顆粒的肥大細胞。
features: Large cohesive cluster of epithelioid cells with round eccentric nuclei and abundant vacuolated blue cytoplasm
Mast cell at lower left and another at right edge with cytoplasm packed with purple-red metachromatic granules
Additional mast cell with dense granules within the cluster
Dark crushed nuclear material and small lymphocytes within and around the cluster
No significant nuclear pleomorphism evident at this magnification
3081.describe_en: Pleural fluid cytocentrifuge preparation shows a large cohesive cluster of epithelioid cells with round eccentric nuclei and abundant vacuolated basophilic cytoplasm. Mast cells with cytoplasm filled with purple-red metachromatic granules are present at the edges and within the cluster, and small lymphocytes and crushed nuclei are interspersed. Marked nuclear pleomorphism is not evident in this field. Findings demonstrate mast cells in pleural fluid; the epithelioid cluster requires immunocytochemistry to distinguish reactive mesothelial cells from metastatic carcinoma.

ddx.vs: Basophils are smaller with segmented nuclei and fewer, coarser granules.

ddx.dx: Reactive mesothelial cells vs metastatic carcinoma
ddx.vs: Mesothelial cells are calretinin/WT1-positive with intercellular windows, whereas carcinoma is claudin-4/MOC-31/BerEP4-positive.
Siderophages contain refractile golden-brown or blue-black pigment that is Prussian blue positive.

3017.recognize_zh: 抹片中數個小至中型、幾乎沒有細胞質的圓形芽細胞，核染色質均勻細緻、無顆粒，背景紅血球有明顯的水分乾燥假影（折光小泡），符合前 B 淋巴芽細胞白血病。
features: Small-to-medium round blasts, about 1.5 times RBC diameter
Extremely high N:C ratio with barely visible cytoplasm
Round to oval nuclei with finely stippled, homogeneous chromatin
Nucleoli inconspicuous; no granules or Auer rods
Background RBCs show refractile water/drying artifact; one smaller cell with denser chromatin at top right
3017.describe_en: Smear shows several small-to-medium sized blasts with an extremely high N:C ratio and scant, agranular cytoplasm. The nuclei are round to oval with finely stippled homogeneous chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. No Auer rods are identified. Surrounding red cells show prominent refractile water (drying) artifact, which should not be mistaken for inclusions. Findings are consistent with lymphoblasts of precursor B-lymphoblastic leukemia, with lineage confirmed by flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: Mature lymphocytes have coarse clumped chromatin, whereas these blasts have fine homogeneous chromatin.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with minimal differentiation
ddx.vs: AML blasts are usually larger with more cytoplasm and nucleoli and are negative for CD19/CD10/TdT-B pattern while expressing CD13/CD33/CD117.
Morphologically identical; cytoplasmic CD3 expression and lack of CD19/CD79a define T lineage.

exam.answer_en: B-lymphoblastic leukemia — circulating small-to-medium blasts with scant agranular cytoplasm and fine chromatin; RBC drying artifact in background
pearls_zh: 考法：周邊血母細胞，考官先問「成熟淋巴球還是 blast」；看染色質——細緻均勻即 blast，粗塊狀即成熟淋巴球。
背景紅血球的折光小泡是 drying（water）artifact，不要誤報為紅血球內包涵體或寄生蟲。
B-ALL flow：CD19+、CD10+、cCD79a+、CD22+、TdT+；T-ALL 則為 cytoplasmic CD3+，形態無法區分。
成人 B-ALL 中 BCR::ABL1 t(9;22) 比例隨年齡增加，陽性者治療需合併 TKI。
周邊血高母細胞數時注意 tumor lysis syndrome 與 leukostasis 的臨床處置。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把折光的乾燥假影當成紅血球包涵體或 malaria，或把 blast 當成小型成熟淋巴球；成熟淋巴球染色質粗塊狀，blast 則細緻均勻。

quiz.q: 圖中紅血球內的折光小泡代表什麼？這些核質比極高的細胞是成熟淋巴球還是 blast？
quiz.a: Drying（water）artifact；blast（lymphoblast）

2889.recognize_zh: 大片均質、細顆粒狀的粉紅色無細胞壞死（乾酪樣壞死 caseous necrosis）佔滿視野，中間夾著一條由組織球與少量發炎細胞組成的殘存細胞帶。
features: Extensive amorphous, finely granular eosinophilic necrosis without preserved architecture
Scattered tiny nuclear dust within necrotic areas
Central band of viable histiocytes and inflammatory cells with vacuolated cytoplasm
No recognizable splenic red or white pulp in this field
2889.describe_en: H&E section shows extensive amorphous, finely granular eosinophilic necrosis that effaces the normal splenic architecture, with scattered nuclear dust. A band of viable histiocytes and inflammatory cells, some with vacuolated cytoplasm, traverses the necrotic zone. Ghost outlines of the original tissue are not evident. Findings are consistent with caseous necrosis in the setting of necrotizing granulomatous inflammation; organisms should be sought with GMS and acid-fast stains.

ddx.vs: Infarcted tissue retains ghost outlines of cells and sinusoids, whereas caseous necrosis is structureless and granular.
Necrotic tumor usually shows viable neoplastic cells at the periphery rather than epithelioid histiocytes.
Abscesses are composed of neutrophils and nuclear debris rather than acellular pink granular material.

2825.recognize_zh: 背景是密集的顆粒球系增生（含嗜酸性、嗜鹼性球），中央有一顆小型、核只分兩葉的低分葉巨核細胞（dwarf/hypolobated megakaryocyte），這是 CML 骨髓的典型線索。
features: Small hypolobated megakaryocyte with a bilobed nucleus and finely granular pink-gray cytoplasm (dwarf megakaryocyte)
Marked granulocytic hyperplasia with myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands and segmented neutrophils
Scattered eosinophils and basophils with coarse dark granules
Occasional larger immature myeloid cells; blasts not obviously increased
Adjacent cell with multilobated overlapping nucleus, possibly a second megakaryocytic cell or overlap artifact
2825.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is hypercellular with marked granulocytic hyperplasia showing maturation, accompanied by increased eosinophils and basophils. A small megakaryocyte with a hypolobated, bilobed nucleus and moderate granular cytoplasm is present, typical of the dwarf megakaryocytes seen in CML. Blasts are not obviously increased in this field. Findings are consistent with chronic myeloid leukemia, chronic phase.

ddx.vs: MDS micromegakaryocytes accompany multilineage dysplasia and cytopenias, without the marked granulocytic hyperplasia and basophilia of CML.
ET megakaryocytes are large to giant with hyperlobulated staghorn nuclei, not small and hypolobated, and granulopoiesis is not expanded.
PMF megakaryocytes are atypical with cloud-like hyperchromatic nuclei in tight clusters and the disease is BCR::ABL1-negative.

ddx.dx: 5q- syndrome (MDS with low blasts and isolated del(5q))
ddx.vs: Del(5q) MDS has monolobated rather than bilobed megakaryocytes, macrocytic anemia and no granulocytic hyperplasia.

exam.answer_en: Chronic myeloid leukemia, chronic phase — granulocytic hyperplasia with eosinophils/basophils and small hypolobated 'dwarf' megakaryocytes
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指那顆小型、雙葉核的巨核細胞問「這叫什麼、見於哪個 MPN」——答 dwarf（micro）megakaryocyte，CML 特徵；與 ET/PV 的大型多葉 megakaryocyte 對比。
BCR::ABL1 陽性 CML 的骨髓切片：高細胞性、paratrabecular 未成熟髓系區增厚、小型 hypolobated megakaryocyte，可伴 pseudo-Gaucher cells 與 reticulin 增加。
若以血小板增多表現、缺乏明顯白血球增多，CML 也可能被誤當 ET；所有疑似 ET 的病人都要排除 BCR::ABL1。
Pseudo-Gaucher cell 與 sea-blue histiocyte 反映細胞周轉增加，非 CML 專有。
Dwarf megakaryocyte 與 MDS 的 micromegakaryocyte（單核、極小）需區分；後者屬 dysplasia，合併其他系列發育異常時考慮 MDS 或 MDS/MPN。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把小型雙葉 megakaryocyte 誤當 dysplastic micromegakaryocyte 而診斷 MDS；CML 背景為大量成熟 granulocyte 與 basophilia，確認需 BCR::ABL1。

quiz.q: 圖中小型、雙葉核、細胞質細顆粒的細胞為何？在 MPN 中最具代表性的是哪一種？
quiz.a: Dwarf（hypolobated small）megakaryocyte；CML

2697.recognize_zh: 中央一顆嗜中性球大小正常、細胞質有細小粉紫顆粒，但核是單一橢圓形未分葉，染色質粗糙結塊；核成熟卻不分葉，是 Pelger-Huët 異常中圓核型（Stodtmeister cell）的表現。
features: Neutrophil of normal size with a single oval, non-segmented nucleus
Very coarse, clumped mature chromatin with pale parachromatin spaces
Abundant pale cytoplasm with fine specific (neutrophilic) granules
No cytoplasmic hypogranularity or vacuolation
Normochromic red cells and a polychromatic cell in background
2697.describe_en: High-power view of a peripheral blood smear shows a mature neutrophil with a single round-to-oval, non-lobulated nucleus. The chromatin is coarsely clumped, indicating maturity despite absent segmentation, and the cytoplasm contains normal fine neutrophilic granules. Background red cells are normochromic with an occasional polychromatic cell. Findings are consistent with a hyposegmented neutrophil of Pelger-Huët type (round-nucleus form), which requires correlation with the rest of the smear to distinguish inherited from acquired (pseudo-Pelger) change.

ddx.vs: A myelocyte has a round nucleus but finer, less condensed chromatin and often a paranuclear clear zone, reflecting immaturity.
Lymphocytes lack the fine neutrophilic cytoplasmic granules and have scant, bluer cytoplasm.
Dysplastic hyposegmented neutrophils are often hypogranular and accompany other dysplastic lineages and cytopenias.

exam.answer_en: Pelger-Huët-type neutrophil (round-nucleus form) — mature neutrophil with single non-lobulated nucleus, coarsely clumped chromatin and normal granules
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指這顆單一圓核、細胞質有 neutrophilic 顆粒的細胞問「是 myelocyte 嗎？」——答否：myelocyte 染色質較細、可見核仁殘跡、細胞質偏藍；此為染色質成熟的 Pelger-Huët 型 neutrophil。
圓形單葉核（Stodtmeister cell）在遺傳性 PHA 的 homozygote 較常見；heterozygote 以雙葉 pince-nez 為主，但也可混有少數單葉。
若病人有 cytopenia、macrocytosis 或其他系列發育異常，round-nucleus 型 neutrophil 應視為 pseudo-Pelger dysplasia，考慮 MDS/AML 並做骨髓檢查。
判讀 dysplasia 必須用好的抹片與染色，並計數足夠數量的 neutrophil；單一細胞無法判定遺傳或後天。
藥物如 mycophenolate、tacrolimus 所致 pseudo-Pelger 在停藥後可消失，移植病人判讀時要考慮。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把圓核 neutrophil 誤認為 myelocyte 或 lymphocyte/plasma cell：本細胞染色質極度濃縮成塊、細胞質淡粉紅且滿布細小 neutrophilic 顆粒，屬成熟 neutrophil。

quiz.q: 單一圓核但染色質粗塊狀的成熟 neutrophil 若出現在 cytopenia 病人，應考慮何種後天疾病？
quiz.a: Myelodysplastic neoplasm（pseudo-Pelger-Huët dysplasia），或 AML/藥物影響

2569.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抹片的骨髓顆粒（particle）以大小不一的脂肪空泡為主，造血細胞只沿著空泡之間與基質帶稀疏分布，呈現低細胞密度的顆粒；此倍率看不出發育異常，MDS須配合高倍與切片。
features: Low-power view of a marrow particle dominated by large, variably sized fat spaces
Hematopoietic cells sparse, distributed along stromal strands between adipocytes
Dark, densely stained stromal/crushed cellular areas in the center of the particle
Scattered individual nucleated cells and red cells within and around fat spaces
Cytologic detail and dysplasia cannot be assessed at this magnification
2569.describe_en: Low-power view of a bone marrow aspirate particle shows a predominance of large adipocyte spaces with hematopoietic cells sparsely distributed along intervening stromal strands. Central areas are densely stained, likely representing stroma and crushed cells. Individual cell morphology cannot be evaluated at this magnification, so dysplasia and blast percentage cannot be assessed. The particle appears hypocellular, but aspirate particles are an imperfect surrogate for cellularity, which should be determined on an adequate core biopsy. Findings are compatible with a hypocellular marrow, which in the stated context supports but does not establish hypocellular myelodysplastic neoplasm.

ddx.vs: Aplastic anemia also yields fatty particles, and separation from hypocellular MDS relies on high-power dysplasia assessment, CD34 and p53 immunostains on biopsy, and cytogenetics.
Elderly patients normally have more fat, so cellularity must be age-adjusted on the biopsy and correlated with peripheral cytopenias.
Hypocellular AML shows at least 20% blasts on aspirate differential or CD34 immunostaining despite low cellularity.

2505.recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓抹片中許多嗜酸性骨髓球與成熟嗜酸性球，胞質滿布橘紅色顆粒，部分早期細胞夾雜暗紫色的未成熟顆粒，背景散落破裂細胞的游離顆粒，嗜酸性系大量增生。
features: Numerous eosinophilic myelocytes with round to indented nuclei and cytoplasm packed with orange-red granules
Some early eosinophil precursors containing admixed dark purple (immature, basophilic-staining) granules
Mature eosinophils with bilobed nuclei
Scattered orthochromatic normoblasts and small lymphocytes
Abundant free eosinophilic granules in the background from disrupted cells
2505.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at high power shows a marked increase in eosinophilic precursors, predominantly eosinophilic myelocytes and metamyelocytes with cytoplasm packed with orange-red granules, some early forms showing admixed dark purple immature granules, together with mature bilobed eosinophils. Scattered normoblasts and small lymphocytes are present, and many free granules lie in the background. Blasts are not increased in this field. Findings indicate marked eosinophilic hyperplasia, consistent with hypereosinophilic syndrome after exclusion of reactive and clonal (PDGFRA/PDGFRB/FGFR1/JAK2) causes.

ddx.vs: Abnormal eosinophils in AML with inv(16) have large, coarse, purple-violet granules and are accompanied by increased myeloblasts and monocytes.
Mastocytosis shows spindled CD25+ mast cells in aggregates, raised tryptase and KIT D816V, which should be sought on biopsy.

ddx.dx: Normal eosinophil maturation with immature granules
ddx.vs: Some dark granules are normal in early eosinophil precursors, so the discriminator here is the markedly increased proportion rather than granule color.

2313.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中大量母細胞與幼稚骨髓細胞混雜，母細胞核染色質細緻、有摺痕，細胞質藍灰；另可見含粗大深紫顆粒的嗜鹼球，在 CML 背景下提示急性轉化。
features: Numerous large blasts with fine chromatin, some with folded or indented nuclei and visible nucleoli
Moderate grayish-blue cytoplasm in many blasts, occasionally with small vacuoles
Admixed immature granulocytes (promyelocytes/myelocytes) with azurophilic granules
Occasional cells with coarse dark purple granules consistent with basophils, one vacuolated
Scattered free granules and few red cells in the background
2313.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a hypercellular population dominated by large blasts with fine chromatin, irregular or folded nuclei, occasional nucleoli and moderate grayish-blue cytoplasm. Admixed are immature granulocytes and scattered basophils with coarse dark granules, one showing vacuolation. Maturation beyond the myelocyte stage is limited in this field. Findings are consistent with blast phase of CML, BCR-ABL1-positive; blast enumeration and flow cytometric lineage assignment are required.

ddx.vs: Increased basophils and blasts below the blast-phase threshold favor acceleration, whereas this field shows blasts predominating.
Monocytic cells have abundant gray cytoplasm and folded nuclei similar to some cells here, but NSE staining, flow cytometry and BCR-ABL1 status with prior CML history separate them.
Acute basophilic leukemia shows blasts with basophilic granules and lacks a BCR-ABL1 rearrangement, which must be excluded.

exam.answer_en: CML, BCR::ABL1-positive, blast phase — marrow dominated by blasts with residual basophils and immature granulocytes
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指含粗紫顆粒的嗜鹼球與大量芽細胞，問「這些嗜鹼球提示什麼背景？」答 CML 背景，芽細胞增多代表 blast phase。
WHO 5th：CML 只分 chronic phase 與 blast phase（取消 accelerated phase）；blast phase 為 blasts ≥20%、髓外芽細胞增生或 PB/BM 出現增加的 lymphoblasts。ICC 2022 仍保留 accelerated phase。
約七成為 myeloid、其餘多為 lymphoid blast phase，必須 flow 定系；lymphoid BP 預後與治療策略不同（可合併 ALL 型化療）。
進展時要驗 ABL1 kinase domain mutation（如 T315I 需 ponatinib 或 asciminib）與 additional chromosomal abnormalities（+8、第二個 Ph、i(17q)）；適合者考慮 allogeneic HSCT。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤診為 de novo AML（如急性骨髓單核球性白血病）：需看既往 CML 病史、嗜鹼球增加、脾腫大與 BCR::ABL1；形態相似時靠遺傳與病史區分。

quiz.q: 圖中芽細胞大量增加並散在嗜鹼球，若病人已知 BCR::ABL1 陽性，這代表哪個病期？下一步必做哪項檢查決定芽細胞系別？
quiz.a: Blast phase（blast crisis）；flow cytometry 定系

2185.recognize_zh: 高倍下組織被中到大型、核形不規則、染色質呈泡狀並可見小核仁的非典型淋巴細胞瀰漫取代，其間夾雜小淋巴細胞與纖細膠原/血管，缺乏特定亞型的特徵，符合周邊 T 細胞淋巴瘤 NOS 的形態。
features: Diffuse sheets of medium-sized to large atypical lymphoid cells
Irregular, angulated to indented nuclei with vesicular chromatin and small nucleoli
Moderate amount of pale to clear cytoplasm in many cells
Admixed small mature lymphocytes creating a polymorphous appearance
Delicate eosinophilic collagen strands and small vessels traversing the infiltrate
Scattered mitotic figures and apoptotic bodies
2185.describe_en: High-power H&E section shows diffuse effacement by a polymorphous population of medium-sized to large atypical lymphoid cells with irregular, angulated nuclei, vesicular chromatin, small nucleoli, and moderate pale cytoplasm. Small mature lymphocytes are admixed, and the infiltrate is traversed by delicate collagen strands and small vessels. No Reed-Sternberg-like cells, prominent arborizing high endothelial venules, or granulomas are evident in this field. The findings are suggestive of a peripheral T-cell lymphoma; classification as PTCL, NOS requires immunophenotyping (loss of pan-T antigens, TFH markers) and exclusion of specific subtypes.

ddx.vs: AITL shows arborizing high endothelial venules, expanded follicular dendritic cell meshworks, and TFH marker expression (PD1, ICOS, CXCL13), which are not highlighted in this field.
Morphology overlaps; DLBCL cells are more uniformly large and express CD20/PAX5, whereas PTCL cells are CD3+ with aberrant T-antigen loss.
ALCL has hallmark cells with horseshoe nuclei, cohesive/sinusoidal growth, and strong uniform CD30 expression.
Reactive T-zone expansion lacks sheets of cytologically atypical cells and shows preserved architecture with normal T-antigen expression and polyclonal TCR.

2057.recognize_zh: 中低倍 H&E 下淋巴結被許多圓形、大小相近、背靠背的濾泡佔據，濾泡外套區變薄或不清楚、濾泡內沒有明顯亮暗分區，濾泡間僅剩窄窄的組織，是濾泡性淋巴瘤的典型型態。
features: Numerous closely packed, round neoplastic follicles of relatively uniform size
Attenuated or absent mantle zones with poorly defined follicle borders
Follicles appear monotonous without polarization or conspicuous tingible-body macrophages
Narrow interfollicular areas with vessels and a few red cells
Nodal architecture effaced
2057.describe_en: Medium-power section of lymph node shows effacement by closely packed, back-to-back round follicles of relatively uniform size. The follicles have attenuated mantle zones and lack polarization or conspicuous tingible-body macrophages, and the interfollicular areas are narrow. Findings are consistent with follicular lymphoma, to be confirmed by cytologic grading and BCL2/CD10 immunohistochemistry.

ddx.vs: Reactive follicles vary in size and shape with intact mantle zones, zonation and many tingible-body macrophages, and are BCL2 negative.
MCL nodules lack germinal center cells and are CD5 and cyclin D1 positive.

ddx.dx: Follicular colonization by marginal zone lymphoma
ddx.vs: Colonized follicles contain CD10-negative, BCL6-negative marginal zone cells and plasma cells rather than CD10+ neoplastic centrocytes.

exam.answer_en: Follicular lymphoma — back-to-back monotonous follicles with attenuated mantles, no polarization or tingible-body macrophages
pearls_zh: 考法：中倍指著一個濾泡問「哪些特徵支持腫瘤性濾泡？」答：mantle 變薄或消失、無亮暗區極化、缺乏 tingible-body macrophages、濾泡背靠背。
細胞學：濾泡由 centrocytes（小、核有切痕）與 centroblasts（大、泡狀核、周邊核仁）組成；centroblast 比例為傳統分級依據。
IHC/遺傳：CD10+、BCL6+、BCL2+ 於 germinal center；多數帶 t(14;18) IGH::BCL2，可用 FISH 證實。
臨床：常為無痛性全身淋巴結腫大；每年有一定比例轉化為 DLBCL，出現單一快速長大腫塊、LDH 上升或 B 症狀時應再切片。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 nodular mantle cell lymphoma：MCL 結節由單一小細胞組成、缺乏 centroblasts，且 CD5+、cyclin D1+、CD10 陰性。

quiz.q: 列出圖中兩個支持 follicular lymphoma 而非反應性濾泡的低倍特徵。
quiz.a: 濾泡背靠背且大小一致；mantle zone 變薄且無極化/無 tingible-body macrophages

1993.recognize_zh: 大片大型、多形性淋巴樣細胞，核呈泡狀、可見核仁；其中兩顆特別巨大的細胞有強陽性的細胞膜染色，周圍許多大細胞呈較弱的膜性染色，背景小淋巴球陰性，符合大 B 細胞淋巴瘤的間變型（anaplastic variant）常見的 CD30 表現型態。
features: Sheets of large atypical lymphoid cells, many 3-5 times the size of background small lymphocytes
Two bizarre giant cells with large irregular vesicular nuclei showing strong, crisp membranous staining
Weaker membranous and cytoplasmic staining in many surrounding large cells
Vesicular chromatin with visible nucleoli in the large cells on the hematoxylin counterstain
Scattered small, dark, negative background lymphocytes
1993.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain (antibody not labeled; staining pattern suggests CD30) of a lymph node shows sheets of large, pleomorphic lymphoid cells with vesicular nuclei and visible nucleoli. Two very large, bizarre cells show strong membranous positivity, and many of the surrounding large cells show weaker membranous staining, while background small lymphocytes are negative. In the setting of a confirmed B-cell phenotype, findings are consistent with diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, anaplastic variant.

ddx.vs: ALCL shows hallmark cells with uniform strong CD30 and ALK expression and lacks CD20/PAX5, whereas anaplastic DLBCL retains B-cell markers and is ALK-negative.
cHL has sparse Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells in an inflammatory background with weak or absent PAX5 and CD45 negativity, rather than sheets of large CD20-positive cells.
Cohesive nests with keratin or S100/SOX10 expression and CD45 negativity distinguish non-hematopoietic tumors.

1417.recognize_zh: 兩顆中等大小的淋巴母細胞，核質比極高、只剩一圈細薄的藍色細胞質，染色質細緻且上方細胞核有凹陷（nuclear indentation），缺乏顆粒與 Auer 小體，符合 T 淋巴母細胞白血病。
features: Two medium-sized blasts, roughly 1.5-2 times the diameter of adjacent red cells
Very high N:C ratio with a scant rim of basophilic, agranular cytoplasm
Round to slightly convoluted nuclei; the upper cell shows a nuclear notch/indentation
Finely dispersed to slightly condensed chromatin with inconspicuous nucleoli
No cytoplasmic granules or Auer rods
Background red cells without specific abnormality; no platelets in this field
1417.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two medium-sized blasts adjacent to each other. The cells have a very high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio with a thin rim of agranular basophilic cytoplasm, round to indented nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. No Auer rods or cytoplasmic granules are identified. The morphology is that of lymphoblasts; lineage assignment requires flow cytometry (cytoplasmic CD3, TdT). Findings are consistent with the stated diagnosis of T-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Morphologically indistinguishable; B-ALL expresses CD19/CD79a/PAX5 whereas T-ALL expresses cytoplasmic CD3 on flow cytometry.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with minimal differentiation
ddx.vs: Myeloblasts may have similar agranular cytoplasm, but they are MPO/CD13/CD33/CD117 positive and lack cytoplasmic CD3 and TdT-lymphoid profile.
Mature T-cell leukemias show more condensed chromatin (cerebriform or with a single prominent nucleolus) and are TdT and CD34 negative.

ddx.dx: Reactive large granular or atypical lymphocytes
ddx.vs: Reactive lymphocytes have more abundant cytoplasm and coarse mature chromatin rather than fine blastic chromatin.

exam.answer_en: T-lymphoblastic leukemia — medium blasts with very high N:C ratio, fine chromatin, nuclear indentation, no granules or Auer rods
pearls_zh: 考法：芽細胞形態無法區分 B 或 T lineage，考官會問「下一步做什麼」：flow cytometry 確認 lineage，cytoplasmic CD3 為 T lineage 決定標記。
Flow：TdT+、cCD3+、CD7+，可有 CD1a、CD4/CD8 雙陽性；ETP-ALL 為 CD1a−、CD8−、CD5 弱，並表現幹細胞/骨髓標記，預後較差。
臨床：好發青少年男性，常有前縱膈腔腫塊，可致 SVC syndrome 與氣道壓迫；高白血球時注意 tumor lysis syndrome。
分子：NOTCH1/FBXW7 mutation 常見；CNS 侵犯風險高，需 CNS prophylaxis。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 AML with minimal differentiation 或 B-ALL；兩者形態可相同，需靠 flow（MPO、cCD3、CD19/cCD79a）判斷 lineage。

quiz.q: 形態無法分 lineage 時，哪個 flow 標記可確立 T lineage？
quiz.a: Cytoplasmic CD3（cCD3）

60297.recognize_zh: 視野中有數個細長、兩端尖、呈新月或鐮刀狀的紅血球（sickle cells），並散在變形、雙凹不明顯的紅血球，符合鐮刀型紅血球。
features: Several elongated, crescent-shaped red cells with pointed ends (sickle cells/drepanocytes)
Some boat-shaped and oat-shaped cells with blunt ends (reversibly sickled forms)
Background anisopoikilocytosis with ovoid cells and occasional small dense cells
Occasional crenated red cells, likely artifact
No nucleated red cells or leukocytes in this field
60297.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked poikilocytosis with numerous elongated crescent-shaped red cells having tapered, pointed ends, as well as boat- and oat-shaped forms. The remaining red cells show anisocytosis with ovoid and small dense forms, and occasional crenated cells are present. Findings are consistent with sickle cells, as seen in sickle cell disease (HbSS or compound heterozygous states such as HbSC or HbS/beta-thalassemia); hemoglobin electrophoresis or HPLC is required for classification.

ddx.vs: Elliptocytes are symmetric oval to rod-shaped cells with rounded ends, lacking the tapered pointed ends and crescent curvature of sickle cells.
Schistocytes are fragments with straight cut edges (helmets, triangles) rather than elongated intact cells with pointed ends.
HbSC shows fewer classic sickles and characteristic straight-edged or glove-shaped crystal-containing cells and many target cells, which are not prominent here.
Artifactually elongated cells are aligned in the same direction across the field, whereas these sickle cells are randomly oriented.

exam.answer_en: Sickle cell disease — elongated crescent-shaped sickle cells (drepanocytes) with pointed ends plus boat/oat-shaped forms
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指細長兩端尖的新月形紅血球問名稱，並追問確診方法與基因變異。
HbS 為 β-globin 第 6 個胺基酸 glutamic acid → valine（HBB c.20A>T），去氧狀態下聚合導致變形；確診靠 Hb electrophoresis 或 HPLC。
Sickle cell trait（HbAS）血片通常看不到 sickle cells；典型 sickle 見於 HbSS、HbSC、HbS/β-thalassemia。
急症：vaso-occlusive crisis、acute chest syndrome、stroke、splenic sequestration、parvovirus B19 aplastic crisis；治療含 hydroxyurea 與輸血／換血。
自體脾梗塞後血片常出現 Howell-Jolly bodies 與 target cells，病人易受 encapsulated bacteria 感染。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 elliptocytes：elliptocyte 為兩端圓鈍、對稱的橢圓或棒狀；sickle cell 呈彎曲新月形且兩端尖細。抹片推片人工變形則方向一致。

quiz.q: 圖中新月形、兩端尖的紅血球叫什麼？確診其血紅素異常應做什麼檢查？
quiz.a: Sickle cells（drepanocytes）；hemoglobin electrophoresis 或 HPLC

137.recognize_zh: 周邊血液可見中型淋巴球，核圓至卵圓、染色質略塊狀、核仁不明顯，細胞質豐富、淡灰藍色，周緣有細毛狀突起；骨髓切片細胞間距寬、呈「荷包蛋（fried-egg）」樣，CD20 強陽性、Annexin A1 陽性，流式 CD103、CD25、CD200 陽性且 lambda 單株性，符合毛狀細胞白血病（HCL）。
features: Medium-sized lymphoid cells with round to oval nuclei and low-moderate N:C ratio
Moderately condensed ('spongy') chromatin with inconspicuous nucleoli
Abundant pale grey-blue cytoplasm with fine circumferential hair-like projections
BM aspirate: sheets of monotonous cells with oval to slightly indented nuclei and ragged pale cytoplasm
BM biopsy: diffuse infiltrate of widely spaced nuclei separated by clear cytoplasm (fried-egg pattern) with red cell extravasation
IHC: CD20 strongly positive, Annexin A1 positive, cyclin D1 weak nuclear; flow CD103+, CD25+, CD200+, CD123 largely negative, lambda-restricted
137.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows medium-sized lymphoid cells with round to oval nuclei, moderately condensed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and abundant pale grey-blue cytoplasm with fine circumferential hair-like projections, admixed with a small mature lymphocyte. The bone marrow aspirate contains sheets of morphologically similar cells. The core biopsy shows a diffuse infiltrate of monotonous cells with evenly spaced round to oval nuclei surrounded by clear cytoplasm, imparting a fried-egg appearance, with areas of red cell extravasation. Immunohistochemistry shows strong CD20, cytoplasmic Annexin A1 and weak nuclear cyclin D1 (BCL1) expression, and flow cytometry identifies a lambda-restricted B-cell population (97.6% of B cells) expressing bright CD20, CD103, CD25 and CD200 with little or no CD123. Findings are consistent with hairy cell leukemia.

ddx.dx: Hairy cell leukemia variant / splenic B-cell lymphoma with prominent nucleoli
ddx.vs: HCL-v cells have a prominent nucleolus, lack CD25 and Annexin A1 and are BRAF V600E negative, whereas these cells have inconspicuous nucleoli and express CD25 and Annexin A1.

SMZL villous lymphocytes have polar (bipolar) short projections and are typically CD103-, CD25-/weak, Annexin A1-negative with a nodular/intrasinusoidal marrow pattern rather than diffuse fried-egg infiltration.

ddx.dx: Splenic diffuse red pulp small B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: SDRPL shows broad-based villous cytoplasm, intrasinusoidal marrow involvement and is Annexin A1-negative and usually CD25-negative, unlike this Annexin A1+/CD25+ infiltrate.
MCL is cyclin D1 strongly positive but CD5+, CD103-, CD25- and Annexin A1-negative with scant cytoplasm, whereas HCL shows only weak cyclin D1 with abundant hairy cytoplasm.

captions: PB smear: hairy cells with abundant pale cytoplasm and circumferential projections
BM aspirate: sheets of monotonous hairy cells
BM biopsy: fried-egg infiltrate (H&E) with CD20, Annexin A1 and weak BCL1 positivity
Flow cytometry: lambda-restricted CD20-bright B cells expressing CD103, CD25 and CD200, CD123 largely negative

exam.answer_en: Hairy cell leukemia — lymphoid cells with circumferential hairy projections, fried-egg marrow infiltrate, CD103+/CD25+/Annexin A1+
pearls_zh: 考法：血片指著細胞質周圍一圈細毛狀突起的淋巴球，切片指荷包蛋樣間距寬的細胞，問診斷與確認用 marker。
表型：CD11c、CD25、CD103 亮陽性；Annexin A1 是 HCL 最特異的 IHC（但 T 細胞與骨髓細胞也會染），TRAP 陽性。
分子：幾乎所有典型 HCL 帶 BRAF V600E；IHC 可用 VE1 抗體；HCL variant 與 SMZL 無此突變。
臨床：全血球低下合併單核球減少（monocytopenia）、脾腫大、骨髓因網狀纖維化常 dry tap；一線治療為 purine analog（cladribine）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤認為 SMZL 的絨毛狀淋巴球；SMZL 突起集中於一極、CD103/CD25/Annexin A1 陰性，也無 BRAF V600E。

quiz.q: 此白血病最具診斷價值的單一 IHC 標記與分子變化各為何？
quiz.a: Annexin A1；BRAF V600E

73.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片細胞密度明顯增加，呈三系增生（panmyelosis），巨核細胞大小不一、核過度分葉，並鬆散成群；網狀纖維染色有輕度增加。血液抹片紅血球擁擠，可見嗜鹼性球，符合 JAK2 V617F 陽性的真性紅血球增多症。
features: Hypercellular marrow for age with panmyelosis (increased erythroid, granulocytic and megakaryocytic lineages)
Increased, pleomorphic megakaryocytes ranging from small to giant with hyperlobulated nuclei, forming loose clusters, some with emperipolesis
Megakaryocytes are not tightly clustered and lack cloud-like hyperchromatic nuclei
Reticulin stain: loose network with focally increased, intersecting fibers (about MF-1, focally MF-2)
Aspirate: trilineage maturation with granulocytic predominance and megakaryocytes; no obvious increase in blasts in this field
Peripheral blood: crowded normochromic red cells, neutrophils, a basophil, and a large mononuclear cell with fine chromatin
73.describe_en: The peripheral blood smear shows densely packed normochromic red cells, mature neutrophils, and an occasional basophil. There is also an occasional large mononuclear cell with fine chromatin and pale blue agranular cytoplasm; a circulating blast cannot be excluded at this resolution. The bone marrow core biopsy is hypercellular for age with panmyelosis. Megakaryocytes are increased and pleomorphic, ranging from small forms to giant forms with hyperlobulated nuclei, and they lie in loose clusters, often near sinusoids and fat. The reticulin stain shows a mild increase in fibers, with focal intersections (about MF-1, focally MF-2). The aspirate shows trilineage hematopoiesis with granulocytic predominance and no overt increase in blasts. In a patient with known JAK2 V617F-positive disease, findings are consistent with polycythemia vera. The mild reticulin fibrosis and circulating immature cells are worth recording as possible features of progression.

ddx.vs: ET shows normocellular marrow with large-to-giant, deeply hyperlobulated (staghorn) megakaryocytes but no panmyelosis, whereas this marrow shows trilineage hyperplasia with megakaryocytes of widely varying size.

PMF megakaryocytes are atypical, forming tight clusters with hyperchromatic, cloud-like or balloon-shaped nuclei and a high N:C ratio, and granulocytic proliferation is accompanied by reduced erythropoiesis, whereas here megakaryocytes are pleomorphic but mature-appearing and erythropoiesis is preserved.
Post-PV myelofibrosis requires MF-2 to MF-3 reticulin fibrosis with leukoerythroblastosis, teardrop cells and splenomegaly, whereas fibrosis here is only mild and focal.
Secondary erythrocytosis shows isolated erythroid hyperplasia without pleomorphic, clustered megakaryocytes, with normal or high erythropoietin and no JAK2 mutation.

captions: Peripheral blood, low power: crowded red cells with neutrophils and a mononuclear cell (Wright-Giemsa)
Peripheral blood: basophil, neutrophils and a large mononuclear cell among densely packed red cells
Peripheral blood, high power: large mononuclear cell with fine chromatin and agranular blue cytoplasm
Core biopsy, low power: hypercellular marrow with numerous megakaryocytes (H&E)
Core biopsy, medium power: panmyelosis with increased, loosely clustered megakaryocytes
Core biopsy, high power: pleomorphic giant megakaryocytes with hyperlobulated nuclei in loose clusters
Core biopsy, high power: large hyperlobulated megakaryocytes with emperipolesis amid erythroid and myeloid precursors
Reticulin stain: mildly increased reticulin fibers with focal intersections
Bone marrow aspirate: trilineage hematopoiesis with megakaryocytes and granulocytic predominance (Wright-Giemsa)

exam.answer_en: Polycythemia vera (JAK2 V617F) — hypercellular marrow with panmyelosis and pleomorphic hyperlobulated megakaryocytes; mild reticulin increase
pearls_zh: 考法：考官會指大小不一、鬆散成群的多形性巨核細胞，並問三系增生（panmyelosis）要與 ET、PMF 如何區分。
WHO 5th 主要診斷條件：Hb >16.5 g/dL（男）/>16.0（女）或 Hct >49%/48%；骨髓 panmyelosis 伴多形性成熟巨核細胞；JAK2 V617F 或 exon 12 突變；次要條件為 EPO 低。
治療：放血目標 Hct <45% 加低劑量 aspirin；高風險（年齡 ≥60 或血栓史）加 hydroxyurea 或 interferon（如 ropeginterferon）。
進展：網狀纖維達 grade 2–3 並符合次要條件即 post-PV myelofibrosis；周邊血出現母細胞需排除加速/急性轉化。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 ET 或早期 PMF：ET 巨核細胞大而鹿角狀、無三系增生；PMF 巨核細胞緊密成簇、核呈雲朵狀深染。PV 以多形性、鬆散分布為特點。

quiz.q: PV 骨髓切片最具特徵的變化是什麼？
quiz.a: 高細胞性三系增生（panmyelosis）伴多形性成熟巨核細胞

1225.recognize_zh: 抹片中血小板明顯增多，大小不一，包括大型血小板與一團聚集的血小板，部分顆粒稀少；紅血球與白血球形態大致正常；這種單純的血小板增多是原發性血小板增多症（essential thrombocythemia）的周邊血象。
features: Markedly increased platelets scattered throughout the field
Platelet anisocytosis with large platelets and a central platelet clump
Some platelets hypogranular or with irregular granule distribution
Normal-appearing segmented neutrophil
Red cells largely normocytic and normochromic without teardrop cells or nucleated red cells
1225.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows markedly increased platelets with anisocytosis, including large platelets, occasional hypogranular forms, and a platelet aggregate. The segmented neutrophil appears morphologically normal, and red cells are largely normocytic and normochromic without teardrop cells, nucleated red cells, or immature myeloid cells. The absence of leukoerythroblastosis argues against overt myelofibrosis. In the setting of sustained thrombocytosis with a JAK2, CALR, or MPL mutation and characteristic marrow megakaryocytes, findings are consistent with essential thrombocythemia.

ddx.vs: Platelets are usually more uniform in size with hypochromic microcytes or Howell-Jolly bodies, and there is no MPN driver mutation.
Shows leukocytosis with a myelocyte bulge and basophilia and BCR::ABL1 fusion.
Separated mainly by bone marrow biopsy showing atypical clustered megakaryocytes, granulocytic hyperplasia, and often mild leukoerythroblastosis.

ddx.dx: Pseudothrombocytosis from red cell fragments or microspherocytes
ddx.vs: Fragments are pink and lack the purple granules of true platelets.

exam.answer_en: Essential thrombocythemia (peripheral smear) — marked thrombocytosis with platelet anisocytosis and giant platelets, otherwise unremarkable cells
pearls_zh: 考法：血片看血小板數量與大小，並確認沒有淚滴狀紅血球/leukoerythroblastosis（提示 PMF）或嗜鹼性球與左移（提示 CML）。
WHO 主要標準：血小板 ≥450×10^9/L、骨髓大型成熟多葉巨核細胞增生、不符合其他髓系腫瘤、JAK2/CALR/MPL 突變。
Driver 突變以 JAK2 V617F 最常見，其次 CALR，MPL 較少；三陰性者需更仔細排除反應性。
血小板極高時可發生 acquired von Willebrand syndrome 出血，使用 aspirin 前應評估。
依血栓風險（年齡、血栓史、JAK2 狀態）決定 aspirin 與 cytoreduction（如 hydroxyurea）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤為反應性血小板增多（缺鐵、發炎、脾切除後）；需查 ferritin、CRP，驗 driver 突變與骨髓巨核細胞形態，並確認 BCR::ABL1 陰性。

quiz.q: WHO 診斷 ET 的血小板數門檻為何？
